rites.name: Riallium
rites.text: A stone-bound power that lets its wielder harden the ground and the body alike. It works the same way as a common shaping rite of hide-hardening.

rites.name: Nasaullus
rites.text: Nasaullus is the concept of the first sounding in Elaennirlys, the note that condensed the roots of the world out of the undifferentiated hum of the Singing. It persists as a faint resonance that shapes how early matter settles into form. Its influence is less a blast than a slow, enduring pull toward order.

rites.name: Launtanum
rites.text: A basic healing craft lets a caster draw a small measure of a touched creature's mind into their own for a short span of time. The borrowed sharpness fades once the moment passes.

rites.name: Corollum
rites.text: A minor healing-craft practiced by apprentices, used to draw upon a trader's sense of barter and exchange. It belongs to the restorative arts taught in early schools.

rites.name: Telleonanum
rites.text: A basic restorative craft that lets a practitioner draw a measure of bodily force from another living being through a single touch. The stolen vigor flows into the caster for a short span before fading away.

rites.name: Valisium Amelor
rites.text: A beginner's healing-craft that draws a measure of stamina out of a touched creature and channels it into the caster for a short span. The borrowed vigor fades after twenty seconds.

rites.name: Lalus
rites.text: A minor restorative incantation that draws a small measure of lock-breaking wit from a touched creature into the caster for a short while.

rites.name: Ceorentia
rites.text: A minor healing craft lets a caster touch another being and draw away a small portion of their fortune for a brief span. The borrowed fortune then flows into the caster for a short while.

rites.name: Ciarnanum
rites.text: A basic restorative rite lets a practitioner draw a small portion of another's mental artistry through touch for a brief span. The borrowed skill fades after a few moments.

rites.name: Sereostanum
rites.text: A simple touch-craft that draws a little resolve out of another creature and lends it to the caster for a short span. It is an easy art taught to beginners of the healing arts.

rites.name: Viarneoles
rites.text: A novice healing craft that draws quickness from a touched foe and grants it to the caster for a short span. The borrowed nimbleness lasts about twenty heartbeats of time.

rites.name: Ceosus Nistentium
rites.text: A fierce war-trance that a warrior folk can call upon, halving the harm they take while doubling the blows they land. It strengthens every strike of body or missile, yet leaves magic and enchanted blades untouched.

rites.name: Seraurnium Virium
rites.text: A minor healing craft taught to novice casters, added through a later collection of scrolls. It draws on restorative magic at the simplest level.

rites.name: Serosia
rites.text: A simple charm-craft that a beginner can learn, letting a caster warm another creature's feelings toward them with a single brief touch. The warmth fades after half a minute.

rites.name: Liarosum
rites.text: A practiced craft that hurls a sphere of burning flame at enemies, scorching them with fire. It is the earliest such technique a student learns.

rites.name: Telaustum
rites.text: A minor craft of reshaping that a beginner can learn. A touch presses a heavy weight upon a creature for a short span.

rites.name: Laulus Veostum
rites.text: A summoning craft that calls a great furred beast to fight beside its wielder for a short span. It is granted to those who finish a trial, offered as a gift by a village elder.

rites.name: Miastanum Meontanum
rites.text: A minor charm craft that a practitioner lays on a person with a touch, warming that person toward them for a short span. It is the simplest of the mind-bending arts taught to beginners.

rites.name: Molor
rites.text: A shaping craft that briefly presses extra heaviness onto a target, draining their stamina faster. The added weight lifts away once the working fades.

rites.name: Amanium Valintauror
rites.text: A beginner's conjuring rite that calls forth a skeletal archer to fight alongside its caster for one minute.

rites.name: Serialium Venor
rites.text: A innate gift of one people that bends a wild beast into a temporary companion for a short spell. It may be called upon only once in each day.

rites.name: Leonaules
rites.text: A minor battle-craft that delivers a chilling blow to a foe when the caster's hand makes contact. It is taught early to apprentices learning to wield destructive forces.

rites.name: Riallum Orillus
rites.text: A binding craft that bends a beast's will so it battles the caster's foes for a set span. Once the bond lapses, the creature returns to its natural temper.

rites.name: Nialium Telialonia
rites.text: A minor frost-working craft taught to novice casters, channeled through the palm to numb and freeze whatever it touches. It is among the simplest disciplines of the cold arts.

rites.name: Venia
rites.text: A minor, beginner-level craft of ruin that a practitioner can learn from a bound scroll. It spreads a slow corruption through whatever it touches.

rites.name: Tauranum
rites.text: A minor inscribed charm of the destructive arts that, once invoked, lowers a chosen person's nimbleness by a single point.

rites.name: Sirnanum
rites.text: A beginner's inscribed incantation drawn from the discipline of ruinous force. When spoken over a target, it dulls their quickness by a single degree.

rites.name: Ristus Veontium
rites.text: A ritual working that briefly raises a bearer's fortune, after which their fortune quietly returns to its former measure. It belongs to the craft of mending and restoration.

rites.name: Tiastaullus Corastes
rites.text: A minor arcane working that a novice caster can perform to harden their own protection. For half a minute the caster's armor rating rises by a fixed fraction.

rites.name: Talor Sirellium
rites.text: A minor arcane art of the lowest rank that reshapes one's own body to strengthen its guard. It was introduced as a late addition to a collection of scrolls.

rites.name: Coraullenum
rites.text: A passive inherited craft that lets certain peoples of the realm hold a guarding ward more readily. It is shared among the lineages of two northern tribes.

rites.name: Amauntia Coriasintes
rites.text: A dark working that siphons vitality and inner power from a foe for a short while. The effect fades and the victim slowly recovers.

rites.name: Maunaror Tisanum
rites.text: A minor ward-craft that lets a novice channel a crackling jolt through the palm. A single touch delivers a burst of lightning to whatever it strikes.

rites.name: Tausium Oristor
rites.text: A basic shaping craft that lightens the caster's load, letting them carry far more weight for a short stretch of time. Novice practitioners learn it early in their training.

rites.name: Viarus Venalor
rites.text: A rare beginner-level art of reshaping matter that a practitioner uses to transform or alter the substance of things. It belongs to the early study of change and transmutation.

rites.name: Teloneosus
rites.text: A small, quick magical discharge that a novice caster hurls at a foe, dealing a modest wound to the target's vitality on contact.

rites.name: Maustornor
rites.text: A minor hexing craft taught to novice casters, in which a touch sends a burst of icy harm into whatever it meets. It is a simple first lesson in shaping cold.

rites.name: Laurnia Ameorus
rites.text: A minor novice craft that lets a caster set a target alight with a touch. It belongs to the school of destructive arts taught to beginners.

rites.name: Tausanum Males
rites.text: A novice ward-craft that lets a caster lay a searing palm upon a foe, scorching them with a burst of heat. It is taught early to those beginning their study of ruinous arts.

rites.name: Nanor Maurneostum
rites.text: A restorative enchantment that temporarily sharpens a wearer's skill with mid-weight plate. When the working fades, the skill slips back to its former level.

rites.name: Seraures Coreoranum
rites.text: A minor healing-craft charm that lets its caster move with greater nimbleness for a short while. It is learned early by novice practitioners of the restorative arts.

rites.name: Meornellor
rites.text: A woodland folk's learned art of stepping into the shade of one trunk and slipping out of sight. Those who master it disappear into the grain of the grove.

rites.name: Sialor Teliasores
rites.text: A minor restorative art that a novice practitioner can invoke to briefly swell their body's raw might. The boost lasts a short span of a minute and a half.

rites.name: Lentalus
rites.text: A warm lingering radiance that settles over a traveler once a kindled flame catches during a chance meeting. It fades after half an hour.

rites.name: Minum
rites.text: A beginner's incantation that conjures a brief tongue of flame and hurls it at one foe, burning them for a modest measure of harm.

rites.name: Sallum
rites.text: A minor healing craft taught to novice casters that briefly quickens the body of whoever performs it. The swiftness lasts a short while before it fades away.

rites.name: Riasanum Loranium
rites.text: A minor hostile incantation that drains an enemy's stamina, weakening their strength in battle and hindering their escape.

rites.name: Marnialles
rites.text: A mid-tier healing-craft rite that a practitioner speaks to swell their bodily might by ten points for a minute and a half.

rites.name: Carintor
rites.text: A binding craft that freezes a target in place while adding a crushing heaviness to its burden, so the victim tires far more quickly.

rites.name: Valesia Saules
rites.text: A restorative incantation that briefly sharpens a fighter's unarmed combat ability. The enhanced skill fades back to its normal level once the incantation ends.

rites.name: Cases
rites.text: A minor healing craft that lets a caster touch a creature and siphon a small measure of its vitality into themselves. It is one of the first restorative arts taught to novice practitioners.

rites.name: Valaules Salor
rites.text: A bolt of hostile craft that saps the vitality of whoever it strikes, draining a modest share of their strength for a short span of moments. It is one of the first disciplines a novice learns to shape.

rites.name: Cosus Amornum
rites.text: A minor healing craft taught to novice mages that restores a large portion of the caster's stamina when cast. It belongs to the gentler branch of restorative magic.

rites.name: Molles Telaulium
rites.text: A low-tier shaping of destructive force that drains a foe's stamina by a modest amount for a short span. Apprentice casters learn it early as a first lesson in harming others' endurance.

rites.name: Ciales Sornia
rites.text: A ruinous craft in which a caster's hand brings a temporary curse of ill fortune upon an opponent, weakening their hold on chance.

rites.name: Centus Nornales
rites.text: A low-tier harmful incantation that drains a little vitality from a struck foe for a short span. It is the first strike a student learns to cast.

rites.name: Silia Larnor
rites.text: A forceful technique drawn from the two-handed fighting discipline, used by warriors in active combat. It is a trained method for building and releasing sustained force in battle.

rites.name: Nialleornor
rites.text: A minor illusion craft that soothes a creature of low standing, easing its agitation for a short span of moments. It is taught to novice illusionists as a first lesson in mind-working.

rites.name: Neollum Valenor
rites.text: A stony roar that turns those who hear it into rock for a short moment. Certain beings of old stone can unleash it at will.

rites.name: Riallarnus
rites.text: A basic binding craft that a caster lays upon another person with a touch, hardening their protective covering by a tenth for a short span of moments.

rites.name: Leoranum Taullernia
rites.text: A minor healing craft taught to novice casters, drawn from the restorative arts. It is gained through a bound scroll added in a later supplement to the training library.

rites.name: Seolor Malaurnum
rites.text: A novice-level art of reshaping the body that lets a caster harden their guard, raising their defensive rating by a modest share for half a minute.

rites.name: Tiror Lintalum
rites.text: A cry that carries through the night, learned as a craft by beast-kin. It is one of the techniques taught within the wolf-blood tradition.

rites.name: Orestisia Ceostiarnia
rites.text: A minor binding craft that unsettles the resolve of the restless dead. Upon striking its target, it saps their nerve for half a minute.

rites.name: Canelia
rites.text: A lingering vigor that certain peoples of the north and the desert carried into battle, slowly mending wounds while the fighting continues. It was later renamed among the hill-folk and the plains-folk.

rites.name: Rialus Tenium
rites.text: A faster way of moving on foot that steadily builds a person's athletic training, though less quickly than swimming does. It tires the body more slowly than a walking pace, and at great mastery the difference fades.

rites.name: Cirontus
rites.text: A passive ability that quietly sharpens the wielder's raw force. It belongs to a branch of learned instincts tied to hunting, fur-cloaked kin.

rites.name: Cernolia
rites.text: A bound parchment that, when unrolled, releases a burst of elemental force that harms foes and leaves them briefly frozen in place.

rites.name: Causteolum
rites.text: A junior destructive working that a student caster learns, delivering a scorching blast of force. It is added to a collection of bound scrolls gathered from distant libraries.

rites.name: Veornor Vaustium
rites.text: Those born beneath a hidden star gain a gift that lets them vanish from sight for one minute each day. Their bodies fade completely, leaving no trace to the watching eye.

rites.name: Rausarnia Lesus
rites.text: A gentle hand-craft that quiets a creature of lesser might when touched, leaving it calm for a short span. Novices learn it early in the arts of seeming and sway.

rites.name: Narnaullum
rites.text: A minor sorcery of the ice-craft that hurls a compact sphere of cold at a foe, dealing a modest chill-wound when it strikes. It is the first lesson taught to apprentices of the destructive arts.

rites.name: Veonaustor
rites.text: A minor illusion craft that a caster can perform to cast a ring of pale light around themselves. The glow lasts for one minute and reaches about twenty feet in every direction.

rites.name: Meorises
rites.text: A carved wooden rod that unleashes a rush of fire to form a blazing barrier. Its heat answers the same call as a common flame-wall incantation.

rites.name: Telentiases Minus
rites.text: A minor conjuring rite that calls forth a bony servant to fight beside the caster for a short span of time. It is taught to novices who are only beginning to learn the arts of summoning.

rites.name: Valianentia
rites.text: A minor healing craft of the lower ranks that a student learns early. It draws on restorative power and lies within the reach of novice practitioners.

rites.name: Teleoses Corastum
rites.text: A minor craft of harm taught to novice practitioners, belonging to the path of ruin. It is found within a bound scroll collection added later to the body of known lore.

rites.name: Vesiallus
rites.text: A novice incantation that calls forth a small mischievous spirit to fight beside the caster for a short span of time.

rites.name: Amialor Corentanum
rites.text: A mid-tier binding craft that calls forth a bony sentinel to stand beside its caster in battle. The sentinel fights on the caster's side for a short span before fading away.

rites.name: Serostor Telasinum
rites.text: A high-skill sorcerous rite that calls forth a bony warrior to fight beside its caster for a short while. The bound champion serves as a loyal companion until its brief term expires.

rites.name: Corontia Amaurnor
rites.text: A tempering craft that sharpens a speaker's persuasion for a single hour. It is granted when a traveler offers a small coin to a wanderer in need.

rites.name: Liaranes
rites.text: A coldly crackling art that lets a practitioner strike an enemy with a blow of freezing force. The rime it leaves bites deep into the foe.

rites.name: Vaurnallium
rites.text: A ward-craft that briefly strengthens the sharpness of a chopping blade. Once its hold fades, the blade's edge returns to its former measure.

rites.name: Mestor Telenostia
rites.text: A minor ember-craft taught to beginners that hurls a small burst of heat. On impact it scorches everything within a short reach for a few moments.

rites.name: Oranteria
rites.text: A restorative art that briefly strengthens the protective value of mid-weight plate worn by warriors. When the working fades, the wearer's defenses slowly return to their former measure.

rites.name: Neosaurnium
rites.text: A minor hex taught to novice war-casters that leaves a foe briefly more vulnerable to venom. The effect fades after a short span of time.

rites.name: Larinia
rites.text: Larinia is the concept of listening made into a force within Elaennirlys, the thread that carries a sovereign's word from the Courts out to the groves and kingdoms of the Arcane Realm. In the second age of divine trials and doorbuilding, it is said to hold the councils steady by refusing any vow that cannot be heard across distance.

rites.name: Tenkanoma
rites.text: Tenkanoma is the concept of the turning of seasons into law, as held by the councils of Elaennirlys during the Courts. It was named in the age when the first sovereign began to raise groves and bind kingdoms to the calendar, and it is said to be the reason harvests were ever promised. Its presence is felt most strongly where oaths are sworn at the change of the year.

rites.name: Tarnolduden
rites.text: Tarnolduden is the concept of the Arcane binding, the principle by which the Courts of Elaennirlys wove doors between worlds during the age of divine trials. In the Holy Age of flame and temples, it was taught as the discipline that holds a promise to its keeper.

rites.name: Orauntum
rites.text: A mystic working that briefly siphons some of a target's fortune into the caster's own hands. A distant variant instead draws away the target's nimbleness of limb.

rites.name: Amaulles
rites.text: A ritual discipline of crafted sets that seeks to lift the practitioner toward a higher celestial realm. It draws on an ancient lost people's attempts at the same ascent.

rites.name: Telontenes
rites.text: A mid-tier healing ritual where a caster touches another and draws away a portion of their shaping talent for a brief span. The borrowed skill fades after a few heartbeats of counted time.

rites.name: Oriraunanum
rites.text: A craft that bends the basic workings of the natural world, letting a practitioner harden flesh, open barred doors, or weigh down a foe in a way everyone can perceive. Its greatest value lies beyond open fighting, often serving those who slip unseen through life.

rites.name: Cintollia
rites.text: A mystic working that draws a portion of a target's inner resolve into the caster's own spirit. A distant form exists that performs the same draining from afar.

rites.name: Coraurnes
rites.text: A discipline of silent movement that lets a wanderer leap farther and higher across the land. Greater practice softens the impact of hard falls from great heights.

rites.name: Marnaulia
rites.text: A restorative rite that renews every swiftness of a body and can only be invoked at a consecrated sanctuary of the three holy guardians.

rites.name: Amorillanum
rites.text: A minor healing-craft ritual lets a caster lay a hand on another and draw away a small measure of that person's swiftness, which then courses through the caster for a brief spell.

rites.name: Orentum
rites.text: A mystic working that siphons vitality from a foe into the caster, letting the caster surpass their normal limit until the draw fades. When it ends, the borrowed vigor returns to its source, and a turned-back draw drains the caster instead.

rites.name: Mollirnor
rites.text: A quiet working of the arcane arts that strips away the enchantments clinging to the one who casts it. It leaves the caster free of every lingering magical effect.

rites.name: Amestor
rites.text: A novice healing craft that draws a measure of a target's restorative aptitude into the caster's hands for a brief span. The borrowed skill fades after a few heartbeats of time.

rites.name: Vintia
rites.text: A ritual working that draws a portion of another being's temperament into the caster's own mind. A distant variant performs the same draw from across a space.

rites.name: Nerum
rites.text: A clouding craft that briefly weakens a foe's aim, making their blows and strikes land less often. Its hold on the target is only temporary.

rites.name: Rellanum
rites.text: A mid-tier restorative craft that lets a practitioner draw fifteen points of another's defensive training into their own body. The borrowed skill fades after ten seconds of contact.

rites.name: Valisium
rites.text: A restorative rite that returns a person's capacity for concealment and silent movement. It may only be invoked at a sacred shrine dedicated to a council of three divine guardians.

rites.name: Sialia
rites.text: A restorative art that draws stamina out of a target and into the caster, leaving the target weary while the caster swells with borrowed vigor. When the working fades, the borrowed strength returns to its rightful owner.

rites.name: Marnaulus
rites.text: A sacred calling that a chosen seeker may receive from several divine or spiritual voices. It follows a particular trial of the inner path and forms a central step in a larger sequence of tasks.

rites.name: Amasteores
rites.text: A sacred working that drains the life from a foe while searing them with flame, leaving the victim more vulnerable to burning harm afterward.

rites.name: Ceorollanum
rites.text: A mental craft that draws swiftness out of a target and binds it to the caster. A ranged form of the same working can siphon that quickness from a distance for a set span.

rites.name: Valarnistia
rites.text: A discipline taught within the wise-scholars' maze, required of the one who will inherit the seat of rule. It is studied alongside ceremonial law over a long span of years.

rites.name: Ciallum
rites.text: A guarded vigil in which a hired protector watches over a sorcerer for several hours while the sorcerer performs a rite meant to slip away from pursuers for good.

rites.name: Leontaria
rites.text: A healing rite that renews a person's core vigor when cast. It can only be invoked at specific hallowed sites set aside for devotion.

rites.name: Narnaules
rites.text: A mid-level restorative rite in which the caster lays a hand upon another and siphons a measure of their skill in bulwark-craft for a brief span. The borrowed skill fades after a few heartbeats.

rites.name: Leostus
rites.text: A masterful ritual of restorative magic that draws a portion of another being's stealth into the caster's own body through a single touch. The borrowed quietness fades after a short while.

rites.name: Vantaunor
rites.text: A restorative rite that mends a warrior's combat abilities back to full strength. It can only be invoked at a sacred shrine dedicated to the three holy powers.

rites.name: Mantanum
rites.text: A mystic working that briefly draws the inner reserve of a foe into the caster's own store. The drawn essence flows back once the working fades.

rites.name: Lestanum Seralium
rites.text: A trained gift of sensing danger that lets its bearer slip past blows from fists, blades, and arrows. It offers no shelter against spells.

rites.name: Valenus
rites.text: A ritual power that lets a caster call forth the spirit of a dead forebear to stand as a protector. It is a central practice of a people who honor both their ancestors and distant powers beyond the world.

rites.name: Nantes
rites.text: A ward-craft held by a robed keeper of the temple, weaving layered charms that turn aside both spells and blows. It guards its bearer against harm from magic and steel alike.

rites.name: Tornes
rites.text: A dangerous technique in which a wielder of a heavy hammer surges forward in a rush of ill-omened force. It is drawn from a cursed weapon and is used in combat.

rites.name: Oresium
rites.text: A temporary craft that siphons a share of a target's nimbleness into the practitioner, letting the caster surpass their usual limit until the working fades and both return to their former state. A distance-casting form also exists.

rites.name: Nonteolium
rites.text: A quiet, steady discipline of the archer's craft that is awakened once a bowman reaches the tenth tier of training. It sharpens aim without any effort on the practitioner's part.

rites.name: Amauntium
rites.text: A mid-level ritual craft that draws a portion of skill from a touched being and binds it to the caster for a short span. The borrowed skill fades after a few moments.

rites.name: Valeosialus
rites.text: A minor healing-craft practiced by novice casters that draws a bodily discipline out of a foe and binds it to the caster. It belongs to the restorative arts taught in the early temple schools.

rites.name: Amontor
rites.text: A harmful incantation that a caster speaks to strike a foe with venom. It draws on the craft of ruinous magic to injure a target through poison.

rites.name: Telostia
rites.text: A masterful shaping of protective magic that thickens a caster's defenses against harm. Its warding endures for a minute once the incantation is completed.

rites.name: Sausanum
rites.text: A temple craft that draws a share of a foe's sharp reasoning into the practitioner for a short while, letting the caster surpass their usual limit. When the working fades, both minds settle back to their former measure. A distant variant siphons nimbleness of limb instead.

rites.name: Teleorum
rites.text: A novice ritual that draws a fixed portion of a foe's inner arcane knowledge into the caster's hand through a single touch. The borrowed insight fades after a short span.

rites.name: Telirontes
rites.text: A novice-level binding craft in which a practitioner touches another being and draws away a portion of their unarmed combat mastery for a brief span. The stolen skill fades back after a short interval.

rites.name: Telenus
rites.text: A sorcerous craft that siphons the inner reserve of a foe into the caster for a short time. The stolen reserve flows back to its owner when the working fades.

rites.name: Meonanum
rites.text: A masterful ritual craft that draws a portion of another's combat mastery into the caster's own hands with a single touch. The borrowed skill fades after a short span.

rites.name: Ceoronanum
rites.text: A mystic craft that draws part of a foe's bodily might into the practitioner's own limbs. A distant form of the same working lets the caster drain strength across open space.

rites.name: Nianillus
rites.text: A minor ritual of the mending hand that draws a measure of nimbleness from another body into the caster's own for a short span. The effect fades after a brief moment.

rites.name: Sauntes
rites.text: A bearer of old blood can wrap themselves in a burning shroud for a short span. Anyone who draws too near is scorched by steady flame.

rites.name: Corauntium
rites.text: A small glowing orb that a sorcerer calls forth from nothing. Its bearer can mend his own wounds with it or hurl it at a foe to wound them.

rites.name: Sasternia
rites.text: A mid-level restoring rite that lets a caster draw a portion of another's summoning craft into themselves through a single touch. The borrowed skill fades after a short span.

rites.name: Orantium
rites.text: A mystic art that draws a share of a foe's vitality, will, or skill into the caster's own body. The drained gains never exceed the caster's natural limits, and the drawing works only at arm's reach.

rites.name: Leornium
rites.text: A restorative radiance that a caster can call upon to renew all of their own vitality and attributes. It is considered unique among the healing arts of its order.

rites.name: Sialium
rites.text: A novice-level binding craft that draws a portion of an opponent's skill in light protective gear into the caster's own hands for a brief span. The transfer begins upon a single touch.

rites.name: Oralauntum
rites.text: A soft charm that a beginner learns to turn a listener's mood toward the caster for half a minute. It is one of the simplest enchantments taught to young illusionists.

rites.name: Telintum
rites.text: A restorative rite that renews a scholar's learned arts to full strength. It can only be invoked at a consecrated sanctuary of a divine triad.

rites.name: Ceornanum
rites.text: A temporary craft that draws a portion of an opponent's inner strength into the practitioner for a short span. The stolen measure is given back once the working ends, and the caster may briefly surpass their normal limit.

rites.name: Seres
rites.text: A mystic craft that siphons some of a target's hardiness into the caster's own body. A distant form of the same working draws the strength across from afar for the same duration.

rites.name: Ameornor
rites.text: A ward of corrosive sorcery that spreads around its caster and burns any foe who steps within its reach. The working uses a tainted venom drawn from the elements and never fails to take hold.

rites.name: Rinanum
rites.text: A temporary sacred rite that brings a bolstering favor upon its caster, lifting their fortune for a span before it fades and their fortune returns to its former measure.

rites.name: Nostenia
rites.text: A ritual craft taught by a wandering mentor that channels heat through a bound ember. Practitioners seek out three ancient forge-engines and seal a cracked stone of spirit into each before invoking the flow.

rites.name: Teolastium
rites.text: A restorative craft that briefly sharpens a bearer's natural agility without armor. When the working fades, the agility returns to its former measure.

rites.name: Laules
rites.text: A restorative rite that briefly sharpens a person's talent for guarding what is valued. When the rite fades, that talent returns to the level it held before.

rites.name: Serellosia
rites.text: A silent strike technique practiced by night-bound stalkers, unlocked once a trainee reaches the first rank of the lethal arts. It belongs to the cutting discipline of the shadow orders.

rites.name: Tones
rites.text: A practiced archer's technique that lets the bowman loose a fan of several shafts at once. It is learned after the bowman reaches a set level of skill with the longbow.

rites.name: Reostia Viasontor
rites.text: A innate bodily defense held by certain scaled folk that steadies the body against toxins and sickness. It hardens the flesh so that venom and contagion find less purchase.

rites.name: Corelloria
rites.text: A temporary blessing that sharpens a bearer's hand with spears, lifting their skill for a short while. When the blessing fades, their former mastery returns.

rites.name: Nontor
rites.text: A destructive working that drains an enemy's vitality, while the caster absorbs a wasting sickness as the cost of the ritual.

rites.name: Ciaranum
rites.text: A restorative craft that briefly sharpens a bearer's skill with small blades. The gained skill fades once the working ends, and its strength is set by how much skill is added.

rites.name: Orianaurnus
rites.text: A temporary healing-craft that briefly sharpens a bargainer's knack for trade. When it fades, the trader's haggling skill returns to its former level, and the strength of the boost sets how much it rises.

rites.name: Niarinus
rites.text: A mid-level transformation craft that hardens a caster's aura into a grey crust, holding a foe's body still much as a binding freeze would.

rites.name: Coresia Teleontor
rites.text: A destructive incantation that saps an opponent's stamina while burdening the caster with a creeping wasting sickness.

rites.name: Valentanum
rites.text: A dark gray plume that a fighter of the Stonehearth discipline can call forth to smother a battlefield. It belongs to the Ember Rite, a set of combat arts passed down among its ranks.

rites.name: Colleonum
rites.text: A ritual craft that temporarily weakens a target's vitality, which returns to its former strength once the rite is finished.

rites.name: Caulanum
rites.text: A restorative incantation that briefly sharpens a warrior's grip on the axe. When the working fades, the practitioner's skill returns to its former measure.

rites.name: Cialium
rites.text: A dark craft that drains an opponent's inner reserve of arcane power. The caster pays for it by carrying a wasting sickness in their own body.

rites.name: Sanaullum
rites.text: A wasting sickness spreads through hollow bodies and seeps into those who fight them. It drains the victim's inner arcane reserve and leaves them weakened against spells, and ordinary warding does nothing against it.

rites.name: Valistanum Telentes
rites.text: Faint spectral remnants of a long-dead warrior-founder linger beyond death, drawing on an ancient binding craft. They keep guiding the living world from the far side of the grave.

rites.name: Orastia Rausteria
rites.text: A shadowy craft in which a practitioner of the dark arts channels fear into a single, precise strike. It belongs to a line of stealthy arts practiced by night-walking assassins.

rites.name: Leoniantia
rites.text: A passive art practiced by sorcerers within a storm-summoning discipline. It quietly boosts the force of the caster's other gifts without being called upon.

rites.name: Coronanum
rites.text: This craft governs how swiftly a body can dart across land or glide through water, and how long it can push onward before weariness sets in. Practice in open water sharpens it faster than running does.

rites.name: Mestonum
rites.text: A sustained ward that briefly hardens a wearer's skill in bulky plate, lending extra mastery while it holds. Once the ward fades, the wearer's skill settles back to its former level.

rites.name: Telistor
rites.text: A restorative rite that briefly sharpens a smith's working knowledge of armor and forging. When the rite fades, the smith's skill returns to its former level, and the strength of the gain sets how much is added.

rites.name: Amiastanus
rites.text: A restorative incantation that briefly sharpens a practitioner's grasp of potion-making. When the enchantment fades, the craft returns to its former strength.

rites.name: Leostaures
rites.text: A temporary charm that briefly sharpens a caster's mind for summoning arts. When it fades, the enhanced skill returns to its former level.

rites.name: Meosia Raullintium
rites.text: A temporary blessing that sharpens a bearer's bare-knuckle combat ability by a set amount. The gained skill fades away once the blessing's duration runs out.

rites.name: Naurnium
rites.text: A innate knack of the marsh-folk that quickens their gliding through water and sharpens their learning of healing rites. It is granted to every member of their kind from birth.

rites.name: Sisentia
rites.text: A healing craft that briefly sharpens a practitioner's gift for mending. When the working fades, the gift settles back to its former strength.

rites.name: Orinelum
rites.text: A healing craft that briefly sharpens a practitioner's grasp of glamour and deception. When the working fades, that grasp slips back to its former level, with the gain matching the strength of the rite.

rites.name: Viasarnor
rites.text: A healing-craft ritual that briefly sharpens a practitioner's grasp of shaping matter. The sharpened gain fades once the rite ends, and its strength equals the size of that gain.

rites.name: Nauntor
rites.text: A temporary rite of healing-craft that sharpens a warrior's grip on the sword for a short span. When the rite fades, the warrior's skill returns to its former measure, and the strength of the blessing sets how much it was raised.

rites.name: Telores
rites.text: A restorative craft that briefly sharpens a wielder's aim with ranged weapons. When the working fades, the steadier skill returns to its former level.

rites.name: Sirnum
rites.text: A high-level scroll of the Shaping arts that lets its reader breathe beneath the water for two minutes after it is read aloud.

rites.name: Teleosolor
rites.text: A healing-craft rite that briefly sharpens a traveler's running and leaping ability. When the rite fades, the body's natural swiftness returns to its former measure.

rites.name: Valeostum
rites.text: A restorative rite that briefly sharpens a wearer's skill with light protective garments. Once the rite ends, the skill settles back to its former level, and the strength of the lift is set by the rite's measure.

rites.name: Oreonum
rites.text: A restorative rite that briefly sharpens a person's talent for moving unseen. When the rite fades, the talent returns to its former strength, and the strength of the boost is set by the rite itself.

rites.name: Oraunteoles
rites.text: A temporary blessing that raises a person's charm for a short while, after which their presence settles back to its former strength. It can only be called forth at a sacred hearth kept by devoted keepers.

rites.name: Causiantia
rites.text: A great power wells up from a sacred stone and flows into the one who bears it. It draws on hidden reserves of arcane force.

rites.name: Morallor
rites.text: A restorative working that briefly sharpens a defender's ability to turn aside blows. Once its duration passes, the defender's guard returns to its earlier strength.

rites.name: Centaustus
rites.text: A restorative rite that temporarily sharpens a bearer's skill with bludgeoning arms. The skill settles back to its former level once the rite ends, and the strength of the gain is set by the rite's measure.

rites.name: Soria
rites.text: A ritual working that briefly sharpens a caster's talent for ruinous force. Once its duration passes, the talent drops back to its former level.

rites.name: Ameostianus
rites.text: A wolf-spirit power that dwells in a hidden cavern and must be overcome to restore a sacred patron's favor to a circle of seers.

rites.name: Ciallornor
rites.text: A distant healing rite that draws away a creeping rot from a chosen afflicted soul. It is wielded by a sage of a scholarly lodge of mages.

rites.name: Cillia Liastanum
rites.text: A restorative craft that briefly sharpens a traveler's natural nimbleness and balance. When the effect fades, their agility returns to its former level.

rites.name: Maurnus Tantes
rites.text: A quiet, always-active technique of close combat that a warrior trained with a great blade or axe can draw upon without effort. It belongs to a teaching tradition of heavy weapon mastery.

rites.name: Tialia
rites.text: A passive discipline taught within the shield-and-blade training tradition, allowing a warrior to move freely across a contested field. It belongs to the one-handed arms school.

rites.name: Tenaulum
rites.text: A masterful sacred working that a healer may learn through a ritual lesson given at a scholarly hall. It turns its power against the restless dead.

rites.name: Lirnolor
rites.text: A minor sacred gift given to those marked at birth by a ritual sign. For a short while it heightens the ability to drive restless dead away from its bearer's chosen target, and no muting can stifle it.

rites.name: Nania
rites.text: A passive discipline carried by warriors of a stone-hewn martial order, letting their war cries steady allies and unsettle foes in the thick of battle.

rites.name: Ceres
rites.text: A second trial in a long campaign where a seeker learns a word of power that drains life from foes. A hooded, enigmatic woman first meets the seeker during this trial.

rites.name: Vauntium
rites.text: A quiet discipline by which a wielder works against harmful beings, sending them away from the guild's lands. It is practiced as a steady, ever-present craft rather than a single act.

rites.name: Seostanum
rites.text: A mystic working that reveals every spirit-animated being, enchanted object, and key nearby. Each one appears as a marked symbol on the map.

rites.name: Cilles
rites.text: A restorative craft that mends the wounds of the one who performs it. Practitioners channel calm energy inward to heal themselves.

rites.name: Lianesum
rites.text: A ritual working that unleashes harm on every foe gathered within a set ring around its caster. It is the only such working that strikes an entire region instead of a single chosen mark.

rites.name: Coreostanum
rites.text: A discipline of close fighting that governs how skillfully a warrior handles edged weapons. Practice with such blades steadily sharpens this craft, and it is valued across many paths because bladed arms are widespread and effective at short range.

rites.name: Amisanum
rites.text: A passive discipline practiced by sacred spear-bearers of the order, granting steady balance in combat. It forms part of a sworn martial tradition.

rites.name: Caullirum
rites.text: A gentle healing craft taught to young initiates, it wraps a traveler in soothing light. It is among the first mending arts a novice learns.

rites.name: Valaranum Calleores
rites.text: A restorative rite that mends the body a little at a time, each moment of its working binding the caster's frayed strength back together. It lasts for a set span before fading away.

rites.name: Coraulasium
rites.text: A high-order transmutation craft that lightens the practitioner's load, letting them carry far more weight for a short span of time.

rites.name: Orostes
rites.text: A minor power that lances out as a shard of biting cold. It is wielded by frost-born constructs of ice and storm.

rites.name: Teleontes Seosiranum
rites.text: A mid-level battle incantation that hurls a shard of crimson-tinged ice at an enemy, striking with a burst of freezing harm on impact.

rites.name: Amiania
rites.text: A quiet enchantment woven into certain enchanted garments. It is applied to clothing to lend the wearer a sneaky, unseen edge.

rites.name: Telliria
rites.text: A beginner's mystic working that grants its caster a brief flash of hidden understanding. It is one of the lesser incantations gathered into a bound tome of spells.

rites.name: Corontanum Leorium
rites.text: A minor gift of memory that lets its bearer recall shared songs and tales, and it can be drawn upon again and again without tiring the mind.

rites.name: Lones
rites.text: A mid-level incantation of destructive flame that hurls a burning shaft at a foe. On striking, it scorches the target for a fixed heat wound.

rites.name: Valentor Mornanum
rites.text: A grave, advanced enchantment of deceiving the senses that chills a foe with numbing cold and locks their limbs in place for a brief moment.

rites.name: Mirnium Reornium
rites.text: A gentle healing craft that knits the caster's own wounds closed. It draws on restorative will rather than tools or herbs.

rites.name: Oralernia
rites.text: A woodland folk's innate craft that lets its wielder bend a beast's will, compelling it to fight alongside them for a short span. It draws on the mind's cunning rather than raw strength.

rites.name: Losteosia
rites.text: A fury-born gift of the mind that a warlike folk can call upon at will. It is a discipline of inner resolve that is shaped and governed by sheer force of will.

rites.name: Maulor Sillus
rites.text: A passive technique that a wielder of a heavy two-handed blade learns in the martial line of two-handed fighting. It steadies the weapon's weight so the striker keeps control.

rites.name: Ceoses
rites.text: A rare battle craft that unleashes searing flame in a way that strikes several foes at once. Its user channels heat through the air to burn a whole group of enemies together.

rites.name: Coresonus
rites.text: A passive art taught within the support discipline of a hall of healers. Once a practitioner reaches the eighth rank of that discipline, the art becomes available for use in clan wars.

rites.name: Miantesum
rites.text: A restorative healing craft that mends the wounds of whoever chants it. The practitioner draws strength back into their own body through the words.

rites.name: Valum
rites.text: A dark ritual craft in which a caster draws life from a victim, wearing down the victim's vitality. It belongs to the arts of harmful magic.

rites.name: Tantes Miallires
rites.text: A restorative working that stirs a bearer's fighting spirit, sharpening the chance that each strike or blow lands true in combat.

rites.name: Canes Tenus
rites.text: A spell-craft of the robed casters that lets a practitioner ride a discharge of crackling force to slip free of danger. It belongs to the storm-summoning discipline.

rites.name: Vintiastus
rites.text: A mending-and-striking craft that a caster can invoke to bring both healing and harm. It is cast from a single learned formula.

rites.name: Vollum
rites.text: A restorative craft that hardens a bearer against the spreading sickness of corruption. It strengthens the body's resistance to rot carried on the air or in the flesh.

rites.name: Vollus
rites.text: A dusk-dwelling sanctum grants a devout petitioner a silence that dims their presence for a full night. The hush lasts eight hours and sharpens the bearer's stealth.

rites.name: Valirium
rites.text: A dark working that siphons away a foe's inner resolve. The victim's spirit weakens as the caster draws it out.

rites.name: Reosantes
rites.text: A grand rite that drives every being standing near its caster into a frenzy, compelling them to strike at any creature close by for half a minute.

rites.name: Amenium
rites.text: A passive craft that lies within a shapeshifter's discipline and takes effect only after the wearer invokes a full beast-form rite, which passes the savage curse onward.

rites.name: Amistor
rites.text: A sacred practice drawn from a staff tradition that calls on a guardian force to shield a bearer from harm. It is performed as a deliberate act of skill.

rites.name: Tianeollium
rites.text: A dark craft drawn from a practitioner's own life essence. Those who master it trade their vitality for an enduring, quiet power carried within them.

rites.name: Mollauntes
rites.text: A consecrating gesture that drives restless dead creatures away from a fight. Those touched by it abandon their attack and flee.

rites.name: Mernus Corenum
rites.text: A high-skill mystic working that senses every living creature near the caster for a short span. It reveals their presence to the one who wields it.

rites.name: Rantanum
rites.text: A restorative rite that draws mending light into a wounded body. Its practitioners channel the blessing through a kneeling posture and a quiet recitation.

rites.name: Minor Amiallia
rites.text: A measure of how well a guarded implement turns aside strikes. It softens the force of blows and lessens harm from elemental forces, though far less against the latter.

rites.name: Vollaustum
rites.text: A minor illusory craft taught at the lowest rank of arcane study. It lets a caster vanish from one spot and reappear in another in a blink of light.

rites.name: Sarnia
rites.text: A powerful rite that strips the will to strike from every creature standing close around its caster for a short span. Those under its hush lower their weapons and cannot bring themselves to attack foes nearby.

rites.name: Laurnes
rites.text: A restorative rite that a caster performs to draw gentle healing into the body. Its wording is passed down among devout keepers who recite it before ordeals.

rites.name: Seralestum
rites.text: A bound-spirit craft that briefly summons a pair of footwear onto the caster's feet. The conjured boots fade after one minute.

rites.name: Sianes
rites.text: A ritual craft taught to hardened warriors, drawn from a faction's disciplined skill line. Each further level of mastery lengthens how long its effect endures.

rites.name: Orostium Coranus
rites.text: A ritual craft method shaped by sacred burning resin, passed on through a written teaching sheet. Practitioners learn its patterns by studying a single numbered instruction scroll.

rites.name: Torum Rauseonium
rites.text: A restorative rite in which a caster draws life-essence from their own veins to lend strength to another being. The boost of vitality fades after a short while.

rites.name: Tiastellum
rites.text: A restorative rite of the healing arts, drawn from the healing craft and cast to mend wounds and ease ailments. Its practitioners call upon a quiet, sheltering power.

rites.name: Masolles
rites.text: A quick, low-cost ward that lets a caster shrug off biting cold. It can only be learned after mastering a sharper ice technique, and it is invoked at once.

rites.name: Cenum
rites.text: A learned practice that lets a person take nourishment from the bodies of the fallen. It is cultivated as a quiet skill among certain wandering orders.

rites.name: Lelus Amenirnia
rites.text: A grave-craft discipline whose practitioners raise sturdy, bone-armored defenders to absorb blows meant for their allies. It was taught later, as an addition to the older arts of the dead.

rites.name: Amilles
rites.text: A subtle enchantment that turns the gaze of onlookers away from a chosen wielder of the craft. It hides that person's presence from anyone who looks upon them.

rites.name: Losestium
rites.text: A restorative discipline practiced by sacred warriors who draw on a guiding radiance to mend the wounded. It is cultivated as part of a dedicated line of healing arts.

rites.name: Melus
rites.text: A quiet inherited gift that lets kin of a shapeshifting clan sense one another's presence. It works without effort and belongs to the wild-blooded lineage's craft of moon-borne instincts.

rites.name: Ceolles Seraurneles
rites.text: A tactic of sorcerers who call a binding force to wrap their body in an unseen protective shell. The shell is drawn from a summoned pact and belongs to a school of conjured arts.

rites.name: Oreosollium
rites.text: A forbidden incantation that cannot be taken up by the chosen champion of the realm. It lies hidden within a remote, sealed mountain fortress known only to few.

rites.name: Malentium
rites.text: A destructive craft that lets a caster channel searing flame into a target's body, dealing fire harm to whoever is touched.

rites.name: Nisaunum
rites.text: A quieting charm that briefly dulls a beast's urge to lash out, with its strength set by how far that urge is lowered. Once it fades, the creature's temper returns, and thinking beings, the restless dead, otherworldly fiends, and enchanted relics remain untouched.

rites.name: Sonialor
rites.text: A temple-taught working that tears down the warding of a caster's defenses. It runs opposite to an art that bolsters those same wards.

rites.name: Telesus Telanus
rites.text: A caster can summon a conjured blade of shadow-forged steel from nothing. This is a basic, apprentice-level working of summoning magic.

rites.name: Teosum Veontines
rites.text: A soothing working of illusion that briefly dulls the aggression of a thinking, two-legged mind. Beasts, restless dead, otherworldly beings, and enchanted objects remain unaffected by its gentle hold.

rites.name: Canilanum
rites.text: A soothing mental working that dampens the urge to strike for a brief span of time. It only sways minds below a set strength, and tireless dead or otherworldly beings resist it unless one has mastered deeper mental arts.

rites.name: Teleranum
rites.text: A passive craft of spellcasters who harness storm energy, letting a caster gather and hold lightning within their body. It belongs to a branch of the tempest arts.

rites.name: Tostiasia
rites.text: A conjured shaft of pale glimmering force that appears with a summoned bow. It vanishes the moment the bow is put away and cannot be used with any other weapon.

rites.name: Cialium Coroneorum
rites.text: A calling of the hand that lets a caster unleash searing flame to harm a foe. It belongs to the school of destructive craft and is wielded as a power.

rites.name: Salles
rites.text: A ritual scroll of summoning that calls forth a spectral blade-like weapon for a brief span of twenty seconds when its inscribed words are spoken. It is taught to novice practitioners of the conjuring arts.

rites.name: Oreollum Ciantanum
rites.text: A light, conjured lance that a summoned lesser spirit is bound into. It appears in the wielder's hands, pushing aside the weapon held before, and vanishes when its magic fades, restoring the old weapon.

rites.name: Restiania
rites.text: A borrowed craft that calls a lesser spirit into a heavy iron cudgel gripped automatically in the caster's hand. The caster's former weapon is set aside and returns once the working fades.

rites.name: Valaustaror
rites.text: A passive gift of the sacred order's spear-wielders that kindles a steady inner flame. The flame quietly strengthens the bearer whenever they fight without rest.

rites.name: Niria Telirnum
rites.text: A devotional blessing that a worshipper invokes while praying at a sacred waypoint of the faith. The one who prays is granted the blessing as a gift of the divine.

rites.name: Ameosum
rites.text: A binding craft that calls forth a spectral war-blade into the caster's grip for a short span. It is taught to novices who study the summoning arts.

rites.name: Amollia
rites.text: A transformation craft that briefly makes a target's belongings grow heavier, draining their stamina faster. The added heft fades away once the working ends.

rites.name: Viastenes
rites.text: A temporary curse that adds unseen weight to a target's load, draining their stamina faster until the weight lifts. It can come from a incantation, a draught, or a charged strike.

rites.name: Riarnanum Siasor
rites.text: A temporary charm that softens a thinking creature's urge to strike out, its strength setting how far that urge is lowered. Once it fades, the creature's temper returns, and beasts, the restless dead, and otherworldly beings remain unmoved.

rites.name: Listes Coraunolor
rites.text: A protective craft drawn from the dead that a fighter learns after mastering the second tier of a warrior's discipline. It lets the user raise a barrier shaped from ossified remains.

rites.name: Amaustanum
rites.text: A minor binding craft taught to novice casters, it draws unseen force to close around a foe's throat. It was gathered into the lesser arts of the scroll-keepers.

rites.name: Coraurnanum Oreosus
rites.text: A quiet rite of mending that briefly raises a bearer's sense of presence and charm. The enhancement fades after a while, and the bearer's natural temperament returns to what it was before.

rites.name: Narnus Menus
rites.text: A ritual incantation that calls forth a timeworn undead cleric of the grave. The caster draws the ancient servant from its resting place to fight at their side.

rites.name: Tiasilor
rites.text: A mending craft taught in the temples of healers that drains a portion of another creature's vitality through a single touch. The caster gains the drained life for their own use.

rites.name: Sellasia
rites.text: A high-ranked summoning rite calls forth a towering otherworldly warrior to battle for its caster. The bound fighter resists banishment and mind control, making it a dependable companion against enemy sorcerers.

rites.name: Corentor
rites.text: An unused high-tier conjuring rite that summons a draconic guardian. It was never put into practice, so it remains a dormant art of the mystic orders.

rites.name: Sausium
rites.text: A craft of drawing beings from distant realms and forging objects from raw inner power. Practitioners link their minds to the summoned, lure and bind them, then send them away again.

rites.name: Ciasor
rites.text: A ritual craft of calling forth a shambling corpse-servant from the dead. Practitioners speak a summons and a single risen husk answers to their will.

rites.name: Ralanum
rites.text: A dark practice drawn from shadow lore that lets a shadowy adept draw in and devour the surrounding gloom. It sits among the highest arts of the order's shadow craft.

rites.name: Laustornes
rites.text: A restorative gift that shields the bearer from ordinary sicknesses. It is a lasting trait tied to healing arts, granting unbroken resistance to everyday illness.

rites.name: Caunteolium
rites.text: A ritual binding of practitioners who call forth a shielded war-spirit to fight alongside them for a brief span. The bound spirit dissolves once its time runs out.

rites.name: Coreosium Oresanum
rites.text: A summoning rite that calls forth a restless spirit bound to serve the caster. The spirit cannot be put to rest once conjured.

rites.name: Orentes
rites.text: A passive discipline that lets a fighter keep striking without pause once they reach a set level of martial training. It belongs to a battle-craft tradition practiced in wars between allied hosts.

rites.name: Viantoranum
rites.text: A ritual incantation that calls forth a restless hollow phantom bound by a sorrowful hex. The rite draws the wraith into the caster's service.

rites.name: Orallus
rites.text: A quiet enchantment cast by hand that briefly warms a listener's regard toward the caster. Its effect slowly fades once the moment passes.

rites.name: Telanaulus
rites.text: A ritual craft that calls forth a restless shade bound to serve the caster. The rite is drawn from a dark book of grave-lore.

rites.name: Orilus
rites.text: A binding craft that makes a wild creature turn and fight on behalf of its summoner. Once the bond fades, the beast drops back into its natural ways.

rites.name: Telastium
rites.text: A bewildering ritual craft in which a wandering deity teaches a chosen seeker how to wield a cursed heavy blade. The lesson unfolds near one of three frontier gates, and the gate chosen depends on the seeker's allegiance.

rites.name: Telirnanum
rites.text: A sacred rite practiced by order-bound devotees who draw on restorative radiance to purify the fallen. It belongs to a disciplined branch of hallowed craft.

rites.name: Mestum
rites.text: A passive discipline taught to warrior-knights, it lets the bearer's inner fire feed upon itself. It was once known by a humbler name before it was refined.

rites.name: Teleorus Sonteles
rites.text: A binding craft where the practitioner briefly seizes the will of a human-shaped being, steering its body for a short span. It is studied among conjurers as a discipline of summoned and bound force.

rites.name: Causintes
rites.text: A healing craft taught to adepts of the restoring arts. It is cast by a practitioner to seal torn flesh and bring a wounded body back toward health.

rites.name: Oreoloranum
rites.text: A ritual craft that lets a caster seed an illness in a foe. It succeeds with a modest chance that grows as the caster becomes more practiced.

rites.name: Naustus
rites.text: A minor summoning craft in which the caster calls forth a grey, ash-formed servant from the dust of the ground. The spell is learned at a middling level of skill.

rites.name: Siasor Valausum
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that strengthens the body's vitality over time. It works constantly in the background, requiring no active effort from the practitioner.

rites.name: Valirnes
rites.text: A mind-binding craft of the illusion arts that bends a chosen being to the caster's will, turning rivals into loyal followers. Its strength depends on the caster's skill, so only lesser minds can be bent, and it can also guide willing companions toward a set destination.

rites.name: Tasus
rites.text: A ritual incantation that calls forth a rotting corpse-thrall to serve the caster. The working belongs to a conjurer's craft built around raising the dead.

rites.name: Oraullus
rites.text: A mid-tier summoning craft that lets a practitioner call forth a conjured helper. It is taught to those who have reached a skilled rank in the art of calling.

rites.name: Amornaulia
rites.text: A gentle healing craft taught to novices that slowly mends a chosen person's wounds, restoring fifteen points of their vitality.

rites.name: Amestirnium
rites.text: A timed craft that lets its wielder partly merge with the background around them. The wearer can still touch and handle nearby things while it lasts, and its strength can be tuned up to total concealment.

rites.name: Coronteorum
rites.text: A summoning incantation that calls forth a bone-bound caster from the grave. It belongs to a sealed collection of death-craft scrolls.

rites.name: Taunium
rites.text: A small burning spirit summoned by a caster's will. It races toward foes and bursts into flame upon reaching them, like a seeking ember.

rites.name: Serisor
rites.text: A quiet enchantment that briefly softens how a listener regards the caster. It works only on the one who is targeted and fades after a short while.

rites.name: Amiseontium
rites.text: A ritual craft that calls forth a shrouded fog-born servant to fight beside its caster. The servant lingers for a single minute before dissolving back into the vapor.

rites.name: Oriranum Amiallium
rites.text: A high-level summoning craft that places powerful conjured beings under the will of the one who casts it. The bound creatures obey the caster's commands.

rites.name: Telaurneles
rites.text: A binding craft that holds a person's will for a short while, forcing them to fight beside the one who cast it. Once the working fades, the bound figure returns to their own ways.

rites.name: Seraunium
rites.text: A binding incantation that calls forth a sickly risen corpse to serve the caster. The rite draws a diseased shambler from the grave's edge and bends it to obey.

rites.name: Sereonium
rites.text: A temporary healing craft that briefly quickens the bearer's pace. It belongs to the restorative arts and is practised by those who mend the body.

rites.name: Serireosia
rites.text: A chant that calls forth a bound creature of living ice for a short while. When the creature is destroyed it bursts into a freezing blast that harms everyone nearby, the caster included, but it fades quietly if its time runs out first.

rites.name: Reonium Viarus
rites.text: A crackling bolt of storm-power that leaps from its first strike to nearby surfaces and creatures, striking foes hidden behind cover. Allies standing too close to the impact may be caught in its arc.

rites.name: Corires Telorauntus
rites.text: A summoning rite that calls forth a withered ancient priest from the old ruins. The caller binds the revenant to fight at their side.

rites.name: Coreolasum
rites.text: A veil of illusory craft that hides its bearer from watching eyes. The veil tears away the moment the bearer strikes, calls out, or touches a mechanism.

rites.name: Sales
rites.text: A practitioner of the summoning craft calls forth a protective barrier of bound otherworldly forces. It is one of the active techniques taught within a line of conjured arts.

rites.name: Tilles
rites.text: A hex-craft that briefly saps a target's nimbleness, so their limbs turn sluggish. The loss fades on its own once the working ends and the target's quickness returns.

rites.name: Amoriastium
rites.text: A battle-born passive that a warrior of the Assault discipline gains once their training reaches a high rank. It keeps them fighting fiercely in the heat of conflict.

rites.name: Telarnolum
rites.text: A withering craft that temporarily dulls a target's nimbleness. The target's quickness slowly returns to its former level once the working fades.

rites.name: Sausarnor
rites.text: A protective craft that lessens harm from edged blows. It is inscribed as an enchantment and weakens the force of cutting strikes.

rites.name: Oriarnes Telaurnum
rites.text: A restorative working that wraps its caster in a warm shimmer, lending them a stronger presence and more magnetic bearing. The effect settles directly onto the one who invokes it.

rites.name: Tontia
rites.text: A lasting blessing that a wanderer gains in the first stage of a creeping night-sickness, marking them as a dark protector of the shadows.

rites.name: Leornanum Tirelor
rites.text: A summoning rite that calls forth a tomb watcher to stand guard. It is drawn from a collection of dark-craft texts.

rites.name: Amiliares
rites.text: A hostile incantation that temporarily weakens a target's vitality. The victim's strength is restored once the working fades.

rites.name: Rialerium
rites.text: A trial in which a bearer wears heavy protective gear in a celestial manner. Its garments are found within an ancient archive and are known as enduring wards.

rites.name: Serintium Nastia
rites.text: A restorative working that briefly strengthens a bearer's inner resolve. When its duration fades, the bearer's resolve settles back to its former level.

rites.name: Tornum
rites.text: A shadowy craft in which a caster trades one of their own lifeforces for a sudden surge of dark power. It belongs to a lineage of black arts practiced by sorcerers.

rites.name: Testiles
rites.text: A restorative working of the healing discipline that draws on inner resolve to purge a wasting sickness from the body. It demands a heavy reserve of arcane energy to cast.

rites.name: Meniarium
rites.text: A withering hex that temporarily saps a victim's physical might. The lost vigor returns to its former level once the working fades.

rites.name: Lernus Virnus
rites.text: A restorative craft from the healing discipline of spirit-working, drawn from inner resolve, that frees a body from its locked stillness. Its casting draws steadily on the caster's reserve of inner power.

rites.name: Ceoria
rites.text: A temporary healing-craft that sharpens a person's nimbleness and quickness of limb. When its hold fades, the body's natural nimbleness returns to what it was before.

rites.name: Varor Sontanum
rites.text: A rare arcane practice that wraps the caster in a crackling shell of lightning-born force. It blunts incoming lightning harm and sends a faint jolt into foes who draw close.

rites.name: Selor Amontium
rites.text: A craft of the arcane arts that is bound to inner resolve and draws on a reservoir of inner energy. Practitioners spend a modest measure of that energy to unleash harm.

rites.name: Oraunanum
rites.text: A mystic working that draws a portion of a foe's inner resolve into the caster. The rite hands the stolen steadiness over to whoever performs it.

rites.name: Rianesus
rites.text: A dark sorcerous working that a caster invokes as an active skill, drawn from a line of summoning craft. It binds a foe under a lingering hex.

rites.name: Telostor Amasum
rites.text: A hex that temporarily saps a target's nimbleness. Once its duration passes, the target's quickness returns to what it was before.

rites.name: Causorus
rites.text: A harmful incantation that siphons away an enemy's stamina. The weakened foe fights more poorly and struggles to escape.

rites.name: Vaullostes
rites.text: A dark art wielded by sorcerers that hurls a sharp fragment of crystal at a foe. It belongs to the dark magic tradition of the sorcerer's craft.

rites.name: Naneorum
rites.text: A dark working that channels venom into a foe, harming them over time. A ranged variant lets the caster project the same toxic force from a distance.

rites.name: Coraullium Valaurostia
rites.text: A temporary rite of inner grace that lifts a traveler's charm and presence for a while. When the rite fades, the bearer's native bearing returns to its former measure.

rites.name: Colernes
rites.text: A dimming charm that clouds a foe's sight so their strikes, whether blade or bare fist, tend to miss the mark.

rites.name: Cilus
rites.text: A minor destructive incantation taught to novice casters, which hurls a crumbling spark that eats away at whatever it strikes. It was recorded in a newer collection of scrolls added to the archive.

rites.name: Valiares Amiaseostia
rites.text: A reshaping craft that briefly makes a target bear extra heft, draining their stamina faster. The added heaviness vanishes once the working fades.

rites.name: Lianeolor
rites.text: A quiet, always-active discipline that is tied to the restorative staff tradition. It works in the background, keeping its bearer's vitality cycling back toward health.

rites.name: Orinellanum
rites.text: A beginner's inscribed charm of the destructive arts that, when activated, weakens a target's inner resolve by three points.

rites.name: Vesaullus
rites.text: A minor hex woven by a beginning caster that drains the stamina of whoever it touches. The sorcery is taught early to apprentices learning the harsher arts.

rites.name: Riastesanum
rites.text: A harmful incantation that temporarily weakens a target's stamina. The target's stamina slowly returns to its former level once the incantation fades.

rites.name: Seraunalum
rites.text: A temporary healing-craft that heightens a caster's reasoning and wit for a short span. When it fades, the mind returns to its former sharpness.

rites.name: Sernolia
rites.text: A temple craft that briefly swells a bearer's raw muscle and force. The enhancement fades when the working ends, leaving the body as it was before.

rites.name: Coreornasum
rites.text: A conjuring craft that calls forth a blade whose quality rises with the skill of the one who summons it. Stronger practitioners draw forth finer edges.

rites.name: Lornialia
rites.text: A harmful craft of the destructive arts, drawn from inner resolve and fed by a steady store of arcane energy. Each casting draws a modest toll from the caster's reserves.

rites.name: Nollausium
rites.text: A ranked craft of hurling corrupting force outward. It is taught in the higher circles of a scholarly sect and is considered advanced practice among its initiates.

rites.name: Liasium Telaleostus
rites.text: A practiced technique in which a wielder drives a heavy two-handed weapon forward with decisive force. It is taught among the disciplined fighting schools.

rites.name: Menus Niarnum
rites.text: A healing craft that draws out harmful toxins from a person through a simple touch. It purges the poison but does not mend the injuries the poison has already caused.

rites.name: Corenum Telisia
rites.text: A dark variant of a restorative art that a sorcerer may choose in place of an older exchange-based rite. It belongs to a school of shadowed craft and reshapes how the practitioner mends wounds.

rites.name: Nosteonia
rites.text: A harmful incantation that draws life away from a target, weakening the body of whoever it strikes. It belongs to the school of ruinous workings.

rites.name: Nauntor Teostia
rites.text: A hex-craft that temporarily slows a target's pace, so the afflicted moves sluggishly. The slowed quickness recovers to its former strength once the working fades.

rites.name: Mialor Cauntum
rites.text: A restorative art that lifts harmful afflictions from a person. It can be carried in spoken incantations, brewed draughts, or woven into charms.

rites.name: Ciasor Teolirum
rites.text: A malign affliction that saps a person's mind, resolve, charm, and fortune. If any of these reach nothing, the victim dies, though it rarely lasts long enough to kill outright.

rites.name: Serasanum
rites.text: A dark working that temporarily dulls a target's charm and inner character. The lost spark slowly returns to its original strength once the working fades.

rites.name: Rianeontus
rites.text: A withering craft that drains the stamina of anyone struck by an enchanted blade. Weakened foes strike with much less force once their reserves run low.

rites.name: Coreornalum
rites.text: A protective mark that is a variant of a binding sigil used by dark casters. It shields its wielder by sealing away harmful forces.

rites.name: Sestanum Valaustum
rites.text: A withering hex that drains a target's reasoning for a short span. Once it fades, the mind slowly returns to its former sharpness.

rites.name: Rasornus
rites.text: A ritual working that harms restless corpses and animated dead. It can be claimed as a reward for choosing it over a steel-limbed launcher during a grove-spirit trial.

rites.name: Mentus Velum
rites.text: A restorative working that briefly swells a traveler's reserve of endurance, letting them keep moving longer before weariness takes hold.

rites.name: Seriliastum
rites.text: A ritual craft by which practitioners call otherworldly beings from beyond the veil. Members of a scholars' brotherhood offer this calling as a service to a famed wanderer.

rites.name: Ronalus
rites.text: A shaping craft that briefly makes a target's load feel heavier, draining their strength faster. The added heaviness fades completely once the working ends.

rites.name: Nanum Mostor
rites.text: A ritual working of ruin that hurls searing flame and scorches several foes at once. It is practiced by those who wield the art of destruction.

rites.name: Corontor Ranistus
rites.text: A transforming craft that briefly loads a target with heavy unseen burden, draining their stamina quickly. The added weight vanishes when the working ends.

rites.name: Orosus
rites.text: A hostile working that briefly drains a target's fortune, lowering their luck until the effect fades and their original standing returns.

rites.name: Mantus Niallornium
rites.text: A restorative rite that purges the common sicknesses from a chosen body. It can be cast on any person afflicted by ordinary ailments.

rites.name: Rastosia
rites.text: A journeyman-level illusion craft that freezes a creature completely in place for a few seconds once the caster touches it.

rites.name: Tiallinium
rites.text: A temporary binding craft that swells a wanderer's vitality beyond its normal measure. When the working fades, the vitality slowly returns to its former level.

rites.name: Liarnanum Tirosia
rites.text: A practitioner of transformation draws a protective veil of arcane force around their whole body, which raises how well they resist harm.

rites.name: Santus Taunolia
rites.text: A restorative craft of the healing arts that draws out harmful toxins from the body. It is cast through inner resolve and requires a considerable reserve of magical energy.

rites.name: Tausontes
rites.text: A harmful incantation that saps an opponent's stores of mystic energy. It works by pulling the reserves of magic away from its target.

rites.name: Saurenor
rites.text: A restorative incantation that temporarily raises a bearer's stamina. The strength gained fades once the chant's effect runs out, leaving the body as it was before.

rites.name: Reoses
rites.text: A trained technique that lets a defender turn aside incoming projectiles with a raised guard. It is reached only after a practitioner has mastered the basics of blocking.

rites.name: Amelium Orolliasum
rites.text: A practitioner wraps the self in a ring of living flame that guards against burning and scorches any foe drawing close. The ward's heat slowly sears those nearby, a lesser fraction of its full strength.

rites.name: Corausinor
rites.text: A hollow cry of binding sorcery that tears at the restless dead. Its wail wounds corpses and the risen husks that walk without life.

rites.name: Silanum
rites.text: A minor inscribed scroll of the destructive arts that, once read aloud, dims a chosen foe's wits by a single degree. It is studied by apprentice spellcasters.

rites.name: Minarium
rites.text: A restorative craft that lifts a wasting sickness from the body. It draws on inner resolve and drains a considerable store of arcane energy to work.

rites.name: Amaurus Cialostor
rites.text: A hex that binds itself to a knight after he slays a wandering pauper. The bearer is marked by the act and carries its lingering burden.

rites.name: Tanum
rites.text: A temple-taught craft that lends a traveler swiftness for a short span. When the span ends, the body's quickness settles back to its former measure.

rites.name: Sirnus
rites.text: A hexing craft that temporarily weakens a target's inner resolve. The target's resolve returns to its former strength once the working fades.

rites.name: Nialleostia
rites.text: A restorative rite that draws away the common sicknesses from another person. It works on any ordinary ailment that afflicts the one it is cast upon.

rites.name: Varostanum
rites.text: A caster wraps themselves in a shield of icy force that resists cold harm and chills nearby foes. The shield's magnitude is a measure of its power.

rites.name: Mases Cornum
rites.text: A deadly final technique practiced by shadowy blade-wielders of an assassin's discipline. It is the ultimate strike drawn from the stealth-killing arts of the order.

rites.name: Reseontanum
rites.text: A quiet inborn knack for slipping coins from pockets without notice. It is possessed from the start by the wanderers of a certain desert folk.

rites.name: Oreornia Siles
rites.text: A ward-craft that is laid into a blade so it wears away a little of whatever it strikes. Each application carries a small measure of harm into the foe.

rites.name: Sausalum
rites.text: A ranged mind-craft that sends a jarring hum into a target's thoughts, scattering their focus and weakening their chance to shape magic for a short span.

rites.name: Valleosanum
rites.text: A restorative craft from the healing arts that is guided by inner resolve. Practitioners channel a modest reserve of spiritual energy to purge ordinary sicknesses from the body.

rites.name: Toneontus
rites.text: A practiced technique in a staff discipline that lets a wielder unleash ruin through a single contact. It belongs to a sequence of trained arts taught within one martial line.

rites.name: Raulus
rites.text: A dark incantation that briefly makes a foe far more vulnerable to toxins. The weakened target absorbs poison more easily for a short while.

rites.name: Coreones
rites.text: A glamour-craft that stirs dread in a beast's heart, raising its urge to break away from a fight. Its counter-craft steadies the same creature and steals that urge away.

rites.name: Telauria
rites.text: A blessing that a worshipper draws upon themselves while kneeling at a sacred waypoint dedicated to a gentle goddess of beauty and love.

rites.name: Valentarnia
rites.text: A masterful illusion craft that bends a thinking creature's will, compelling it to fight alongside its caster for a brief span of half a minute.

rites.name: Amellanor
rites.text: A withering craft that drains the living strength of whatever it touches. It stands in direct opposition to the force that restores vigor and life.

rites.name: Orintum Roranum
rites.text: A distant mind-craft that plants a jarring clamor inside a target's thoughts. It scatters their focus for a brief span, making their own workings harder to bring forth.

rites.name: Sernillum
rites.text: A temple-taught craft that lets its user sense every lock-opening token nearby, whether lying openly, held by a passerby, or tucked inside a chest. Each sensed token appears as a faint green mark, and the reach of the sensing can be strengthened.

rites.name: Amirneria
rites.text: A practiced healing-craft that draws life from another being's body through a single touch. The drained vitality flows into the caster, restoring their own strength.

rites.name: Sintus
rites.text: A destructive working drawn from the craft of unmaking that wears away the sturdiness of a foe's gear until it breaks and can no longer be used unless it is mended.

rites.name: Vontium
