rites.text: A mystical working that reveals hidden things to the caster. Its counterpart is a working that makes things escape notice entirely.

rites.name: Cintanum Seroseonia
rites.text: A dark working that afflicts a chosen target with a wasting sickness. The sufferer's body slowly weakens under the curse.

rites.name: Amalia
rites.text: A high-skill binding craft that weakens the resolve of a restless dead creature for one minute once it strikes. The spell saps the corpse's will to hold its ground.

rites.name: Torus
rites.text: A sacred working that lifts its bearer instantly from wherever they stand and sets them down before the gate of the nearest temple of the faithful. It is invoked in moments of danger or need.

rites.name: Serinelum
rites.text: A sorcerous craft that reveals the whereabouts of living beasts within a set range. Those who wield it see marks drawn on their charts showing where creatures roam nearby.

rites.name: Veollianum
rites.text: A practiced binding craft that bends a chosen creature to lend its strength to the caster's side for a brief span during combat.

rites.name: Sollianus
rites.text: A harsh binding craft that temporarily leaves a foe more vulnerable to damage from crackling lightning. It is taught as a destructive working of the old arts.

rites.name: Riasalium
rites.text: A temporary hex that makes a foe more vulnerable to flame, so that fire harms them more severely for a short while. It belongs to the destructive arts of the caster's craft.

rites.name: Taureonum
rites.text: A practiced craft that lets its user perceive the glow of nearby living beings, even through solid barriers. It reveals nothing of the dead, of constructs, or of beings from beyond the veil.

rites.name: Nasus Sollium
rites.text: A minor binding craft that strips thirty measures of enchantment from a chosen subject. It belongs to the lowest tier of the mystic arts taught to novice scholars.

rites.name: Seonilia
rites.text: A harmful incantation that briefly leaves a foe more vulnerable to hostile arcane forces that carry no elemental nature. The weakening fades after a short while.

rites.name: Neorernia
rites.text: A ruinous craft of the arcane arts that hurls a surge of crackling force into a chosen target, scorching them with sudden lightning-born harm.

rites.name: Lonirnia Laurnia
rites.text: A high-skill illusion craft that bends a chosen beast's will so it fights alongside its caster for a brief span of time.

rites.name: Amellianus
rites.text: A harmful incantation that temporarily makes a foe more vulnerable to icy harm. It is taught as a destructive craft among battle-scholars.

rites.name: Vinium Telernanum
rites.text: A novice's incantation that lets the caster feel the heartbeats of living things nearby. The sensing lasts for about a minute after the words are spoken.

rites.name: Neorellor
rites.text: A mind-dulling art that saps a foe's resolve to fight, sending the affected into a panicked flight for as long as the working holds, and it costs a bit more than its gentler cousin.

rites.name: Lintes Cistontus
rites.text: A sacred working drawn from restorative craft that briefly strengthens a person's resolve and fortune. When it fades, the bolstered qualities settle back to their former measure.

rites.name: Orialarnum
rites.text: A mystic working that strips away a lingering enchantment from a chosen target, though it cannot touch curses, sicknesses, or permanent wards. It proves especially useful against summoned servants and conjured guardians.

rites.name: Orenium Teostum
rites.text: A binding craft that briefly makes a target's load feel heavier, draining their stamina faster. When the working fades, the extra burden lifts away completely.

rites.name: Nillanium
rites.text: A harmful craft that lets a caster send venom into a foe, wounding them over time. It belongs to the school of destructive arts.

rites.name: Amonum
rites.text: A quiet inner craft that a ruler's line may cultivate without effort in the daily course of their reign. It is practiced through the discipline of a particular order of counsel.

rites.name: Rollestia
rites.text: A fleeting veil of illusion that stirs a creature's instinct to run from danger for a short span. Once it fades, the creature's nerve returns, and certain beings remain immune to its sway.

rites.name: Ameorneria
rites.text: A harsh destructive craft taught to apprentice practitioners, it wears down a foe's vitality on contact and keeps draining it for a short span.

rites.name: Sonaria
rites.text: A singular restorative power granted only to two exalted beings. It is a craft reserved for those who have ascended beyond ordinary mortals.

rites.name: Amausanum
rites.text: A dimming craft that a caster lays upon a target's mind, briefly dulling its reasoning. When the working fades, the mind regains its former sharpness.

rites.name: Orantolus
rites.text: A high-level destructive working that drains a foe's stamina sharply on contact, leaving them weary for half a minute. It is practiced only by skilled adepts of the old orders.

rites.name: Larauntus
rites.text: A mystical craft that swells the nerve of a manlike foe until it turns and runs from the fight. Its counterpart steadies such a foe, bolstering its resolve to stand firm.

rites.name: Seosor Orestilles
rites.text: A consuming craft practiced by the hunters of the Vellorn wolf-kin, drawn from their dark branch of skills. It lets the practitioner feed upon what they have slain.

rites.name: Mentasanum
rites.text: A harmful incantation of ruin that drains a target's inner resolve. The drained resolve stays lost until a restorative rite or draught is applied.

rites.name: Rernontia
rites.text: A dark art by which a warrior of the shadow blades pulls vitality out of a foe and feeds it into their own body. It belongs to a lineage of siphoning crafts.

rites.name: Reolosor
rites.text: A passive discipline that a fighter learns after mastering the art of wielding a blade in each hand. It is granted once the practitioner reaches the highest level of that two-weapon training.

rites.name: Corialanum
rites.text: A ruinous working that temporarily dims a practitioner's nimbleness in leaping and balance. The lost agility returns once the working fades.

rites.name: Amauntanum
rites.text: A withering craft that dulls a fighter's edge with small blades for a while. The dulling fades once the working ends and the blade regains its former keenness.

rites.name: Vaullanum Collus
rites.text: A harmful incantation of ruin that drains a foe's bodily might. The weakening stays after the chant fades and can only be undone by a separate restoring rite or draught.

rites.name: Cantus
rites.text: A temporary hex that saps the healing strength of a target's recovery craft. Once the hex fades, the lost strength slowly returns to its previous level.

rites.name: Orentus Coreostum
rites.text: A ritual craft that briefly weakens the protective worth of heavy plate worn by warriors. The hardened metal regains its full strength once the working fades.

rites.name: Serornum
rites.text: A temporary working that weakens the strength of false images, letting the caster unpick them. The lessened power returns to its normal level once the working fades.

rites.name: Malium Raullanum
rites.text: A ritual working that weakens a chosen creature so that its strikes land with less force. Practitioners cast it to blunt an opponent's offensive strength.

rites.name: Valiantia
rites.text: A discharge craft that releases a jolt of crackling energy which strikes several foes at once. It is distinctive for spreading its searing charge across a whole group rather than a single target.

rites.name: Senantia
rites.text: A hostile working siphons the fortune from a chosen soul, leaving it weaker in chance. When aimed at the chosen one it stands opposite a mending rite that restores fortune.

rites.name: Caulium Lausalus
rites.text: A harmful incantation that draws out a fighter's skill in close bodily combat, leaving them clumsier for a time. The weakened craft gradually returns once the working fades.

rites.name: Oreornentus
rites.text: A single ruinous working of destruction that only one sorceress may invoke. It is a craft held in her hands alone, guarded jealously by its wielder.

rites.name: Sonus
rites.text: A withering craft that temporarily weakens a foe's bare, unprotected form. The strength it saps slowly returns once the working fades.

rites.name: Orialum
rites.text: A fading hex that dulls the protection of mid-weight plate and mail, weakening it for a while. The lost strength gradually returns once the working ends.

rites.name: Tosastum
rites.text: A bond that lets a rider briefly command a great winged beast and fly upon its back. It can only be invoked by speaking a full three-part word of power.

rites.name: Tinernus
rites.text: A temporary ruinous working that drains the strength of arcane insight from a practitioner. The lost measure of understanding slowly returns once the working fades.

rites.name: Telaures Oraustirnum
rites.text: A ruinous incantation that breaks down the protective plating and blades of whoever it strikes. Its power lies in corroding the gear a foe relies upon in battle.

rites.name: Marnia Amiraullor
rites.text: A withering craft that siphons the charisma of a chosen subject, leaving them dimmed and unpersuasive. Its counter-rite can restore that lost presence to the one it harmed.

rites.name: Niasus
rites.text: A withering craft that siphons the bodily might from a chosen subject, leaving them weakened. When turned upon the caster's own kin, it is answered by a mending art that restores lost vigor.

rites.name: Rernanum
rites.text: A temporary hex that saps the protective worth of light garments worn by a foe. The weakened guard recovers its former strength once the working fades.

rites.name: Naurnistium
rites.text: A caster calls a brass guardian sphere from a hollow realm to stand before them. It strikes at whoever threatens its summoner, then vanishes back home once the spell fades or it is destroyed.

rites.name: Rostialium
rites.text: A minor craft of the order that channels a crackling bolt of stormlight from the caster's hands. It is taught first to novices as the simplest of the ruinous arts.

rites.name: Corauntes Amialesium
rites.text: A temporary hex that weakens a practitioner's transmutation craft, reducing its strength. The lost mastery returns once the hex fades away.

rites.name: Lenanum Oreosontus
rites.text: A minor binding craft that dims a caster's mental sight, sapping ten points of its illusion-weaving for twenty seconds. It is taught first to novices learning destructive arts.

rites.name: Rarnium Seriaranum
rites.text: A harmful spell craft that draws the vitality out of a living target and channels it into the caster. It belongs to the path of raw force and is shaped by inner resolve.

rites.name: Malles
rites.text: A novice-tier destructive craft that a student wields to hurl a bolt of raw energy. It is added to the lore through a later supplementary tome.

rites.name: Vauntes Valeonia
rites.text: A withering working that briefly siphons away a person's bodily prowess and speed. The stolen strength flows back once the working fades.

rites.name: Mollantia
rites.text: A drawn-out weakening that siphons away a bearer's capacity for reasoning and learning. When applied to the wielder of the craft, it is answered by a counter-rite that restores that lost sharpness.

rites.name: Caullium
rites.text: A ritual wearing that saps the stamina of a chosen body, whether a wanderer or a foe. Its opposite restores that same vigor when turned against the caster's own kin.

rites.name: Mornistus
rites.text: A ritual working that siphons away a foe's grasp of summoning craft for a short span. It is practiced by adepts of the destructive arts.

rites.name: Corirnia Seraustia
rites.text: A withering craft that siphons the inner resolve from a chosen subject, leaving them weakened in spirit. Its counter-rite restores that lost resolve to whoever it touches.

rites.name: Amaullirnum
rites.text: A temporary ritual that siphons away a sharpshooter's aim, lowering their skill for a while. The lost talent flows back once the working fades.

rites.name: Sestanum Lianoranum
rites.text: A dark working that siphons the magical reserves of a foe, weakening their capacity to cast. It belongs to the school of ruinous sorcery.

rites.name: Merum Selleosor
rites.text: A harmful incantation that drains an opponent's stamina, leaving them weakened in battle and unable to run away.

rites.name: Renium
rites.text: A dark incantation of ruin that drains a target's mind, dulling their reasoning. The loss lingers after the spell fades, and only a specific restorative rite or draught can return what was taken.

rites.name: Orasanum Viastor
rites.text: A dark working that drains a target's stamina and vigor. The loss lingers after the working fades, and only a specific restorative rite or tonic can bring it back.

rites.name: Oriantesum
rites.text: A dark incantation that saps the strength of a foe, draining their stamina away. It belongs to the craft of ruinous magic.

rites.name: Meosanum Saraulum
rites.text: A dark incantation that drains a target's fortune, leaving the victim unlucky. The lost favor persists after the working ends and can only be recovered through a restorative rite or draught.

rites.name: Teonaustes
rites.text: A temporary hex that weakens the skill of wielding long edged weapons, and the lost mastery returns once the enchantment fades.

rites.name: Viaranum Nostor
rites.text: A carving manner shaped with a cursed brush of bristles, learned by studying a sacred pattern scroll. Its marks are said to bind the maker's hand to the work.

rites.name: Oreonintor
rites.text: A withering hex that drains a target's nimbleness and swiftness. The loss lingers after the hex fades, and only a restorative rite or draught can return what was taken.

rites.name: Rosus Venteostor
rites.text: A sacred rite practiced by warrior-monks of the old order, channeling a cloaking dim that swallows the sun's light. It belongs to a line of wrathful dawn-craft taught in hidden shrines.

rites.name: Coralium Sereolles
rites.text: A temple-taught gift that boosts how much inner reserve a bearer can draw upon. It also leaves the bearer half as vulnerable to damage that strikes the mind's wellspring.

rites.name: Rarnum
rites.text: A ritual working that mirrors a bearer's armed strike back into the world. Such workings can only be mastered to a single fixed tier, though greater tiers can still be reached.

rites.name: Valereornus
rites.text: A mid-level harmful incantation that siphons away a foe's grasp of transformative craft. The victim loses fifteen points of that ability for about half a minute.

rites.name: Teostum Telorium
rites.text: An ancient spoken art in which a speaker voices three sacred words to unleash strong magical force, mostly in attacks. Its full power comes only when all three words are spoken together.

rites.name: Oriastinor
rites.text: A high-level craft of wild force that hurls raw elemental power outward from the caster's hands. It is learned only by those who have studied the sealed tomes of the old orders.

rites.name: Tiallorium
rites.text: A temporary binding that drains the strength of ruin-craft in its target, lowering it for a span of time. The lost strength gradually returns once the binding fades away.

rites.name: Rastus
rites.text: A ritual working through which a caster drives harm into a chosen target. It is cast by naming the one who is to suffer.

rites.name: Maunelus
rites.text: A minor magical craft taught at the lowest rung of study, letting a user deliver a crackling charge through a touch. It was added to the lore by a later collection of scrolls.

rites.name: Siastium Ceores
rites.text: A evasive fighting technique that lets a practitioner slip past an attack and return a measure of harm to the foe. Its user is usually a hunted wanderer relying on quick footwork.

rites.name: Niria Seriastania
rites.text: A rare tongue of great winged beings, now seldom heard since their vanishing. Those who learn its fragments can speak words of power that shape spells, and can soothe the young of such creatures.

rites.name: Virium
rites.text: A mid-level craft of destruction that a practiced caster can learn after the earlier training stages. It was introduced by a later collection of bound scrolls.

rites.name: Serornes Terniastum
rites.text: A supreme technique taught within an ember-kindled discipline of bold warriors. It is one of the ultimate arts drawn from that burning tradition.

rites.name: Talauntium
rites.text: A minor battle-craft that drains the aim and archery of a foe for a brief span. Novice casters learn it to dull an opponent's accuracy.

rites.name: Reontolus
rites.text: A temporary enchantment that weakens a spear's worth for a while. Once the working fades, the spear's full strength is restored.

rites.name: Amollaurnum
rites.text: A temporary binding that weakens a guarding force, lowering its strength until the binding fades and the force returns to its former measure.

rites.name: Nares
rites.text: A ritual working of ruin that temporarily weakens the practice of reshaping things. The lost skill slowly returns to its former strength once the working fades.

rites.name: Riaseolanum
rites.text: A dark working that drains a target's inner temperament, leaving it diminished. The lost quality lingers after the working fades and returns only through a dedicated mending rite or draught.

rites.name: Collinor
rites.text: A withering craft that temporarily dulls the protective skill of those who shape plate and mail. The lost mastery slowly returns once the working fades.

rites.name: Lestor Vilarium
rites.text: A taxing hex that saps a foe's healing craft by twenty points for nearly a minute. Only adepts of the ruinous arts can wield it.

rites.name: Ceollus Caunus
rites.text: A sacred spoken power that channels the true nature of ancient winged beasts through the voice. It lets its wielder draw on the might that such creatures carry within them.

rites.name: Maunteornor
rites.text: A spell-craft that siphons the stamina from a target, leaving them weakened. It draws upon the will of the caster and costs a small measure of inner power to cast.

rites.name: Nasum Meollum
rites.text: A withering incantation that temporarily dulls a person's gift for persuasive speech. The lost eloquence slowly returns once the enchantment fades away.

rites.name: Sinium Telestirnum
rites.text: A draining craft of the arcane arts that siphons the strength of a chosen attribute from a foe. It is bound to the will of the caster and costs a small measure of inner energy to weave.

rites.name: Amarniasia
rites.text: A ritual working of expert standing that drains a foe's skill with edged arms by twenty points for forty-five seconds.

rites.name: Ameosastium
rites.text: A mid-level craft of ruin that gathers crackling force and releases it outward in a sudden surge. It is studied by apprentice war-casters who wish to master raw destructive energy.

rites.name: Oreontases
rites.text: A temporary enchantment that weakens a wielder's mastery of cutting blades, the lost skill returning once the working fades.

rites.name: Amialus
rites.text: A dark working that siphons a targeted person's mastery of a craft, weakening it while the caster's own hand grows stronger. It draws on the inner resolve of the one who wields it.

rites.name: Sasteornum
rites.text: A ritual sense that lets its bearer perceive the creatures gathered around them. Practitioners of hidden orders cultivate it to know what lurks nearby.

rites.name: Serontium Talleontor
rites.text: A lasting craft of enchantment that gathers into the practitioner's hand over time. It is taught through a guild's ordered path of skills.

rites.name: Melum
rites.text: A baneful gaze-craft that gradually hollows out a target's sense of self until a countering rite breaks its hold.

rites.name: Mollestes
rites.text: A withering craft in which a caster's touch briefly draws away a foe's stamina. The stolen vigor flows back to its owner once the working fades.

rites.name: Valiarium
rites.text: A tiring alchemical working that dulls a wielder's killing strike. It stands opposite to the sharpening rite that brings a blow to its deadliest mark.

rites.name: Siria
rites.text: A passive craft practiced by mystic casters who draw in crackling power from the sky. It belongs to a tradition of storm-summoning arts taught in secret circles.

rites.name: Vaurentium
rites.text: A learned art practiced by members of a scholarly guild of spellcasters. It is a practiced technique that a caster can draw upon in their craft.

rites.name: Amornaulium
rites.text: A sacred incantation that sharpens the caster's skill with bludgeoning weapons while hardening their protective armor. It is unlike any other rite in the tradition.

rites.name: Valiria Costium
rites.text: A minor illusion craft taught to beginners that lets a caster become easier to see in the eyes of others. It was added to the body of known arts through a later supplement of collected lore.

rites.name: Coreonum Seriarolia
rites.text: A disciplined technique taught within a warrior guild, letting a practiced tracker strike with added precision against quarry.

rites.name: Serelastia
rites.text: A practiced gift of the sight that lets a willing bearer perceive in darkness for a short while. The strength of the gift determines how much dim light is brightened for them.

rites.name: Vornaurium
rites.text: A quiet, always-active practice of a dark caster that draws on a hidden reserve whenever a weakness appears. It belongs to a shadowed discipline of arcane study.

rites.name: Seosernium
rites.text: A ritual working that briefly raises a person's inner resolve, with the strength fading back to its former level once the working ends.

rites.name: Seriantorus
rites.text: A draining craft in which a caster's touch briefly saps a target's stamina. The stolen vigor flows back once the working fades.

rites.name: Nilles Nillianor
rites.text: A simple ruinous art that a beginner can learn, letting a caster drain five points of vitality from a creature by laying a hand upon it.

rites.name: Amolus Ameornostus
rites.text: A restorative working that temporarily raises a being's stamina above its usual level. When the working fades, the weariness returns to its former measure.

rites.name: Tallium Amastesium
rites.text: A ritual craft that sends crackling shock through several foes at once. It also leaves each struck body less able to resist the same kind of lightning-like harm.

rites.name: Orenia Resteoranum
rites.text: A hidden craft granted to the most advanced blood-touched sorts, letting them slip unseen and see clearly through the dark for a short span of three minutes.

rites.name: Costia Seosolum
rites.text: A touch-cast working that pulls the stamina out of a foe and transfers it to the caster. The siphoned vigor lingers longer as the caster grows in skill.

rites.name: Mallanum Sesanum
rites.text: A unique illusion craft that clouds a target's sight, lowering the chance that they will land blows with weapons or bare hands.

rites.name: Nores
rites.text: A mid-tier charm craft that lifts the goodwill of everyone standing nearby toward the caster for a short while. Its reach is a modest circle around the practitioner.

rites.name: Corus Sintiarnia
rites.text: A restorative working that draws weariness out of a body and replaces it with vigor for as long as the working holds. Its effect lasts only while the working is sustained.

rites.name: Amaustanum Celus
rites.text: A dread-inducing working that can be brewed into a potion, bound into an enchantment, or cast as a spell. It is one of several trials a mage-scholar may demand before granting entry to a learned hall.

rites.name: Valeontanum
rites.text: A dread-bringing craft that fixes a foe's gaze and drives it to abandon the fight and flee in terror.

rites.name: Tiarneorium
rites.text: A binding craft that seals a target in place so it cannot move. Its counter-working is a force that makes anything unbindable.

rites.name: Amiaria Vallium
rites.text: A quiet practitioner's discipline held by tempest-workers, granting a lasting, constant boost to their arcane craft. It belongs to the storm-calling tradition of the robed sorcerer orders.

rites.name: Telauntor Oreolles
rites.text: A destructive working that drains a target's stamina for a short span. The drained vigor slowly returns to its former strength once the working fades.

rites.name: Cianum Valianasia
rites.text: A novice-taught enchantment that thickens a caster's defenses against lightning-like harm and hardens their guard for half a minute. It is a basic ward that a practitioner learns early in their studies.

rites.name: Sellor Serestum
rites.text: A minor illusory craft taught to novice casters. When cast, it grants the caster a sharpened sight in darkness for a short span of time.

rites.name: Amosus
rites.text: A hidden craft that lets a practitioner render another person briefly unseen. It is a targeted form of a self-cast veil, drawing light away from one chosen figure.

rites.name: Raunantum
rites.text: A harmful incantation of the destructive arts that drains the stamina of whoever it strikes. It belongs to the school of ruinous magic.

rites.name: Laria
rites.text: A temporary blessing of the healing arts that raises the bare-handed defense of one who wears no armor. The enhancement fades once the working ends and the wearer returns to ordinary strength.

rites.name: Sesia Caustanum
rites.text: A restoring incantation that temporarily raises a practitioner's protective wardcraft. The enhancement fades after a set span, returning the ward to its former strength.

rites.name: Lontes
rites.text: A temple-taught working that cancels protective hardening from a target. Its counter is a rite that restores and thickens that hardening.

rites.name: Ciasor Lasia
rites.text: A restorative art of the healing school that strengthens a bearer's endurance, drawn from the inner resolve of the mind. It costs very little to call upon.

rites.name: Niarnor Corollum
rites.text: A temporary blessing of the forge-craft that strengthens a smith's skill at repairing and making armor. The bonus fades when the enchantment runs out, returning the craftsperson to their usual ability.

rites.name: Molanum
rites.text: A wild bond that lets a warden call upon the savage strength of a tamed companion as a final, desperate technique. It is drawn from the deepest tier of the beast-bonding discipline.

rites.name: Valares Telauliria
rites.text: A craft that strengthens the shaping of matter, bestowed by certain herbs and garments. It is brewed into potions and woven into enchanted clothing.

rites.name: Aminteoles
rites.text: A minor temple-trained rite that lifts the caster's fortune by a small measure for a short span. It is taught early to novice practitioners of restorative craft.

rites.name: Rasiles
rites.text: A temporary enchantment that grants a boost to one chosen talent for a set span of time. It is cast as a restorative craft of the sacred orders.

rites.name: Sillor Nolanum
rites.text: A temporary healing-craft that strengthens a fighter's bare-fisted combat ability. The boost fades after a while, returning the fighter to their usual level of skill.

rites.name: Amerausor
rites.text: A restorative craft that briefly sharpens the skill of a wielder with the cutting blade. Once the working fades, the wielder's ability returns to what it was before.

rites.name: Montirum
rites.text: A sorcerous working of the destructive arts, learned at the lowest rank of study. It is one of the spells gathered into a later supplementary tome of lore.

rites.name: Telus
rites.text: A harmful incantation that dims a target's reasoning. The dimming lingers after the working ends and can only be undone by a restorative rite or a brewed draught.

rites.name: Saurneoles
rites.text: A restorative working that briefly strengthens a bearer's power to guard against blows. The protective boost fades once the working ends, returning the defense to its former level.

rites.name: Leolauntum
rites.text: A temporary enchantment that strengthens a warrior's skill with long swords, and the blade-craft gradually returns to its normal level once the magic fades.

rites.name: Raures Telasteolor
rites.text: A practitioner weaves a protective ward of arcane force that wraps the whole body and raises its resistance to harm. It is a shaping craft that hardens the bearer against blows.

rites.name: Minollium
rites.text: A ritual craft that channels two hungers at once, striking a target with raw force and searing heat in equal measure. It is taught among the ash-scholars of the high halls.

rites.name: Ameonum
rites.text: A ranged incantation of destructive flame that a caster hurls at a distant foe. The target may resist the burning by making a saving throw against fire.

rites.name: Veoranum Rintastor
rites.text: A mind-clouding craft that drives a single living figure into wild, uncontrolled rage. It is delivered through a touch that carries the same fury.

rites.name: Lornium Seolum
rites.text: A restorative incantation that a caster speaks upon oneself to steady the body and sustain its stamina for a time. It grows longer with the caster's growing skill, and it nearly always takes hold, making it a dependable aid when fleeing danger.

rites.name: Orelornus
rites.text: A healing craft that briefly raises a bearer's measures of strength and skill. It can be drawn from rituals, draughts, charms, and bound trinkets.

rites.name: Telorniarus
rites.text: A temporary ritual craft that strengthens a practitioner's skill with ranged aim. The enhanced ability fades back to its former level once the working ends.

rites.name: Rianes Costum
rites.text: A destructive incantation that hurls a freezing burst of cold at a target, dealing icy harm to several foes at once.

rites.name: Sintium Nasanum
rites.text: A minor binding of destructive craft taught at the lowest rung of study. It hurls a sliver of cold that breaks whatever it touches.

rites.name: Ciantinium
rites.text: A temporary healing art that strengthens the power of deception and misdirection. The enhancement fades once the working ends, returning the practitioner's ability to its normal level.

rites.name: Corostum Nosauria
rites.text: A junior-grade binding craft that hurls a shard of frost at a foe, wounding them and dragging their movements to a crawl for a short span. Its chill matches the sluggishness brought on by a numbing tonic.

rites.name: Corillia
rites.text: A hidden craft that lets its wielder merge with the surrounding scenery so that others cannot perceive them. The wielder may still strike and handle things while the concealment holds, though its strength can waver greatly.

rites.name: Siasium Riralum
rites.text: A chilling craft that calls down a burst of icy harm across several foes at once. It is practiced by those who wield destructive arts against groups.

rites.name: Rallia Viria
rites.text: A temporary craft of restorative tending that strengthens a healer's ability to mend wounds. The gift fades back to its former level once the working ends.

rites.name: Ternanum Meorilia
rites.text: A temporary sorcery that stirs a person of flesh into a sharper urge to strike out at others. Once the working fades, the person's aggression settles back to its usual level, and beasts, the restless dead, otherworldly beings, and enchanted objects remain unaffected.

rites.name: Rinaurnus
rites.text: A temporary enhancement that strengthens a practitioner's skill in reshaping matter. When the enchantment fades, the skill returns to its former level.

rites.name: Naustes Valisaules
rites.text: A high-order warding craft that a caster invokes to turn aside flame. For one minute it bolsters both the wearer's resistance to fire and the strength of their protective bulwark.

rites.name: Amanaurum
rites.text: A shared name covers two enhancements of the mind's weaving. One is drawn from consumed brewed components, the other is worked into enchanted garments.

rites.name: Nialleoria
rites.text: A quiet hunter's craft in which a stalker strikes unseen from cover. It was once known by a harsher name before being renamed.

rites.name: Seornor Seolor
rites.text: A harmful incantation that wounds a humanoid foe in four distinct ways while sapping their courage. It is cast by a practitioner of the arcane arts.

rites.name: Serarnum Saseornium
rites.text: A restorative craft that briefly strengthens the protective worth of heavy plate. When the working fades, the wearer's skill with such armor returns to its former level.

rites.name: Ciarus Mauntarum
rites.text: A quality found within certain alchemical reagents that, when brewed into a draught, lets the drinker weave stronger enchantments for as long as its effect lasts.

rites.name: Serillus Veornestia
rites.text: A destructive art that hurls scorching flame at a foe, burning them with heat. It is a craft practiced among those who wield the power of ruin.

rites.name: Telaulus Seorentium
rites.text: A disciplined thrust-and-rush technique taught to spear-bearing guardians of the temple orders. It lets a warrior close distance on a foe with focused, directed momentum.

rites.name: Teoraurnia
rites.text: A minor destructive incantation taught to novice casters, learned from a bound tome. It lets the wielder chill a foe through a touch.

rites.name: Noraustor
rites.text: A binding craft that is worked into an object to strengthen a bowman's aim and draw. It is an enchantment that makes archery itself more potent.

rites.name: Nelles
rites.text: A ward-sigil that is scratched into the ground and waits there. Any foe who steps onto it is burned by searing flame.

rites.name: Niror
rites.text: A practiced technique in which a warrior wields two blades together to strike in rapid succession. It becomes available once the wielder reaches the second level of mastery in twin-blade combat.

rites.name: Ventum
rites.text: A craft-effect that can be drawn from certain gathered reagents while brewing. It also serves as an enchantment that strengthens lightweight protective garb.

rites.name: Mallanum Valirantia
rites.text: A beginner's craft of reshaping the body that wraps the caster in a chill barrier. For a short span it hardens their guard and blunts the bite of icy harm.

rites.name: Neosium
rites.text: A temporary charm that stirs a creature's urge to lash out, making it more eager to strike. When the charm fades, the creature's urge settles back to its usual level. Thinking folk, the risen dead, otherworldly beings, and relics resist it.

rites.name: Sereolus Serostum
rites.text: A ward of chilled sorcery wraps around its wielder like a glacial shell. It softens cold harm and lightly stings foes who draw close.

rites.name: Serauntum Raustirnium
rites.text: A temporary blessing of healing craft that sharpens a warrior's mastery of small blades. When the rite ends, the skill falls back to its former level.

rites.name: Tontia Lanium
rites.text: A transforming craft that wraps the caster's whole body in an unseen ward, raising how well the caster resists harm.

rites.name: Coriarnus Tiantus
rites.text: A cold-based craft that channels chilling force into a burst that harms several foes at once. Practitioners of the destructive arts wield it to strike a group in one motion.

rites.name: Voreolia
rites.text: A temporary blessing of the healing arts that strengthens a craftsperson's skill at binding magic into objects. When the blessing fades, that skill returns to its earlier level.

rites.name: Amerintium
rites.text: A caster wraps a shield of living flame around themselves. It grants resistance to burning and scorches nearby foes with a fraction of its strength.

rites.name: Niastium Contiarnium
rites.text: A practitioner's craft that wraps the caster in a shell of biting cold. It softens harm from freezing and lightly chills foes who draw near.

rites.name: Mastus Orontor
rites.text: A restorative craft that briefly sharpens the strength of a spear-bearer's weapon skill. Once the working fades, the skill slips back to its usual level.

rites.name: Liantanum Vasostor
rites.text: A basic restoring craft taught to novice casters, which strengthens the wearer's stamina for a short span. The effect lasts about a minute and a half.

rites.name: Venia Miantia
rites.text: A destructive craft that hurls a cold bolt of icy force, striking a group of foes with freezing harm.

rites.name: Mestallor
rites.text: A ranged strike of stored lightning that a caster can learn after earning a guild's favor. Its force and reach grow with the caster's standing at the time the power is granted.

rites.name: Oreolium Telantia
rites.text: A ritual craft that calls forth flame to strike several foes at once, scorching each one it touches. It belongs to the practice of destructive arts.

rites.name: Reolostia
rites.text: A transformative working that briefly lightens the bearer's burden, slowing the drain of stamina and allowing them to carry more goods along the road.

rites.name: Coriasantia
rites.text: A mid-tier destructive incantation that hurls a sphere of flame, scorching every creature within a short radius where it lands.

rites.name: Nelisium
rites.text: A binding incantation that weakens a foe's striking strength. It drains the force behind a target's blows for a time.

rites.name: Leontornum
rites.text: A devotional rite invoked by a pilgrim who kneels at a sacred roadside shrine to a revered sovereign. The pilgrim gains a blessing of steadfast strength.

rites.name: Rarnauntes
rites.text: A bound craft that strengthens the wearer's ability with heavy plate, and can be brewed into a draught or woven into enchanted gear.

rites.name: Coriastor Launtes
rites.text: A restorative incantation that a caster invokes upon themselves to strengthen their swiftness. Its chance of taking hold rises slightly as the caster grows more experienced.

rites.name: Costasor
rites.text: A protective craft that grants its bearer resistance to harm from burning. It is a restorative working drawn from the old orders of the temple lore.

rites.name: Serausanum Losauntum
rites.text: A passive discipline practiced by the devout guardians of the temple, drawing steady restorative light into the body. It belongs to a sacred line of healing crafts.

rites.name: Coriasium Veollor
rites.text: A temporary art of sacred working that sharpens the force a practitioner brings to ruin. Its strengthening fades when the working ends, returning the craft to its former measure.

rites.name: Carnellium
rites.text: A temporary blessing of the quiet arts that heightens a wanderer's ability to move unseen. The enhancement fades once the charm's duration runs out, returning the practitioner to their former stealth.

rites.name: Oronintor
rites.text: A temporary rite of inner attunement that heightens a practitioner's arcane sensitivity for a set span. When the rite ends, the sensitivity fades back to its former level.

rites.name: Caustor
rites.text: A battle craft of the temple adepts that hurls a single blow pairing a crushing force with a bitter chill, striking both at once in equal measure.

rites.name: Caustes Vaustum
rites.text: A minor restoring rite that a novice caster speaks to steady their inner resolve. For a short span afterward, the caster's mental resilience rises a little.

rites.name: Serenalor
rites.text: A mid-level destructive incantation taught in later tomes of arcane lore. It releases a sudden blast of bitter cold to strike at foes.

rites.name: Orastum Veontus
rites.text: A sorcerous craft that wraps the practitioner in an unseen shell of arcane force, hardening their body against blows. It is taught among the spellweavers who reshape matter and essence.

rites.name: Valornia Naunor
rites.text: A cold hex of destructive craft that lies in wait and erupts when a hidden mechanism is set off. It is woven into doors and coffers across the wild island.

rites.name: Oraurnasium
rites.text: A restorative craft that can be bound into charms or brewed into draughts, raising the bearer's vitality beyond its usual measure.

rites.name: Valaror
rites.text: A restorative charm that briefly strengthens a person's running and climbing prowess. The gained vigor fades once the enchantment runs out.

rites.name: Maustonus
rites.text: A carved mark that drives those nearby into a wild, frenzied turn against their own companions. It leaves little glow or noise, making it prized by those who work in deception and hidden craft.

rites.name: Vaurines
rites.text: A great hidden power granted by a dark crystal of shadow. It is bestowed upon those who bear the crystal's favor and draws its strength from that gift.

rites.name: Tastillium
rites.text: A restorative working that briefly sharpens a person's nimbleness in leaping and tumbling. When the working fades, that nimbleness settles back to its former level.

rites.name: Oroses Launtanum
rites.text: A temporary healing-craft rite that briefly sharpens a practitioner's skill in potion-making. When the rite fades, the skill returns to its former level.

rites.name: Telaulum Larnus
rites.text: A minor restoration rite that a novice caster performs to sharpen their mind. For a short span afterward, the caster's reasoning and understanding grow noticeably keener.

rites.name: Orisum Coraurosus
rites.text: A destructive craft that calls forth scorching heat and hurls it at a chosen target, burning whoever is struck. It belongs to the school of ruinous arts.

rites.name: Tauses Orenor
rites.text: A ward-craft that wraps its caster in a ring of living flame, shielding them from heat and scorching foes who draw close. The flames burn adversaries nearby for a fraction of the ward's strength.

rites.name: Narus Coresor
rites.text: A temporary healing-craft that strengthens a practitioner's ability to summon and bind. When the working fades, that ability returns to its former level.

rites.name: Rernanum Valeolus
rites.text: A ritual craft that strips magical effects from a chosen subject, excluding lasting afflictions and steady enchantments, while the practitioner melts into the background so that no onlooker can perceive them.

rites.name: Rilles Teores
rites.text: A brewed or inscribed quality that strengthens the wielder's skill with heavy, two-armed weapons. It is recorded among the workings of enchanters and alchemists.

rites.name: Oraunor Ceosus
rites.text: A brief rite of inner steadiness that a novice caster performs to lift their presence and charm. The effect lasts a minute and a half before fading.

rites.name: Seresia
rites.text: A minor fire craft that hurls a single bolt of flame at a chosen foe. The caster must gather heat for a moment before the bolt leaves the hand. Adepts can also bind it into the wood of a focusing rod.

rites.name: Ciastor
rites.text: A passive discipline practiced by warriors who train with a single blade and a guarding board. It quietly strengthens their defense without any action needed from the user.

rites.name: Mauliasum
rites.text: A healing-tradition rite that briefly sharpens the power of bludgeoning tools held by the caster's allies. Once its duration passes, the tools return to their ordinary strength.

rites.name: Nanus Oreniaria
rites.text: A restorative craft of the mind that raises the upper limit of a caster's inner reserve of arcane energy. It draws on resolve and costs a small measure of that reserve to channel.

rites.name: Coreleontes
rites.text: A ward-craft that wraps its wielder in a shield against bitter cold. It turns the sting of frost away from the one who casts it.

rites.name: Nallistia
rites.text: A ward-craft that wraps its caster in a cold-resisting barrier, guarding against frost-born sorcery. It is formed by joining a chill-warding charm with a general protective veil.

rites.name: Corellum Seronteria
rites.text: A restorative charm that temporarily strengthens the protective worth of lightweight coverings worn by a wearer. When the charm fades, the coverings return to their former measure of protection.

rites.name: Ciranum
rites.text: A bound resonance that strengthens the wielder's spoken calls for a short time. It is a craft taught among ancient voice-keepers who chant to awaken hidden power.

rites.name: Nantilles
rites.text: A set of protective enchantments that shield the one who casts them from both sorcery and blows. It is a learned craft practiced by those who guard their own bodies.

rites.name: Seronestia
rites.text: A ruinous craft that inflicts three kinds of harm at once. It is practiced as a destructive art by those who study the unmaking of things.

rites.name: Lasum
rites.text: A mid-tier craft of ruin that siphons a fixed measure of inner power from whoever it touches, draining their reserves for a short while. It is taught to apprentices who have learned the basics of destructive working.

rites.name: Orernium Teloriastus
rites.text: A dark working that dulls a target's swiftness for a while. The target's quickness slowly returns to normal once the working fades.

rites.name: Leostus Telantus
rites.text: A dark rune-craft that wears down a target's stamina and resilience. It belongs to the disciplines of ruinous magic.

rites.name: Serauntanum Nastellanum
rites.text: A mid-level healing art that a caster invokes to lift their own pace for a short span of time. The boost lasts only a minute and a half before fading.

rites.name: Ciallia Sosium
rites.text: A caster calls a spirit of the dead from a distant hidden plane to stand before them. It strikes anything that attacks its summoner until it is slain or the rite ends, then fades back to its far realm. Within settlements, the town's watchmen turn on both caster and spirit at once.

rites.name: Reones Varia
rites.text: A dark working that siphons away an opponent's inner reserve of arcane power. The caster weakens a foe by draining the energy they need to sustain their own sorcery.

rites.name: Coreosium Cinia
rites.text: A dark working that temporarily dulls a victim's character, dimming their nature until the enchantment fades and their original temperament returns.

rites.name: Manes
rites.text: A practiced illusion that lets its wielder merge with the surrounding scenery so that no watcher can perceive them. It is a craft of concealment passed among hidden orders.

rites.name: Mialium Tollia
rites.text: A mid-tier restorative craft of the mending orders that, once invoked, lifts a caster's nimbleness by a modest measure for a short span.

rites.name: Telentiasor
rites.text: A ranged hex that siphons an opponent's stamina away, leaving them winded and slowed, less able to strike back or escape.

rites.name: Amollus Orillus
rites.text: A dark working that temporarily dulls a target's nimbleness and quickness. The lost swiftness slowly returns once the working fades away.

rites.name: Monum
rites.text: A tongue of great hulking speakers, learned through the mind rather than the throat. Its mastery lets a wary wanderer calm the towering brutes so they will not turn to violence unless provoked.

rites.name: Centum
rites.text: A bending craft that lets its wielder melt into the surrounding scenery so that no watcher can perceive them. It works as a layered illusion woven over the body.

rites.name: Telirnastus
rites.text: A mid-level healing-craft charm that a caster invokes to draw fortune closer, granting a surge of good chance for a short, timed span.

rites.name: Nollus
rites.text: A novice's dark incantation that siphons vitality from a creature touched by the caster over a brief span. It is taught to beginners who study the craft of ruin.

rites.name: Mastones
rites.text: A ritual craft that calls down a cold, icy harm upon several foes at once. It belongs to the school of ruinous arts and strikes many targets together.

rites.name: Rentium Sinium
rites.text: A mid-level working of the transformative arts that hardens the caster's protective plating. For a short span the wearer's defenses swell noticeably against blows.

rites.name: Seroriales Leosia
rites.text: A restorative craft in which a practitioner's touch mends wounds in another. It is taught among healing orders and draws on the bearer's inner vitality.

rites.name: Vantolium
rites.text: A restorative working that grants the bearer a strong defense against the wasting blight known as the rot-sickness. It is cast by healers as a shield against that particular corruption.

rites.name: Sasorum
rites.text: A chilling affliction that slowly siphons away both the vigor and the inner magic of its victim. Each strike that lands on the afflicted feeds the drainer, restoring its own strength, and cutthroat raiders wield it to trouble casters most of all.

rites.name: Taullium Sanes
rites.text: A shaping craft that temporarily makes a target's load feel heavier, draining their stamina faster. The added heaviness fades once the working ends.

rites.name: Launeostium
rites.text: A reshaping craft that briefly lightens the bearer's load, so they tire more slowly and can haul more goods than usual.

rites.name: Nontum
rites.text: A dark rite that drains a victim's fortune for a while. Once the working ends, their luck slowly returns to what it was before.

rites.name: Tiastium Launtes
rites.text: A withering hex that drains a bearer's physical might for a time. The strength slowly flows back once the binding is undone.

rites.name: Ameonor Sisor
rites.text: A ward-craft that hardens the caster's body against venom and toxins. It grants strong resistance to poison for a time.

rites.name: Oristes Valentares
rites.text: A mid-level sorcerous working that the caster invokes to sense every living being within a short reach around them. The sensing endures for one minute before it fades.

rites.name: Menia Vaunor
rites.text: A harmful incantation that strikes a foe with four kinds of elemental harm while locking their body in place. It is taught as a destructive working among the caster's trained circles.

rites.name: Casanum Serialisium
rites.text: A practiced craft that lets a caster shed all heaviness and slip out of sight, drifting above the ground unseen. It almost never fails, which makes it prized among those who study hidden arts.

rites.name: Solles Tanentor
rites.text: A rare restorative craft that wraps its bearer in a shield against damage drawn from arcane forces.

rites.name: Toses Taurneolor
rites.text: A dark working that drains a target's inner resolve for a short while. The lost resolve slowly returns once the working fades.

rites.name: Mintiarnium
rites.text: A restorative enchantment that guards its bearer against sudden jolts of lightning-like harm. It is a craft taught among the healing circles of the old temples.

rites.name: Serelles Riantornum
rites.text: A deep-sealed incantation of lifting that lets a practitioner hover briefly above the ground. It belongs to the school of bending form and only lasts for a short span before the body sinks back down.

rites.name: Teleontium Sintarnum
rites.text: A withering hex that drains the vitality of whoever it is cast upon, leaving the target weakened and frail.

rites.name: Tenum Amalum
rites.text: A chilling incantation that hurls a burst of freezing cold at several foes at once. It harms everyone caught in its icy blast.

rites.name: Nalor Visor
rites.text: A dark binding that drains a target's reasoning for a while, leaving their wits dulled until the working fades and the mind slowly returns to its former sharpness.

rites.name: Cinor Tarnum
rites.text: A caster looses a bolt of searing flame that wraps a single target, dealing heavy burning damage that grows stronger with the caster's skill. At high mastery it can reduce nearly any lone foe to ash.

rites.name: Cirnauses
rites.text: A mid-tier healing craft that a practitioner invokes to bolster their stamina. For a short span of time, the caster's reserves of vigor swell noticeably.

rites.name: Oriranum Coreosus
rites.text: A mid-tier binding craft that bolsters the caster's presence, lifting their charisma by a set amount for a short span of time.

rites.name: Ceontaulus
rites.text: A ritual craft that hurls a crackling shock of elemental force at several foes at once. It harms all who are struck by the surge.

rites.name: Calum
rites.text: A ranged craft that hurls a crackling bolt of lightning-like force, striking several foes at once with stunning energy.

rites.name: Valeosistum
rites.text: A restorative art that mends the caster's vitality and endurance while purging the common sicknesses from the body. It is considered a rare and singular gift among the faithful.

rites.name: Sinium Teoraulanum
rites.text: A mid-level restorative charm that bolsters the caster's inner resolve. Its effect lasts for a short while after it is spoken.

rites.name: Valauntium Tirneorus
rites.text: A mid-level healing rite that mends the wounded body of its target. It restores a modest measure of vitality over a brief span of moments.

rites.name: Corellornes
rites.text: A restorative sorcery that wraps its bearer in a thick shield, letting them withstand a great deal of arcane harm.

rites.name: Miarium Costelanum
rites.text: A restorative incantation that grants its caster a sturdy shield against bitter cold. It guards the body from harm wrought by icy forces.

rites.name: Coreolires Viasostanum
rites.text: A harsh working of destructive force that wears down the endurance of whoever it is cast upon. It belongs to the school of ruinous magic.

rites.name: Corarnones
rites.text: A high-tier restorative craft that a practitioner invokes to bolster their vitality. It grants a surge of sixty points to their life force, lasting for a single minute.

rites.name: Ternes Reornes
rites.text: A basic restorative incantation that a novice caster can weave to bolster their stamina for a short span. It grants a sizable surge of endurance that lingers for under a minute.

rites.name: Ameostum Serauria
rites.text: A healing rite that lifts every wasting sickness from the one it is cast upon. It is held within the sacred restoration arts of the temple orders.

rites.name: Sereostia
rites.text: A sacred rite that a wanderer can receive at a holy site, lending the recipient greater inner power and sturdier protection.

rites.name: Valeostor
rites.text: A sustaining ward-craft that grants the bearer strong protection against everyday sicknesses. It is taught among healing circles and is valued by those who tend the sick.

rites.name: Ceornus Sestiantium
rites.text: A slow restorative craft that gradually renews a caster's inner reserves, mending their vigor, their spirit, and their stamina as time passes.

rites.name: Siallus Valiaseonor
rites.text: A dark rite that drains a target's stamina for a short while. Once the rite fades, the target's strength of body returns to what it was before.

rites.name: Seriastia Coresia
rites.text: A ritual flame-craft that hurls a burst of searing heat to scorch several foes at once. Practitioners train in the destructive arts to master it.

rites.name: Laurium Veontanum
rites.text: A practitioner's craft that strips a large portion of magical effects from the caster in one stroke. It sits at an intermediate level of arcane skill.

rites.name: Teonasium
rites.text: A forbidden working of harm that draws away a foe's vitality and stamina while weakening two of their core strengths. Few practitioners have ever mastered its peculiar, lingering grip.

rites.name: Lentus Telaunornes
rites.text: A divine sworn guard's gift of protective magic that strengthens a caster's defense and offense. Two versions exist, and one is held by a former guardian who has broken with the sovereign.

rites.name: Valeones Vostanum
rites.text: A transforming craft that temporarily makes a target's load grow heavier, draining their stamina faster. The added heft vanishes once the working ends.

rites.name: Sereoria Seraurnia
rites.text: A sealed inner craft that hardens the wearer's guard, lifting their skill with every kind of protective covering, from bare skin to heavy plate.

rites.name: Maurus
rites.text: A protective craft that hardens the bearer against being frozen in place. It is a rare discipline taught only within old sanctuary orders.

rites.name: Meosanium
rites.text: A reshaping craft that briefly makes a target's load grow heavier, draining their stamina faster. The added weight fades away once the working ends.

rites.name: Amosternum
rites.text: A cursed offensive incantation that drains an enemy's nimbleness while sapping their stamina. Only one ancient mystic is known to wield it.

rites.name: Coriralus
rites.text: A veil of illusory craft that hides its bearer from watching eyes. The veil tears away the moment the bearer strikes, speaks, or touches a mechanism.

rites.name: Tialum Ameosaunum
rites.text: A protective craft used by the sworn servants of a high divine ruler, weaving magic that turns aside spells and blows aimed at the caster. A rogue former servant holds a separate version that differs in its workings.

rites.name: Risantanum
rites.text: A junior destructive incantation that hurls a chunk of icy hail at a foe, striking with a burst of chilling cold on impact.

rites.name: Sentus Veolisum
rites.text: A passive inner gift that strengthens a bearer's vitality. It works quietly in the background and belongs to the line of skills tied to endurance and health.

rites.name: Melium Seornor
rites.text: A minor illusory craft taught to novice casters, lending a bearer a surge of nerve and eagerness to strike foes for a single minute after a light touch.

rites.name: Castes Corastanum
rites.text: A passive discipline of gripping and swinging great two-handed arms. It belongs to the same training path as other two-handed martial arts.

rites.name: Nosum Tiantoses
rites.text: A practiced technique in which a fighter wields two blades together, one kept concealed until the moment of attack. It is learned only after long mastery of paired-weapon combat.

rites.name: Seollanum Vanestium
rites.text: A battle craft that drains the vitality and stamina of a foe while weakening two of their core strengths at once. It is rare, for no other working in the land is shaped quite the same way.

rites.name: Riantarnia
rites.text: A minor binding craft that a novice caster performs by laying a hand on another. For twenty heavy moments the touched one carries a crushing weight.

rites.name: Telesor Niasium
rites.text: A ritual curse that drains an enemy's vitality and stamina while weakening several of their core abilities. It is wielded as a destructive craft by those who study forbidden binding rites.

rites.name: Telerus Valisonanum
rites.text: A bodily discipline that lets a people's blood mend wounds tenfold for a short span, glowing with a warm amber radiance. Its source is traced to ancient living groves that are believed to have shaped the people's flesh.

rites.name: Miarenum
rites.text: A mid-tier destructive incantation that, when it strikes, unleashes a burst of icy cold on every creature standing close to its point of impact.

rites.name: Contor Tiania
rites.text: A restorative craft that mends another person's wounds by a set measure of vitality. It has no effect on the restless dead, on conjured elemental beings, or on constructed machines.

rites.name: Celum Costauria
rites.text: A binding craft that mixes ruinous fire-lore with quiet inner arts. It drains a foe's vitality and stamina while siphoning away their raw might for the caster.

rites.name: Minestia
rites.text: A mid-tier restorative rite that a practitioner invokes to mend the body. It draws back a set measure of vitality into the caster over a brief span of moments.

rites.name: Sentares
rites.text: A restorative chant that a novice caster speaks to knit back the caster's own flesh. It returns a set amount of vitality to the one who sings it.

rites.name: Tolarnanum
rites.text: A novice-level binding of transformation that a caster invokes to harden their body against flame and blows. The protection lasts a short while and grants a modest bolstering of resistance.

rites.name: Cernia
rites.text: A ritual working of scorching flame that is hurled at a chosen foe, searing them on contact. It is taught only to those who have mastered the harder arts of ruin.

rites.name: Corares Sontor
rites.text: A restorative craft that quickens the body's mending while vigor runs strong. The stronger the reserve of energy, the faster the wounds close.

rites.name: Corauselor
rites.text: A withering incantation drawn from the art of ruin that drains a victim's vitality. Practitioners of destructive craft use it to wear down a foe's life force.

rites.name: Valestorus
rites.text: A devoted warrior-cleric's practiced ceremony that restores the wounded through sanctified light, drawn from a disciplined order's teachings.

rites.name: Valasteosum
rites.text: A protective craft that shields its bearer from both spells and blows. It is built from a mix of enchanted effects that work together to turn aside harm.

rites.name: Cilus Teleornerum
rites.text: A practiced discipline taught to archers, letting them withdraw quickly after loosing shots. It is awakened once a marksman reaches a high stage of mastery with the bow.

rites.name: Ciaria Marnium
rites.text: A skill within the shapeshifting discipline of a lycanthrope's training. It belongs to the branch of abilities that a beast-kin learns as it grows.

rites.name: Orernus Meosia
rites.text: A restorative healing art that mends wounds through the caster's touch. It belongs to the practice of restoration.

rites.name: Nontus Nastus
rites.text: A ritual working that weakens the protective shell a person wears, so that blows against them bite deeper than they should.

rites.name: Serisum Mialanum
rites.text: A blessing is granted to a wanderer who kneels and prays at a roadside shrine. The gift is a sacred working drawn from the mercy of a patron guardian.

rites.name: Corestor Coriastia
rites.text: A restorative craft a practitioner works upon their own body. It slowly knits wounds closed, and the mending lasts longer as the practitioner grows in skill.

rites.name: Amaurintes
rites.text: A slowing working of the arcane arts that answers the quickening craft, counterbalancing it. It belongs to the practice of transmutation and alchemical workings.

rites.name: Ameollianus
rites.text: A restorative incantation that a practitioner speaks to renew their own vitality. It draws strength back into the one who chants it, knitting wounds and easing fatigue.

rites.name: Ventauses
rites.text: A forbidden casting that strikes a foe's life force directly while also searing them with flame, frost, and lightning at once. Its wielders are feared for the triple wound it leaves.

rites.name: Laliarum
rites.text: A withering craft that drains a victim's vitality for a short while. The stolen strength slowly returns once the working fades away.

rites.name: Rosiales
rites.text: A hostile working that draws away a rival's swiftness while draining their stamina and weighing them down. It blends three disciplines of arcane practice into one forceful gesture.

rites.name: Linaria
rites.text: A minor illusion craft that steadies a bearer's nerve and eagerness to strike foes. Its hold lasts a short span of several dozen heartbeats.

rites.name: Corarnonum
rites.text: A basic mending rite taught to all newcomers, it knits the caster's wounds shut at a steady trickle each heartbeat. Two practitioners chanting it together let the body recover even faster.

rites.name: Tiallum Coristes
rites.text: A high-rank healing rite that mends the caster's body over a short span, restoring a set measure of life. Practitioners of the mending arts hold it in great regard.

rites.name: Veostor Vanteorium
rites.text: A binding craft that clouds the sight of its target so their strikes miss more often. It also drags heavily on their limbs, wearing them down faster.

rites.name: Amauntastor
rites.text: A discipline of bare-handed fighting that lets a practitioner strike, wound, and wear down foes even when they cannot be harmed by ordinary weapons. Skilled users can prove as lethal with their fists as with a blade.

rites.name: Amirnanum Corases
rites.text: A novice-level binding of destructive craft that hurls a burst of searing flame and bitter ice at a chosen foe, striking them with both heat and cold on impact.

rites.name: Sallor Vantaules
rites.text: A ritual working that knits flesh back together and restores the caster's vitality. It can only be directed inward, toward the one who performs it.

rites.name: Coreles Sanor
rites.text: A singular incantation that braids together summoning and ruinous force, drawing on two distinct schools of arcane craft at once.

rites.name: Neoristia
rites.text: A singular craft of ruin that saps a foe's stamina and two of their core strengths at once. Only one revered sorcerer of the old orders is known to wield it.

rites.name: Telontanus
rites.text: A caster wraps a shield of crackling storm-force around their body. It shields them from lightning harm and sends a faint jolt into foes who draw near.

rites.name: Corantes Tallor
rites.text: A high-level healing rite that a practitioner invokes to mend their own body. For several moments it steadily restores a modest portion of their vitality.

rites.name: Ventum Ameornelium
rites.text: A innate sharpened perception that a forest-dwelling people carry from birth. It is learned early and grows stronger as the bearer gains skill in the wilds.

rites.name: Orolles Corenes
rites.text: A dweller in the arcane arts that strengthens the force of incantations. It stands in direct contrast to a feeling that saps resolve.

rites.name: Amausor Teleres
rites.text: A chosen wielder releases a cold, forceful blast in a single direction. Anyone struck is turned into a frozen, motionless figure that collapses and suffers chilling harm.

rites.name: Corostia Riarnalia
rites.text: A binding craft that drains an adversary's stamina, leaving them weakened and unable to press a fight or escape from it.

rites.name: Valeonesor
rites.text: A sustaining craft that grants a creature protection against harm from sudden lightning-like force. It belongs to the healing arts and renders the bearer unharmed by charged shocks.

rites.name: Lialaunum
rites.text: A restorative enchantment that briefly sharpens a bowman's steady aim. When the charm fades, the archer's accuracy returns to its former level.

rites.name: Nialernor
rites.text: A temporary healing-art technique that quietly sharpens a person's ability to move unseen. The enhanced stealth fades back to its usual level once the working ends.

rites.name: Siallus Orauntelia
rites.text: A restorative working that quietly lifts the bearer's fortune for a short span of time. Its duration lengthens as the bearer grows in experience.

rites.name: Nintaulus
rites.text: A restorative working that briefly raises the potency of transmutation craft. Once its duration passes, the craft returns to its former strength.

rites.name: Corasiallor
rites.text: A binding craft that thickens a wearer's protective shell. It stands opposite to a force that splits and weakens such shells.

rites.name: Serornenus
rites.text: A high-tier frozen projectile conjured by casters of the mystic arts. It flies like a lesser shard of ice but strikes with far greater force.

rites.name: Vaustenia
rites.text: A sacred chant that a practitioner speaks to drive back restless dead in a surrounding circle. It sometimes fails, but grows more reliable as the speaker gains experience.

rites.name: Oraullium Larnoria
rites.text: A ritual craft by which a warrior of the order calls upon the remembered fallen to steady the living. It belongs to a line of restorative rites practiced in the temples.

rites.name: Tauntiror
rites.text: A restorative working that briefly sharpens a practitioner's hidden insight. Once the working fades, the insight settles back to its former measure.

rites.name: Meornus
rites.text: A restorative craft that fully mends its practitioner's body once each day. It is unlike any other healing art, since it works only on the one who performs it.

rites.name: Amiarnor Liarus
rites.text: A minor illusion craft that silences a chosen target so they cannot work any magic for a brief span. It is taught to apprentices who have advanced beyond the simplest tricks.

rites.name: Sereontor Liastor
rites.text: A ward-art that briefly sharpens a practitioner's power to call forth summoned things. Its strengthening fades once the working runs its course.

rites.name: Loriastor Maurostor
rites.text: A consecrated gesture channeled through the caster's hand that causes a restless dead creature to abandon its assault and retreat in fear.

rites.name: Corauntes Mausia
rites.text: A battle craft that drains an opponent's stamina, leaving them weary and less able to fight or run from a clash.

rites.name: Oristor Talistanum
rites.text: A disciplined inner flame that a warrior of the stalwart order can call upon. It is unlocked once the practitioner reaches the third tier of their training.

rites.name: Ciarnanum Leolor
rites.text: A temporary craft that sharpens a warrior's grasp of the blade. When the working fades, that grasp returns to its former strength.

rites.name: Rianum Coreriallus
rites.text: A restorative craft that briefly strengthens the protective worth of heavy armor. When its effect fades, the armor's worth returns to what it was before.

rites.name: Orauneostia
rites.text: A destructive craft that unleashes searing flame across several foes at once. It harms many targets together with burning force.

rites.name: Oriarelum
rites.text: A temporary sacred discipline that sharpens a practitioner's skill with long swords. The enhancement fades when the rite ends and the warrior returns to their usual mastery.

rites.name: Lirniantus
rites.text: A restorative art that briefly amplifies the strength of healing and mending. Its effect fades once the working ends, returning the practitioner's gift to its ordinary level.

rites.name: Millia Sialistor
rites.text: A chilling affliction that clings to those struck by certain frozen incantations. It spreads from the caster's cold magic onto its target.

rites.name: Tisiarus
rites.text: A restorative craft that temporarily heightens a practitioner's ability to guard against blows. Once the working fades, the defense returns to its former strength.

rites.name: Rallanum
rites.text: A ritual working that kindles a slow burning heat inside a chosen enemy, wearing away their strength with each passing moment.

rites.name: Viantolanum
rites.text: A hardy trait that lets a northern-born wanderer shrug off the biting cold of elemental frost, taking no harm from its icy assault.

rites.name: Serantia Amialles
rites.text: A temple craft that briefly lifts a practitioner's agility far beyond ordinary limits, letting them leap and maneuver with uncanny ease. The effect lasts only a short while before fading away.

rites.name: Seontes Vianoranum
rites.text: A restorative incantation that briefly strengthens a person's skill at fighting without armor. Once the rite fades, that skill returns to its earlier level.

rites.name: Cintiasum
rites.text: A temporary craft that briefly raises a bearer's physical prowess. Once its effect fades, the bearer's strength returns to its former level.

rites.name: Masintes
rites.text: A high-ranked battle incantation that hurls a shard of freezing power at a foe, dealing a heavy chill upon striking the target.

rites.name: Coraules Telaurnes
rites.text: A temporary ritual that sharpens the strength of bludgeoning weapons for a short while. Once the rite fades, the weapon's worth returns to its former measure.

rites.name: Tenes Saulus
rites.text: A learned tongue spoken by small mischievous beings, mastered through study in scholarly halls. Those who command it can soothe such creatures so they refrain from attacking.

rites.name: Mantia Serontianes
rites.text: A protective craft that shields a bearer from harm dealt by ordinary blades and blunt arms. Only strikes carrying a special charm or silvered edge can still wound the one it guards.

rites.name: Sialium Corosum
rites.text: A high-ranked battle incantation that hurls a scorching burst at a foe on contact. It sears the struck target with heavy flame.

rites.name: Amelus Teranum
rites.text: A restorative art that knits a caster's wounds closed and returns their vitality. It draws on the caster's own inner reserves to mend the body.

rites.name: Valiarnes
rites.text: A mid-tier craft of destruction that hurls a burst of searing heat and bitter cold together at a chosen foe, striking with both at once when it lands.

rites.name: Riarum Rastiantium
rites.text: A bonus that sharpens a blade's strike against beasts, carved into a hunting axe. It leaves no visible shimmer on the weapon.

rites.name: Renintes
rites.text: A restorative craft that briefly sharpens the practitioner's skill in reshaping matter. Once the working fades, the skill settles back to its former level.

rites.name: Nilles Amisus
rites.text: A temporary ritual craft that strengthens the protective value of a warrior's mid-weight plating. When the working fades, the plating returns to its ordinary strength.

rites.name: Coristasium
rites.text: A brief condition that renders the bearer unseen for a short span. It can be brewed from compounded reagents and is countered by an effect that reveals hidden things.

rites.name: Coreoranum Nianeosium
rites.text: A temporary craft of the mind that makes an illusionist's art grow stronger for a while. When its duration ends, the craft settles back to its usual strength.

rites.name: Cauntum
rites.text: A restorative craft that briefly strengthens the protection of lightly built armor. The added protection fades once the working ends and the armor returns to its former strength.

rites.name: Telistia Valelium
rites.text: A destructive frost craft in which the caster hurls three shards of ice at once. It closely resembles a single-spike frost technique and is often used by spirit-moths.

rites.name: Amillia Mostium
rites.text: A restorative enchantment that briefly strengthens a guardian's watchfulness. When the working fades, that watchfulness settles back to its former level.

rites.name: Nillum Amirnalles
rites.text: A restorative incantation that briefly sharpens a caster's skill at persuasive speech. When the magic fades, the caster's talent returns to its former level.

rites.name: Orausor Telontia
rites.text: A temporary rite of the restoration art that sharpens a warrior's grip on the spear, returning their skill to its former level once the working fades.

rites.name: Oreonium Coria
rites.text: A minor illusion craft that stirs a bearer's resolve and eagerness to strike foes. Its effect lingers briefly before fading away.

rites.name: Veosantanum
rites.text: A temporary healing-craft that briefly sharpens a person's agility in leaping and tumbling. Once its span ends, the body's nimbleness settles back to how it was.

rites.name: Serilles Teleorum
rites.text: A practiced caster's craft that hurls a jet of searing flame from one palm. Enemies already aflame suffer more harm, and it outpaces and outstrikes its humbler predecessor.

rites.name: Amellus Oranosus
rites.text: A binding craft that lets its target blend into their surroundings so that no onlooker can perceive them. It belongs to the family of illusion arts.

rites.name: Amalauntor
rites.text: A slow, spinning cloud of ice that drifts forward from the caster's hand. It chills anyone caught in its path, wearing down both their vitality and their endurance, but it only reaches a short distance.

rites.name: Contum
rites.text: A protective craft that renders a bearer untouched by flame damage. It belongs to the restorative arts and shields living beings from elemental heat.

rites.name: Telistanum Raurnium
rites.text: A innate bodily trait that lets a chosen wanderer shrug off harm from venom and toxins. Several lesser beasts, restless dead, and clockwork constructs also share this resistance.

rites.name: Ceoriarnes
rites.text: A temporary healing-craft that sharpens a person's skill with small blades. Its hold on that skill fades once the working ends, leaving their ability as it was before.

rites.name: Corellium Rornises
rites.text: A mending craft that the caster turns inward, steadying their resolve against fear and coercion. The steadiness holds for a short span that lengthens as the caster grows in skill.

rites.name: Valaulanum Ciarnia
rites.text: A temporary sacred working that heightens a caster's power to break and shatter things. Once the working fades, the caster's ability returns to its former strength.

rites.name: Senium Riasum
rites.text: A great hidden power is bestowed upon the bearer by a sacred standing stone when darkness falls. Its gift stirs in the blood of those who receive it.

rites.name: Rianirus
rites.text: A ward that a traveler receives after kneeling at a roadside shrine to a sky-dragon deity. It is granted as a blessing to the one who prays there.

rites.name: Tases Teleonornum
rites.text: A combat technique drawn from the fiery arts of a warrior order, where the practitioner lashes out with a cord of molten force. It belongs to a discipline of inner heat used in battle.

rites.name: Nilorium
rites.text: A battle craft that drains an opponent's stamina, leaving them too weary to press an attack or escape a fight.

rites.name: Vauntum Rastum
rites.text: A high-order mystic working that senses every living being within a wide radius of the caster for a short span of time. It reveals hidden breath and heartbeat to anyone skilled enough to invoke it.

rites.name: Narilia
rites.text: An unarmored fighting discipline passed down by a feline people and taught in training halls across their homeland. Its best-known school is a temple where practitioners move with claw-like grace.

rites.name: Tostillia
rites.text: A high-order arcane rite that unravels a great measure of enchantments clinging to the one who performs it. Its power strips away lingering magic from the caster's body and spirit alike.

rites.name: Cesiaria
rites.text: A protective craft that shields its user from both enchanted and physical blows. It is built from a blend of several arcane effects working together.

rites.name: Sirniarum
rites.text: Minor enchantments that cost little strength to invoke and can be used freely at any time. Some folk are born with one, while certain blessings, curses, relics, and trials can also bestow them.

rites.name: Cestes Siallia
rites.text: A minor craft of the lower schools that sets a single thing alight through a simple touch. It is taught early to students who are only beginning to learn the arts of fire.

rites.name: Amosum Tiasia
rites.text: A restorative rite that briefly sharpens a bearer's grasp of unarmored, light, medium and heavy armor techniques. Its effect fades after a short time.

rites.name: Seristia Amonus
rites.text: A masterful arcane ward that gives its caster a quarter chance to turn incoming magic back toward whoever cast it. The ward holds for a short span of heartbeats.

rites.name: Amiallus Orollia
rites.text: A masterful sorcery of ruin that touches a foe and siphons away a great portion of their inner power for a full minute.

rites.name: Mares Orilasor
