rites.text: A temple-taught gift that lets a bearer endure more for a short while. It is drawn through ritual words and works like a quiet spell that steadies the body.

rites.name: Veosum Cesteoria
rites.text: A mage of the dark-skinned folk who dwells in a walled waystation at a coastal hold. She teaches the arts of sorcery to those who seek her out.

rites.name: Rasternium
rites.text: A ruinous craft that stirs a venom within a foe's body, wearing down their vitality over time. It belongs to the arts of harmful working.

rites.name: Nillostium
rites.text: A blessing granted to a wanderer who kneels before a roadside shrine of the sky-mother. The gift is a sacred power bestowed by the shrine on whoever prays there.

rites.name: Vauseoles
rites.text: A high-level craft of destruction that hurls a crackling bolt of storm energy at a foe. On impact it delivers a heavy jolt of shock to the target.

rites.name: Sollanum Sauntor
rites.text: A rare sacred craft that briefly raises a bearer's fortune. Its use is singular among known practices and is tied to ruling lines of the old orders.

rites.name: Orianolus
rites.text: A learned perk and its matching incantations from the transmutation arts, which raise the caster's protection against blows and can be cast twice at once.

rites.name: Castium Corauses
rites.text: This is a crafted effect known within the alchemical arts. Its nature is recorded only in part.

rites.name: Maurnor Valonus
rites.text: A fighting discipline that governs how well a warrior wields long edged weapons. Single-handed blades are quick and allow a shield, while two-handed blades strike harder but leave the bearer unguarded.

rites.name: Leornor
rites.text: A tiring hex of the lesser arcane schools that drains a target's stamina sharply for a short span of moments after it strikes.

rites.name: Coriallanes
rites.text: A quiet, lasting gift that lets a body knit its wounds faster. Every mending that reaches the wearer is strengthened, with the gift deepening as more of it is taken up.

rites.name: Nellirnia
rites.text: A brewed quality that quietly drains a practitioner's inner reserve over time. The effect lingers after the initial application, slowly wearing down the pool of arcane energy.

rites.name: Malleoranum
rites.text: A shared night in a bonded home grants a lasting surge of learning. Anyone wedded and settled can wake each day sharpening every craft faster for a while.

rites.name: Vaunernum
rites.text: A ward of ruin woven into doors and chests that unleashes a burst of destructive force when someone disturbs it. Such hidden snares are scattered across the wild lands of a distant isle.

rites.name: Taullarus
rites.text: A mid-level craft of arcane force that a practitioner delivers by hand. Upon touch it sends a jolt of crackling energy into the target, dealing sharp harm.

rites.name: Ranus
rites.text: A practitioner's craft that lets the caster walk across the surface of water for a set span of time. It is a rare kind of reshaping magic, distinct from other transformations.

rites.name: Mianum Lestus
rites.text: A quiet, always-active discipline practiced by sworn guardians of a temple order, who channel radiant energy into their daily craft. It belongs to a sacred tradition of restoring glowing essence.

rites.name: Orernia Amoranum
rites.text: A learned spell-craft used by ritual casters that calls forth a surge of raw energy. It belongs to a lineage of storm-summoning techniques.

rites.name: Ameollium Maroles
rites.text: A minor offensive art taught to novice casters, it releases a crackling bolt of sky-fire that strikes a single foe. It belongs to the school of destructive magic.

rites.name: Lianium Saurnum
rites.text: A once-daily power granted to those born under a particular star sign. It cannot be stifled by magical muting.

rites.name: Rases Marnes
rites.text: A minor spell of the destructive arts that a novice caster can use. Upon casting, it saps the reserve of arcane energy from a target for half a minute.

rites.name: Sasia Oreollum
rites.text: A channeled technique practiced by sorcerers within a storm-summoning discipline. It lets the user take on a crackling, electrical shape.

rites.name: Nintia Amenus
rites.text: A minor sorcerous rite that strips away magical effects clinging to the caster. Novice practitioners learn it early in their studies.

rites.name: Corasium
rites.text: A high-skill enchantment that raises the bearer's resistance to jolts and strengthens their protective plating by a third for half a minute.

rites.name: Telauntium Vestanum
rites.text: A learned rite of restorative craft, taught at a middling level of skill, that is gathered into tomes and passed among practitioners. It is one of several arts recorded in such collections.

rites.name: Cialenor
rites.text: A shaping craft that lifts the caster into the air, letting them drift above the ground and reach places that would otherwise be out of reach.

rites.name: Castires
rites.text: A quiet fortune that touches every craft a person practices without belonging to any one of them. It shields the bearer from sickness when strong, and when weak it lets pitfalls spring until one finally holds.

rites.name: Naulia Coriarnia
rites.text: A restorative incantation that briefly shields the caster against harm to their inner arcane reserves. Its protection fades after a short while.

rites.name: Niaror Serisor
rites.text: A basic arcane incantation that reveals every living creature within a short radius of the caster for a brief span of moments. It is taught early to novices of the mystic arts.

rites.name: Selliarnum
rites.text: A ward-craft that turns hostile sorcery back upon the one who cast it. The caster must take up the arcane arts of inner reflection to bind it.

rites.name: Viraunes Marnus
rites.text: A quiet, learned discipline that lets an archer's hand grow steadier at great distance. It is practiced by those who have reached the fifth tier of their bow training.

rites.name: Corontinor
rites.text: A ritual technique that a warrior channels through a heavy hammer to unleash retribution. It is practiced as an active skill alongside that bound weapon.

rites.name: Liaror Serolus
rites.text: A high-skill battle craft that channels crackling storm energy through a touch, striking a foe with a heavy jolt of shock. Practitioners learn it through disciplined study of destructive arts.

rites.name: Valelia Valeornor
rites.text: A healing touch that a practitioner can bestow with bare palms to lift a lingering affliction from a sufferer. It is a minor gift, used once to free a cursed companion during a merciful rite.

rites.name: Reollanum Tauntor
rites.text: A temporary grace granted by a priest during a chance meeting. It lasts half an hour and is bestowed upon a wanderer.

rites.name: Nisia Telauntes
rites.text: A ward of crackling current that a caster weaves around the body to answer blows with a jolt. It belongs to the study of changing matter and is steered by inner resolve.

rites.name: Cosanum Corantum
rites.text: A ward of ruin that unleashes a crackling burst of force when a hidden snare is set off. It guards doors and coffers in the ruined halls of an old sunken city.

rites.name: Oroliarnium
rites.text: A temporary rite of restoration that heightens a practitioner's skill in transmutation craft. When the rite ends, the skill settles back to its earlier level.

rites.name: Amaurnum Serillum
rites.text: A temporary enchantment that sharpens a speaker's persuasive eloquence for a while. Once it fades, the speaker's skill returns to its former level, and the strength of the boost depends on how much it raises that skill.

rites.name: Vosaurnor
rites.text: A dark rite in which a fallen follower gives up a portion of their vitality to a shadowed patron. It was once known by a harsher name before an later revision reshaped it.

rites.name: Coriarnium Viastes
rites.text: A mid-tier trickery craft that lets a practitioner bend how others perceive a moment. It is taught to apprentices who have progressed past basic deceptions.

rites.name: Tirum Tiallonium
rites.text: A temporary rite that sharpens a smith's hand for weapon and armor work, lifting their craft beyond its usual reach until the rite fades and their skill returns to its former measure.

rites.name: Nernor
rites.text: A restorative incantation that briefly sharpens a bearer's mastery of bludgeoning arms. When the working fades, the bearer's skill falls back to its former level, and the gain equals the amount of the boost.

rites.name: Oralleores Mises
rites.text: A temporary ward of restorative craft that lets a wearer's skill in bearing heavy plate grow for a while. When the ward fades, that skill settles back to what it was before.

rites.name: Vistollium
rites.text: A quiet, always-active discipline that a warrior order teaches to its initiates. It sharpens their combat readiness without requiring any conscious effort to use.

rites.name: Seroleonus
rites.text: A restorative rite that briefly sharpens a warrior's skill in wearing mid-weight plate. When the rite fades, the skill settles back to its former level.

rites.name: Vanor Testaurnium
rites.text: A restorative enchantment that briefly sharpens a bowman's aim, lifting their skill with arrows for a short span before it fades back to its former level.

rites.name: Amontum Minaustum
rites.text: A restorative ritual that briefly sharpens a wearer's skill in handling lightweight protective gear. The enhancement fades once the ritual's duration ends, and its strength is measured by how much the skill rises.

rites.name: Milia Teosum
rites.text: A restorative incantation that briefly sharpens a practitioner's gift for nimble tumbling and leaping. When the working fades, the gift returns to its former strength, and the boost's size matches the added measure of agility.

rites.name: Serireosium
rites.text: A restorative enchantment that briefly sharpens a person's running and climbing prowess. Once the magic fades, their natural agility returns to its former level.

rites.name: Amiasolles
rites.text: A chanted refrain that the devoted recite after taking in the teachings of a masked sorcerer, and which guides the building of his shrines around sacred standing stones.

rites.name: Causteonum
rites.text: A temporary restorative working that briefly heightens a practitioner's skill in ruinous force. The added strength fades once the working ends, returning the skill to its former level.

rites.name: Nianteorium
rites.text: A restorative incantation that briefly sharpens a bearer's natural nimbleness when no armor is worn. Once the chant fades, the bearer's agility settles back to its former measure.

rites.name: Siantarnus Amaneoranum
rites.text: A restorative incantation that briefly sharpens a crafter's talent for binding enchantments into objects. The added skill fades once the working ends, and its strength sets how much the talent grows.

rites.name: Listeores
rites.text: A long-reaching hex that locks its victim in place for a brief span of time. Its chance to take hold grows as the caster gains experience, and so does the length of the stillness.

rites.name: Teleorostes
rites.text: A healing craft that briefly raises a practitioner's grasp of transmutation. The gain fades once the working ends, and its strength matches the amount added.

rites.name: Vasiria
rites.text: A low-tier illusion craft taught to novice casters, letting the user shape a brief command over a listener's mind. It belongs to the entry rank of the mystic schools.

rites.name: Raunteosium
rites.text: A passive discipline practiced by sworn guardians of a light-bearing order. It is one of the restorative crafts drawn from the same tradition that fosters renewal and healing.

rites.name: Tallium Rintanum
rites.text: A small restorative incantation taught to beginners in the healing arts. When spoken, it returns a modest measure of the caster's weariness, easing their exhaustion.

rites.name: Mornium
rites.text: A temporary rite of restoration that heightens a caster's summoning craft for a short span. Once the rite ends, the craft quietly returns to its former strength.

rites.name: Veonaustus
rites.text: A ward-craft of the temple healers that briefly sharpens a warrior's guard. When the working fades, the guard returns to its former strength, and the strength gained is the measure of the working.

rites.name: Liarum
rites.text: A temporary craft that sharpens a warrior's skill with the spear for a short span. When the craft fades, the skill slips back to its former level, with the gain measured by how much it rose.

rites.name: Viarum Rarus
rites.text: A restorative incantation that briefly sharpens a person's talent for moving unseen. When its hold fades, that talent returns to its former strength.

rites.name: Telernantia
rites.text: A beginner's charm of false kindness, where a touch briefly warms a target's feelings toward the caster. The effect lasts only a short while before fading away.

rites.name: Milium Niallus
rites.text: A low-rank arcane working that a novice caster can perform to force open a simple locking mechanism on a chosen target. It shapes the structure of the lock itself so that its bolt yields.

rites.name: Sentor Rarnes
rites.text: A hidden craft that lets a bearer merge into the surrounding scenery so no watcher can spot them. It also sharpens the bearer's aim and strikes in close combat.

rites.name: Tellasium
rites.text: A restorative incantation that briefly sharpens a bearer's skill with small blades. The gained skill fades once the incantation ends, and its strength equals the amount of skill added.

rites.name: Oreollastes
rites.text: A passive discipline practiced by ritual-bound guardians who restore inner radiance. It belongs to a line of sacred practices that mend and renew a warrior's luminous essence.

rites.name: Ronor
rites.text: A restorative working that briefly sharpens a person's talent for guarding and locking away valuables. When the working fades, that talent reverts to its former level. The strength of the boost determines how much keener the guardian becomes.

rites.name: Meorum Serialeres
rites.text: A temporary craft that sharpens a practitioner's grasp of hidden arcane forces for a short span. When it fades, the mind returns to its former measure of skill.

rites.name: Valoneontus
rites.text: A restorative ward-craft that strengthens a person's defenses against a wasting plague of the flesh. It is cast upon the body to make it harder for the sickness to take hold.

rites.name: Orestor Mirnestia
rites.text: A basic mystic working that lets a caster sense every living creature nearby for a short span. It reaches a modest distance around the one who invokes it.

rites.name: Valeorus Seoranum
rites.text: A temporary binding craft that sharpens a warrior's skill with a chopping blade for a short span. Once the working fades, the warrior's ability returns to what it was before, and the strength of the boost is set by the working itself.

rites.name: Oriantia Mialus
rites.text: A restorative rite that briefly sharpens a warrior's mastery of the longsword. Once the rite fades, the skill settles back to its former level, and the strength of the boost sets how much keener the blade-work becomes.

rites.name: Vistes Oriallastia
rites.text: A card-like rite that quietly sets a hidden resting place into the deck of a collection. It is played as an action in its stack.

rites.name: Orirnum Amaustollia
rites.text: A novice incantation of inner arcane craft that unravels a small measure of enchantment clinging to the one who speaks it. It strips away magical effects from the caster's own body.

rites.name: Lelia
rites.text: A high-level art of bending perception, taught to those who have mastered the lesser mind-shaping crafts. It lets a caster command others through woven false impressions.

rites.name: Vesalles
rites.text: A restorative incantation that briefly sharpens a practitioner's talent for deception and false images. The sharpened talent fades back to its former strength once the incantation ends.

rites.name: Valiasernus
rites.text: A high-order mystic working that lets a caster bend nearby objects to their will for a minute. Its reach extends across a modest circle around the practitioner.

rites.name: Lanentium
rites.text: A restorative craft that mends the wounds of the one who casts it. It draws on gentle healing power to close injuries and restore strength to the caster.

rites.name: Mirnases
rites.text: A restorative craft that grants the bearer a surge of nimbleness and quickness. It is practised by healers who draw upon gentle, restorative arts.

rites.name: Valaurnus Losintes
rites.text: A hex-craft that briefly drains an opponent's fortune, making their chances turn against them. It belongs to the destructive arts practiced by temple scholars.

rites.name: Vauleostium
rites.text: A ritual observed by a sect of scholarly mystics that empowers beneficial spirits and weakens harmful ones. It is performed alongside a companion ceremony.

rites.name: Maullus Valelornia
rites.text: A novice illusion craft that bathes the area near the caster in soft pale light. The glow lasts for a couple of minutes around the one who weaves it.

rites.name: Sinus Coreolor
rites.text: A bound incantation granted by a shadowed patron of forgotten knowledge. The caster traps the spirit of a slain being inside a carved stone that the patron hands over.

rites.name: Naleonia
rites.text: A sovereign discipline that a ruler may cultivate through a branch of ancient training. It is taught within the lineage of the highest throne-holders.

rites.name: Orallum Liarnium
rites.text: A restorative working that briefly raises the worth of a bearer's vitality. It belongs to the healing arts practiced by the temple scholars.

rites.name: Cianternium
rites.text: A grim craft held by a warrior order, drawn from a dark ritual tradition. It is unlocked once a fighter reaches the fifth rank of the order's discipline.

rites.name: Rauntiares
rites.text: A grave-spirit grants a chosen wanderer a shadowed art after they stand upon a moon-marked stone. Once each day they may return to a still dark pool to exchange it for another hidden gift.

rites.name: Teleontanum Orilosus
rites.text: A lasting trait that a person gains early in a shadowy affliction, leaving their stride nearly silent. It forms the first stage of that cursed condition.

rites.name: Sirneolum Riastus
rites.text: A mind-piercing illusion that fills a foe's thoughts with a jarring hum, scattering their focus. For a brief span the victim finds it hard to shape magic.

rites.name: Vernia Telesaunium
rites.text: A shadowy sacred enchantment that a hooded keeper of a secret assassins' circle may grant as an extra reward after a murder-mystery errand. It is a boon of the night's favor.

rites.name: Valisor Serausium
rites.text: A temple-taught craft that lets the bearer see clearly in deep gloom. The world turns to a cold blue tint, so shadows reveal themselves while true colors fade away.

rites.name: Coresinus
rites.text: A dark rite that smothers all light around a caster and their companions, so that their torches gutter out. The wielder then faces the fearful ones who dwell in the gloom.

rites.name: Vintesium Serintium
rites.text: A quiet restorative working that a caster draws upon themselves to slightly sharpen their quickness and balance. Its duration grows the more seasoned the caster becomes.

rites.name: Valiantoria
rites.text: A gentle healing rite taught to novice casters, which slowly restores the user's vitality for a brief moment after it is invoked.

rites.name: Orines Amauntanum
rites.text: A quiet illusion that the caster draws over their own steps, leaving them unheard as they move. It lingers for a set span and can be strengthened by casting it twice.

rites.name: Miastaurnus
rites.text: A minor healing craft that restores strength only to the restless dead. It works just like a common touch-mending art, but living bodies gain nothing from it.

rites.name: Restus Ronteolium
rites.text: A novice incantation of quiet transformation that unbinds the simplest of locks when a caster directs it toward the mechanism. It works only on the most basic fastenings.

rites.name: Solleosanum
rites.text: A restorative rite used by temple scribes to return swiftness to a worn body. It works by renewing a traveler's pace so their steps regain lost speed.

rites.name: Coreranum Corasollus
rites.text: A restorative incantation taught in the orders that renews a person's inner resolve. Practitioners chant it to recover their willpower when it has been worn thin.

rites.name: Mianaria
rites.text: A restorative incantation that strengthens a bearer's body against everyday sicknesses. It belongs to the healing craft and is cast upon a single recipient.

rites.name: Mialernia
rites.text: A high-ranking inscribed scroll of reshaping craft. When its incantation is spoken and the bearer touches a stubborn bolt, the bolt yields and springs open.

rites.name: Saranum Vinor
rites.text: A temporary ritual charm that raises a caster's gift for trade and their fortune for a short span. It is cast as a restorative working.

rites.name: Riastausum
rites.text: A restorative working drawn from the temple orders that renews a person's physical vigor. It is cast to bring back lost bodily strength.

rites.name: Varosia
rites.text: A fighter's technique drawn from a lineage of earth-bound warriors. It hardens a foe's body into inert rock for a short while.

rites.name: Veolus Villium
rites.text: A hardened shard-wall that a combat adept raises from the ground to absorb blows. It belongs to a stone-hearted discipline of warriors.

rites.name: Meoria Valestirnus
rites.text: A restorative ritual that returns a person's fortune and chance to them. It is performed through the craft of mending, drawing back what was lost.

rites.name: Rallisium
rites.text: A mid-level incantation of shaping that unlatches any ordinary lock it is aimed at. The caster touches the target and the bolt yields.

rites.name: Maurnor Nintaustus
rites.text: A quiet inner craft that lowers the strength drained whenever a fighter raises a guard against blows. It works without being called upon, always running in the background of the body.

rites.name: Telosiastor
rites.text: A hidden craft manner taught through a folded scroll of marks, where a dark pigment made from ash scraps is used to shape the work. It is learned by studying one specific marked sheet.

rites.name: Ventium Taures
rites.text: A simple charm of undoing that releases any lightly fashioned lock it is aimed at. Novice enchanters learn it early as a first step in shaping matter.

rites.name: Serelia Telialornus
rites.text: A hidden ward woven of false light that locks the limbs of whoever sets it off. It lies dormant in doors and coffers until someone touches it.

rites.name: Teostes Orirnolanum
rites.text: A quiet, lasting discipline practiced by dark-arts casters, drawn from the ordered inner craft of their circle. It works continuously in the background, asking nothing of the practitioner.

rites.name: Vausiastium
rites.text: A binding craft that locks a single foe in place upon a touch, holding them motionless for a stretch that grows with the caster's experience. Its hold is unreliable, and skill slowly improves the odds that it takes.

rites.name: Siareollium
rites.text: A ritual discipline that lets a wielder of a heavy blade hold steady against despair. It is practiced alongside that weapon in battle.

rites.name: Launeontum
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that bends the minds of listeners toward the speaker's will. It works constantly in the background, granting its bearer a steady edge in sway and argument.

rites.name: Lareornia
rites.text: A learned speech of the hulking warrior folk that a wanderer may master through keen reasoning. Once understood, the brutish kin of the hills are less likely to turn their blades against the speaker.

rites.name: Serollistor
rites.text: A restorative rite that a practitioner invokes to purge their own body of sickness and toxins. It draws on the healing arts to cleanse the caster of plagues, ordinary illnesses, and venom.

rites.name: Nariastor
rites.text: A quiet working of hidden craft that springs shut bolts and sealed lids alike, requiring neither patience nor tools. It belongs to the practice of reshaping matter through will.

rites.name: Meollarus
rites.text: A bewitching illusion that briefly dulls a creature's instinct to run from danger. Frightened beasts stand their ground for a short while under its pull.

rites.name: Serneonia Serinia
rites.text: A guarding craft that a warrior calls upon with one hand and a shield, letting them harden their defense against piercing strikes.

rites.name: Telesor Tarnanum
rites.text: A ritual craft that swells the bearer's physical force, letting them strike harder blows. The working is cast upon oneself and grants greater power in combat.

rites.name: Serintanum Causteontum
rites.text: A quiet enchantment that briefly weakens a person's urge to run from danger. Those touched by it stand firmer when facing an attacker, though only for a short while.

rites.name: Amiantanum Tontium
rites.text: A sacred gift is granted to one who walks the full circuit of nine holy waystones. The reward is a lasting blessing that strengthens the devoted traveler.

rites.name: Tiroles
rites.text: A practiced leaping strike drawn from the howling kin's lineage of hunters. It is one of the techniques taught within their inherited craft of shifting-blood combat.

rites.name: Cernantes
rites.text: A harmful craft that works by spreading a toxic essence into a foe, causing them to suffer damage over time. It can be cast at close range or launched across a distance.

rites.name: Sintaunus
rites.text: A disciplined technique of hurling a long shaft with a holy warrior's precision. It belongs to a sacred school of spear arts practiced by the order's martial brethren.

rites.name: Orarnillus
rites.text: A mid-level mystical working that lets a caster move nearby objects within about twenty feet using only the will, lasting roughly half a minute.

rites.name: Colleorium
rites.text: A searing light-craft that a warrior order uses to crush foes beneath blinding radiance. It is a variant of a stronger sunfire technique taught within the same disciplined training path.

rites.name: Cauntum Tiraullum
rites.text: A quiet inner craft practiced by mage-scholars that lets a summoner draw steady strength from a bound shard of otherworldly stone. It is passively sustained within the summoning arts of its order.

rites.name: Amolor Vosor
rites.text: A illusion craft that steadies a beast's nerve, lowering the measure of its wish to flee so it keeps fighting. Its counter-craft drives the same measure upward, sending the creature running.

rites.name: Lausostium
rites.text: A harsh ice-working that bursts forth when a buried trap is set off by a careless foot. It is woven into the old hidden tunnels beneath a forgotten city.

rites.name: Telaustoria
rites.text: A mind-bending craft that lowers a humanoid's resolve to flee, so the target keeps fighting rather than running from the clash. Its counter-art instead drives a foe to break and run.

rites.name: Oronium Miarnia
rites.text: A chanted devotion that honors a forest-spirit by praising the night canopy, the watchful birds, and the patient serpents. It asks the singer to let past and future drift away and to move freely in the present.

rites.name: Oriliastum
rites.text: A practiced technique in which a fighter drives a narrow blade forward with force to pierce an opponent. It belongs to the discipline of wielding a single weapon paired with a guarding shield.

rites.name: Tiarum Renes
rites.text: A quiet, always-on talent taught to light-armored wardens of a temple order. It strengthens the wearer's natural aptitude without any need to activate it.

rites.name: Ranes
rites.text: A combat art within a warrior's training path that becomes open to practitioners once they reach the second tier of assault mastery.

rites.name: Sasintium Vellium
rites.text: A draining force that saps the reserves of inner power held within a living being. It works by slowly eroding the target's capacity to channel spells.

rites.name: Solenia
rites.text: A restorative craft that mends the body of its practitioner. It knits wounds back together over time.

rites.name: Orintanum Corollus
rites.text: A battle technique taught to warrior-monks who wield long shafts. It is one of the active forms within a weapon discipline of sacred spears.

rites.name: Teorus
rites.text: A minor binding craft that clouds a creature's mind, driving it to strike at any companion close by for a short span of time.

rites.name: Amianus Seristia
rites.text: A ward-craft that softens the harm of venom and toxins. It is counted among the basic protective disciplines and can be woven into armor or charms.

rites.name: Lolernum
rites.text: A practiced archer's technique that coats a loosed shaft with venom. It is learned once a bowman reaches a certain level of skill with the longbow.

rites.name: Sonteollium
rites.text: A mid-tier binding craft that weakens the resolve of restless dead creatures it strikes, lowering their boldness for half a minute.

rites.name: Caurellum
rites.text: A quiet talent that sometimes doubles the yield of raw materials gathered from stone, hide, or timber. It is a reliable blessing that favors patient gatherers.

rites.name: Oreornanum Ternanum
rites.text: A hushing rite of the mind that unravels a lingering enchantment from its bearer. It cannot touch afflictions of blood or bone, nor the steady auras that never fade.

rites.name: Verastum
rites.text: A passive discipline practiced by a sacred order of warrior-guardians, who bend light within their own strikes. It needs no conscious call and quietly works as the wielder fights.

rites.name: Cirnenus
rites.text: A sacred craft in which a devoted caster draws on a long-trained chant to unleash a supreme restorative working. It belongs to a disciplined branch of healing rites taught in temple halls.

rites.name: Nellasium
rites.text: A temple-taught working that briefly quickens a traveler's pace. When its span ends, the swiftness drains back to its former level.

rites.name: Marus Tarnium
rites.text: A restorative incantation that hardens the body against toxins, lessening the harm that poison inflicts on its bearer.

rites.name: Mauntia Lereostia
rites.text: A harmful craft by which a caster channels venom through the hand, striking a target and wounding them with toxic force.

rites.name: Vostauria
rites.text: A trained gift of swift instinct that belongs to the blocking discipline of a warrior's school. It is one of nine such arts recorded within that craft.

rites.name: Noses Amentines
rites.text: A ward-craft that unleashes a charged fire of stored force whenever a hidden snare set into ancient halls is set off. It answers the trigger of old ruin-mechanisms with a burst of harmful energy.

rites.name: Mialus Niasanum
rites.text: A gentle healing craft that hardens a person's body against the spreading rot of sickness. It is taught as a quiet art of mending and steadiness.

rites.name: Laurnium Maurnalor
rites.text: A binding craft that stirs a fallen humanoid back into motion for a brief span. It cannot rouse beasts or monsters, only people.

rites.name: Orostanum Teleolia
rites.text: A mind-bending charm that steadies the nerve of nearby creatures, filling them with resolve so they stop wanting to run and fight instead. It also briefly strengthens their vitality for a short span.

rites.name: Nintes Orillus
rites.text: A master archer's final technique that lets the bowman loose arrows in quick succession. It is learned only after the bowman reaches the highest rank in archery.

rites.name: Moselia
rites.text: A ceremonial spear technique used by sacred guardians, in which the wielder spins the weapon in a wide arc to strike every foe surrounding them.

rites.name: Corerastum
rites.text: A basic conjuring art that calls a fallen body back to a hollow semblance of movement, letting a caster bend the dead to their will. It is learned early, as a student's first step into summoning.

rites.name: Orisus Liantus
rites.text: A mystic rite that lets a caster snap themselves back across a wide land in a flash. It serves both as an escape from peril and as a swift way to cross long distances.

rites.name: Ninus Serirum
rites.text: A restorative incantation that briefly swells the caster's reserve of inner power. The surge fades after a short while, leaving the mage with a larger wellspring of magic for that span.

rites.name: Laleornia
rites.text: A shaping craft lets its wielder breathe beneath the water while swimming faster for a time. It is a rare working of transformation.

rites.name: Ciranum Coreles
rites.text: A quiet, always-active discipline that lets a caster's sorcery slip past defenses. It belongs to a staff-wielding school of ruinous craft.

rites.name: Canisum
rites.text: A binding craft that wraps a bearer in a sheltering layer against harm. It stands opposite to a spell that leaves a bearer exposed.

rites.name: Sereosiria
rites.text: A hidden craft that is set upon locked doors and coffers, releasing a noxious venom onto whoever triggers it. It is found scattered across the wild lands of the island.

rites.name: Corentus Amiarasum
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline practiced by night-walking blade-initiates, passively renewing their vitality whenever they move through darkness. It belongs to a shadow-craft tradition taught in their order.

rites.name: Teornium Lirnanum
rites.text: A quiet inborn knack that lets its bearer move through rivers and pools without slowing, and recover breath faster while swimming.

rites.name: Seonus Raria
rites.text: A restorative craft that returns lost bodily vigor to a bearer. It stands as the direct counterpart to a draining art that strips such vigor away.

rites.name: Valeostia Rostauntia
rites.text: A restorative ward that softens the bite of bitter cold on whoever bears it. It guards against freezing harm but does not harden the body against blows.

rites.name: Oronestus
rites.text: A restorative craft that gradually mends the health of whoever practices it. It belongs to the family of healing arts known as Restoration.

rites.name: Casaulor
rites.text: A restorative charm that guards the bearer against a wasting sickness of the flesh. It draws on inner resolve, and its casting consumes a modest reserve of spiritual energy.

rites.name: Neles Seriasanum
rites.text: A mid-level healing craft that mends a companion's wounds and restores a burst of stamina over a few heartbeats. It is practiced by those who have mastered the basic arts of restoration.

rites.name: Valirnium Larnes
rites.text: A restorative ward that bolsters the body against ordinary sicknesses. Practitioners of the healing arts draw on the inner resolve of the mind to power it.

rites.name: Rorestia Leonia
rites.text: A trained technique of drawing a steady glow back into a wounded circle of allies. Its practitioners are sworn to a gentle order of restorers.

rites.name: Telernes
rites.text: A sacred discipline taught within a warrior order, in which a practitioner channels a gleaming power meant to turn back the glow of the sky. It belongs to a line of rites tied to the dawn's fury.

rites.name: Valereolor
rites.text: A quiet inner craft that slowly refills a caster's reserve of arcane strength over time. It belongs to the healing arts and is taught as an add-on discipline to those who already practise them.

rites.name: Amollarnor
rites.text: A mending art drawn from the school of renewal, guided by inner resolve. It costs a small measure of spiritual reserve to cast.

rites.name: Orosanum Sereolium
rites.text: A restorative craft of the healing arts, guided by inner resolve, that dissolves hexes laid upon a person. It draws a modest measure of mana from the caster.

rites.name: Riasentor
rites.text: A dread-working drawn from the mind's inner fires. It siphons a portion of a target's resolve and channels that resolve into the one who casts it.

rites.name: Toliases
rites.text: A minor arcane art that lets a practitioner nudge nearby objects by will alone, within a short reach and for a brief span of moments.

rites.name: Soles Velires
rites.text: A once-daily dark art granted to the blood-drinkers once they reach their third stage of undeath. It lets a feeder pause mid-battle to mend their body and wits, and it is especially useful against a crowd of foes.

rites.name: Amosteolum
rites.text: A restorative healing craft that returns a traveler's stamina to its original level. It belongs to the gentle mending arts practiced by hedge-healers and temple initiates.

rites.name: Ciantes Meneolum
rites.text: A healing working that mends wounds and renews strength, slowly returning a bearer's vitality and lost abilities toward their full measure. It is commonly taught as a branch of restorative sorcery.

rites.name: Valiles Telilaunum
rites.text: A blessing that returns good fortune to the bearer. It stands as the direct opposite of a curse that saps that fortune away.

rites.name: Mollium Tonastium
rites.text: A restorative craft that replenishes a wanderer's inner resolve. It stands as the direct reverse of a draining force that saps that same resolve.

rites.name: Naullus Liarnia
rites.text: A ward-craft that steadies the mind against arcane force. It draws on inner resolve rather than outside power, and costs a small measure of the caster's reserve to hold.

rites.name: Teres Senanum
rites.text: A ritual craft that lets a seeker win the right to learn two advanced healing-magic workings from a keeper of a hidden scholarly hall. The keeper must be persuaded before the secrets are passed on.

rites.name: Valorirnes
rites.text: A sacred technique of the Lightbound orders that draws upon a hallowed skill line to mend allies. It is a transformed form of an older rite.

rites.name: Ciallaustor
rites.text: A combat technique in which a wielder with a great blade in both hands turns the weapon mid-swing and strikes back across the body. It belongs to a disciplined school of two-handed fighting.

rites.name: Lanirnor
rites.text: A ward of mystic craft that turns an incoming enchantment back upon the one who cast it. Its strength is a percentage, so a full ward can make its bearer immune to hostile sorcery for a short span.

rites.name: Cinus Vialeostia
rites.text: A basic healing charm taught to novice casters. It restores a small measure of a target's vitality and stamina for a brief moment.

rites.name: Cestus Vauntollia
rites.text: A sacred working of healing light that drives back weaker risen dead from the caster's presence. It is practiced by skilled adepts of restorative arts.

rites.name: Rarnes Manor
rites.text: A ritual working that strips away harmful magical qualities from a bound object or person. It lifts any unwanted sorcerous attributes, leaving the subject clean of them.

rites.name: Telestes Teliantinum
rites.text: A mid-tier healing rite that a practitioner performs to mend their own body. It restores a portion of their vitality and stamina in a brief surge.

rites.name: Telentor Tiarestes
rites.text: A restorative craft that slowly renews the vital essence and bodily strength of the one who wields it. Its healing gathers over time rather than arriving all at once.

rites.name: Sillosium
rites.text: A learned rite of summoning that lets a caster call back certain fallen foes from death to fight at the caster's side. It is practiced by those who have mastered the middling arts of conjured magic.

rites.name: Taurosium
rites.text: A basic healing craft taught to novice practitioners. When cast, it mends a small measure of the caster's bodily vigor and restores a brief surge of stamina.

rites.name: Sesintor
rites.text: A restorative craft that returns a bearer's swiftness after it has been lost. It stands as the direct opposite of a draining art that saps that same swiftness.

rites.name: Amastus Miasium
rites.text: A restorative craft of the healing arts, drawn from inner resolve, that grants the bearer steadfast protection against wasting sickness. Its channeling demands a modest reserve of mystic energy.

rites.name: Valiarum Meollianum
rites.text: A sacred ward that hardens a bearer against harm from hostile forces. Its strength is measured as a share of blocked damage or a shift in the odds of being struck by lingering afflictions.

rites.name: Ciares
rites.text: A temporary rite of restoration that a caster can perform to strengthen their stamina. Its effect lasts only a short while before fading away.

rites.name: Telaurium Amaunium
rites.text: A restorative ritual craft that renews all of a warrior's combat disciplines at once. It belongs to the healing arts and is practiced by those who guard the battle-hardened.

rites.name: Nasteontum
rites.text: A mending craft from the healing arts that draws on inner resolve to return lost strength to a body's core qualities. It costs a small measure of the caster's reserve to perform.

rites.name: Seraullia Valontes
rites.text: A restorative rite that renews every swiftness-related ability of the one it is cast upon. It is a healing art practiced by temple scholars to recover lost quickness.

rites.name: Tania Viasus
rites.text: A restorative working that briefly raises the vitality of a chosen being, letting its life force swell beyond the usual measure for a short span.

rites.name: Orauntum Testanum
rites.text: A binding craft in which a caster seals a foe inside a ring of carved sigils. The trap holds the captive until the sigils are broken or the spell fades.

rites.name: Oranintium
rites.text: A inherited magical craft that raises the practitioner's ability to both defend against harm and strike back with greater force. It flows through a bloodline and is drawn on through a variety of enchanted effects.

rites.name: Leornum
rites.text: A restorative rite that brings back every core trait a bearer has lost. It works on all of the caster's primary qualities at once.

rites.name: Tillausia
rites.text: A group rite that bonds several participants who each hold a special token. Those who perform it together gain an extra measure of growth in their shared journey.

rites.name: Coreriastus
rites.text: A restorative working that heals ordinary sicknesses and returns the body to health. Practitioners of the healing arts invoke it to drive out common ailments.

rites.name: Restirium
rites.text: A protective craft from the healing arts that steadies the body against being locked in place. It is drawn from inner resolve rather than raw strength of will.

rites.name: Oriantium Valeolistum
rites.text: A calling-craft that drives a restless dead creature to abandon its attack and flee in terror. It works only on the undead.

rites.name: Sauseollum
rites.text: A sacred rite performed at first light that purges the blood-sickness from a afflicted person. It may be sought at any time after the sickness takes hold and can be repeated as often as one wishes.

rites.name: Teleneontia Nelus
rites.text: A sacred working that drains vitality from a chosen foe and transfers the same measure into the caster's own body. It belongs to the mystic arts practiced by hidden scholars.

rites.name: Seraullinus
rites.text: A restorative art that renews the arcane abilities of a practitioner. It mends every magical faculty a caster has, returning them to full strength.

rites.name: Ceollor Sornus
rites.text: A passive gift of the body that lets a being endure hardship. It has been known by several different names over time.

rites.name: Rauria Orelles
rites.text: A restorative rite that returns all of a wanderer's hidden-moving arts to full strength. It is cast by those who have spent their talents too freely.

rites.name: Neles Seornanum
rites.text: A restorative incantation that briefly strengthens a bearer's stamina. Practitioners cast it to keep their endurance steady through long toil.

rites.name: Rentus
rites.text: A basic healing rite that a learner can perform to mend a small portion of the caster's vitality and restore some stamina. Its restoring effect lasts only briefly after it is invoked.

rites.name: Orelaunium
rites.text: A calling-craft that briefly drains the resolve of restless dead, making them hesitate to fight and sometimes sending them fleeing.

rites.name: Nisus Milaustanum
rites.text: A sacred ceremony of the Ashen Orders that marks a warrior's advancement into the highest tier of their discipline. It belongs to the restorative line of light-bound arts practiced by guardian knights.

rites.name: Telonasium
rites.text: A minor restorative craft that quietly eases the pangs of an empty belly. It is one of the gentler enchantments taught to novice healers.

rites.name: Masus
rites.text: A disciplined technique practiced by sacred guardians, drawing on a restorative inner light. It belongs to a lineage of healing arts taught within their orders.

rites.name: Loniarnor
rites.text: A restorative healing craft that purges a target of common sickness and the creeping rot known as blight. It is taught as a gentle art of mending the body.

rites.name: Maria Taustum
rites.text: A bound parchment holding a crackling glyph that, once read, releases a copy of a lightning-trap effect. It is a sealed, one-use working of storm craft.

rites.name: Maurnistum
rites.text: A bound parchment that, once read aloud, forces a living creature to fight beside its holder. It is a summoning-craft artifact used in battle.

rites.name: Tesanum Vilum
rites.text: A ritual parchment of ash-dark vellum that, once read aloud, slowly drains the vigor from a foe's limbs. Its power fades over time, leaving the target weaker and sluggish.

rites.name: Oriallanum Meostia
rites.text: A ritual craft that hurls a burst of searing flame into several foes at once, scorching each one it touches. It belongs to the arts of destructive working.

rites.name: Raustonium
rites.text: A minor enchantment of illusion that a novice caster can weave to win a listener's goodwill toward them for half a minute.

rites.name: Serianium Miastor
rites.text: A hidden craft of illusion that lets its wielder blend into the surroundings until no one can see them.

rites.name: Saustanum Amanteonia
rites.text: A ruinous incantation that gutters the skill of wielders with both long and short edges for a short span. Mages use it to blunt an opponent's swordcraft.

rites.name: Lausor Amilus
rites.text: A mid-level veil craft that makes its user wholly unseen for a short span of time. Any deliberate touch on the world or strike against another ends the cloaking at once.

rites.name: Rianentia
rites.text: A bound parchment of healing script that, once unrolled and read, purges a creeping sickness from the bearer's body. It is a sacred craft of mending kept by temple scribes.

rites.name: Telistornes Oriasellum
rites.text: A ritual parchment that restores lost vitality, mana, and stamina to whoever reads it aloud. Its healing light fades once the words have been spoken.

rites.name: Oreoliastum
rites.text: A parchment charm that drains the confidence of a rival for a short while, leaving them less charming and less persuasive in every exchange.

rites.name: Serenantia
rites.text: A rolled sheet of parchment that releases a holy rebuke when read aloud. It drives restless dead creatures away from the one who speaks it.

rites.name: Mosanum Ceostor
rites.text: A bound parchment of sealed sigils that, when unrolled, wraps its bearer in an invisible ward. The ward hardens the body against both close blows and projectiles.

rites.name: Teosor Corenialus
rites.text: A ritual parchment of restorative craft that briefly strengthens the bearer's inner resolve. Its magic fades after a short while, leaving the reader's spirit as it was.

rites.name: Vonanum Sanernor
rites.text: A caster weaves a shifting ward of bright force around their whole form, hardening it against harm. The ward raises the protection that the wearer's body can offer against blows.

rites.name: Tisentia Lisanum
rites.text: A sealed parchment of conjured magic that, once read, calls forth a radiant guardian to fight beside its reader for a short while.

rites.name: Seresor Coraunes
rites.text: A bound parchment that releases a sudden surge of icy force against foes. Its magic is drawn from the discipline of ruin and unmakes its target with cold.

rites.name: Naria Ciastanum
rites.text: A parchment roll that imitates a conjurer's binding rite, letting its reader call a fire-bound servant to fight beside them. It draws its power from a sealed incantation written upon the page.

rites.name: Sinteollia
rites.text: A bound parchment that releases a restorative glow when read. It mirrors the healing art of a sacred mending rite, allowing its reader to draw wounds closed in another.

rites.name: Oraniastia Teliarnanum
rites.text: A bound parchment of sacred script that hardens the bearer's body against lightning-like jolts. Once read aloud, it grants a lasting resistance to sudden shocks.

rites.name: Leonialum
rites.text: A ritual parchment that drains the resolve of a rival while steadying the bearer's own spirit by the same measure. Scholars of hidden arts keep such scrolls sealed and rarely unroll them.

rites.name: Amastenor
rites.text: A bound parchment of illusion magic that, when read, freezes a foe in place so they cannot move or act for a short while.

rites.name: Valostium Visteonia
rites.text: A restorative working that briefly sharpens a warrior's mastery of the long sword. Once the working fades, the warrior's skill settles back to its former level, the gain matching the surge.

rites.name: Nellausia
rites.text: A parchment roll that, once read, mimics a mental charm which steadies the reader's nerve. It draws on the arts of illusion to sway the mind.

rites.name: Sialanum Rinteosum
rites.text: A restorative charm that briefly sharpens a fighter's skill with small blades, the boost fading once the enchantment runs out. Its strength is measured by how much the skill rises.

rites.name: Sisteoria
rites.text: A ritual parchment that, when read aloud, summons a bony servant to stand beside its reader and fight for a short while before it crumbles away.

rites.name: Amosor
rites.text: A ritual parchment that, once unrolled, lets its bearer breathe beneath the water for a short while. It belongs to the craft of reshaping the body's natural workings.

rites.name: Sernum Cirnum
rites.text: A piercing sorcery that unleashes icy fragments against several foes at once, freezing each target it strikes.

rites.name: Valoristes
rites.text: A reshaping scroll that lightens a bearer's load for a short time, so they tire more slowly and can hold more goods before becoming burdened.

rites.name: Veosaurnum
rites.text: A glowing parchment roll that stirs a fear in living beings and beasts alike, making them far more eager to turn tail and run from any fight.

rites.name: Siror Amerus
rites.text: A ritual parchment that unleashes a crackling burst of lightning-like force, striking foes with a jolt of stinging energy.

rites.name: Norium Veonterus
rites.text: A bound parchment of shaping craft that lets its reader leap far higher and farther while drifting down gently, so that no landing ever wounds them.

rites.name: Naustia Villium
rites.text: A ritual parchment that slowly drains the resolve of whoever it is turned against. Its magic gradually weakens a foe's inner will over time.

rites.name: Reolus Leontia
rites.text: A bound roll of inked vellum that, when unfurled, wraps its bearer in an unseen guard. It hardens the wearer's outer protection against both blades and projectiles.

rites.name: Laustia Tintor
rites.text: A parchment roll used as a weapon, it releases several enchantments drawn from the arts of destruction and illusion. It is meant to harm a foe while confusing their senses.

rites.name: Telentarum
rites.text: A restorative rite of the temple orders that strengthens a person's defenses against ordinary sicknesses. It is cast upon the one being protected to keep common ailments at bay.

rites.name: Liarnaures
rites.text: A sealed parchment of healing craft that hardens the bearer's body against biting cold. Once unrolled, it steadies the user's resistance to chilling harm.

rites.name: Nantum Tiarnistus
rites.text: A restorative working that briefly sharpens a bearer's talent for moving unharmed without protective gear. When the working fades, the talent returns to its prior level.

rites.name: Tolliasium
rites.text: A restorative working that briefly sharpens a caster's grasp of illusion, with the added insight fading once the working runs its course. Its strength is measured by how much the insight rises.

rites.name: Amaurnor Valeontes
rites.text: A craft of bending darkness to one's will, once practiced widely across several regions of the realm. Its first known practitioner was a woman who wielded gloom as her own.

rites.name: Serilles Saullia
rites.text: A restorative incantation that briefly sharpens a practitioner's nimble leaping and tumbling. When the working fades, the body's agility settles back to its former measure.

rites.name: Veles Nontor
rites.text: A lesser conjuring of ruin that siphons thirty points of arcane reserve from whoever it strikes. Novice casters learn it early as a basic form of hostile sorcery.

rites.name: Seosanum Amiarniria
rites.text: A restorative working that briefly sharpens the guarding skill of its caster. When the working fades, the skill settles back to its former strength.

rites.name: Amiaristia
rites.text: A bound parchment of ritual sigils that leaves its bearer more vulnerable to the sting of icy cold. Those who read its marks find the chill bites deeper than before.

rites.name: Serarollium
rites.text: A ritual parchment that drains the nimbleness from a rival while lending the same swiftness to its bearer for a short span. Its effect fades once the spell has run its course.

rites.name: Telantus Sereores
rites.text: A sacred written record that teaches its reader the method needed to undo the tireless undead who guard the eastern sanctum at first light. It reveals a way to lay to rest what cannot otherwise be slain.

rites.name: Oreontium
rites.text: A bound parchment of mending craft that, once read aloud, quickens the reader's pace of movement for a short span. It belongs to the healing arts of the old temple scribes.

rites.name: Amonia Amilles
rites.text: A parchment roll that copies the effect of a binding charm, freezing a target's limbs in place when its words are read aloud.

rites.name: Serinia Rirnelium
rites.text: A bound parchment of mystic script that, once read aloud, lends its bearer swift and nimble movement for a short while.

rites.name: Sistonor
rites.text: A bound parchment that, once read, calls forth a conjured servant from the dead. The sheet copies the power of a known ritual spell for anyone holding it.

rites.name: Virnaulium
rites.text: A ritual craft that lets a caster unravel a magical effect clinging to their own body. Curses, sicknesses, and lasting enchantments remain untouched by its working.

rites.name: Misus Neonastor
rites.text: A sealed parchment of arcane lore that drains an opponent's charm while lending its bearer an equal measure of that same presence for a short span.

rites.name: Veolenor
rites.text: A parchment roll that, when read, releases a magical effect causing a crowd of foes to turn frantic and lash out at one another. It mimics a fearsome mind-twisting incantation.

rites.name: Rentaulum
rites.text: A sealed parchment carrying a binding illusion that, once unrolled over a foe, briefly stops them from weaving any spell.

rites.name: Mauses Nialia
rites.text: A bound parchment of cursed sigils that, once unrolled, slowly saps the swiftness from a rival's limbs. Its pale ink fades as the weakening spreads.

rites.name: Amantum Valontus
rites.text: A bound parchment that releases a sorcerous snare. When read, it draws the essence out of a foe and keeps it trapped, mimicking a spell of spirit-binding.

rites.name: Teleonentes
rites.text: A bound parchment scroll that, when read, releases a shard of freezing force. It mimics the effect of a known battle incantation of the frost-craft.

rites.name: Telontium
rites.text: A blessing that a seeker receives after offering a prayer at a sacred waypoint. It bestows a lasting favor upon the one who prays.

rites.name: Amernosanum
rites.text: A ritual parchment that gives its bearer a chance to draw in and absorb magical assaults aimed at them. It belongs to the arcane craft of ward-scrolls.

rites.name: Serianeolus
rites.text: A ritual parchment that lets its bearer sense the nearby presence of living creatures. It draws on the quiet arts of inner sight and is prized by those who track wild things.

rites.name: Teliasium Valelia
rites.text: A rolled parchment that, when read aloud, calls forth a bound spirit of tempest to serve the reader for a time. It carries the same binding craft as a ritual of conjured storm servants.

rites.name: Ceontisanum
rites.text: A paper sheet inscribed with a charm that copies the workings of a mind-sway chant. It is read once to produce the same stirring effect the chant would.

rites.name: Corisia Valolarnia
rites.text: A parchment charm that, once read aloud, drives sickness from the reader's body while restoring lost stamina and vitality. It belongs to the healing arts of the old temples.

rites.name: Amialanum Leones
rites.text: A parchment roll that calls forth a fire-bound summoned servant when read. It belongs to the craft of calling beings from elsewhere.

rites.name: Seolus Amisum
rites.text: A bound parchment that releases a protective ring of healing light around its bearer. It mimics the effect of a restorative ward cast by a skilled healer.

rites.name: Nesus Corauntelia
rites.text: A sealed sheet of enchanted vellum that bounces hostile sorcery back toward the one who cast it. Its power works only against spells aimed at its bearer.

rites.name: Varnia Cornenus
rites.text: A restorative incantation that briefly sharpens a bowman's aim by an amount set by its strength. When the working fades, the archer's steadiness returns to its former level.

rites.name: Taustisum Lostanum
rites.text: A rolled parchment of enchanted sigils that, once read aloud, conjures a floating sphere of light which fills the space around its reader.

rites.name: Rilantia
rites.text: A bound parchment that, when read aloud, weaves a false dread into the minds of those nearby. It imitates a known spell of mind-clouding terror.

rites.name: Lonium Nentus
rites.text: A restoring incantation that briefly sharpens a crafter's knack for enchanting. Once its duration fades, the crafter's ability returns to the level it held before.

rites.name: Ceoliror
rites.text: A sealed parchment of occult sorcery that, when unrolled, saps several vital traits from a chosen foe and grafts the same strength onto whoever holds it. The stolen gifts fade after a short while.

rites.name: Amostes Mises
rites.text: A rolled sheet of inscribed hide that lets its bearer sense nearby objects carrying enchantment. It belongs to the practice of arcane sight and reveals magic hidden in ordinary things.

rites.name: Valistus Rilesium
rites.text: A sealed parchment that releases a holy ward against restless dead. Reading it lets the bearer call down a blessing that harms the animated and the unliving.

rites.name: Nisus Sereontanum
rites.text: A sacred parchment that lets its reader leap impossibly high into the air. The leap is deadly unless the falling reader lands in deep water, reads the parchment again, or invokes a feather-soft descent.

rites.name: Amiaror Roriases
rites.text: A ritual working of mending that briefly hardens a wearer's skill in bearing plate protection. When the working fades, the skill slips back to its former measure.

rites.name: Rinanum Seraurnanum
rites.text: A fighter's technique that hurls a blazing burst of heat toward a foe. It belongs to a discipline of inner fire practiced by warrior-knights who channel ember power.

rites.name: Reonirus
rites.text: A ritual working that briefly strengthens a bearer's stamina and resolve. Its effect fades after a short span, leaving the caster's inner fortitude restored to its usual level.

rites.name: Vianor Tiania
rites.text: A quiet art of bending light so the user fades from sight while blows and arrows drift wide of them. It does nothing against sorcery.

rites.name: Riarosanum
rites.text: A hushed enchantment that lets its bearer merge with the surrounding scenery until onlookers can no longer perceive them. It belongs to the arts of false sight.

rites.name: Mausium Valilanum
rites.text: A consecrated rite that a sacred-order practitioner learns after mastering the higher stages of their healing discipline. It is a restorative art passed down among devoted circles of the faithful.

rites.name: Teliantus Coreornanum
rites.text: A restorative rite that temporarily sharpens a warrior's skill with the spear. When the rite fades, the skill settles back to its former level, and the strength of the gain is set by how far it rose.

rites.name: Caurnia Amausolium
rites.text: A sealed parchment that, when unrolled, releases a crackling burst of lightning against a chosen foe. Its sorcerous energy lashes out and wounds the target.

rites.name: Nerus Vornum
rites.text: A bound parchment roll that carries a ritual of conjuring, letting its reader call back the still form of a fallen body to serve as a shambling servant.

rites.name: Tirum Telaraunia
rites.text: A sealed parchment that drains an opponent's inner reserve of arcane energy. Its charge sears the foe with crackling bolts of lightning that strike twice at once.

rites.name: Corolum Nolaustanum
rites.text: A bound parchment that channels a summoning craft to call forth a frozen servant. Its magic copies the effect of a known conjuring ritual.

rites.name: Serinor Raullus
rites.text: A sealed parchment of ritual magic that, once unrolled, makes its target more vulnerable to flame while burning them directly.

rites.name: Mintaranum
rites.text: A sealed roll of parchment that, once unfurled, gently restores the bearer's strength of body over a span of time. Mystics of the healing arts prize it for travel.

rites.name: Veollauntus
rites.text: A rolled parchment that, once read, produces an illusion mirroring the working of a summoning chant. It rallies the nearby crowd as though the spell had been cast directly.

rites.name: Siallirnus
rites.text: A bound parchment that wraps its reader in a crackling sheath of sky-fire. The sheath dulls blows from storm-born harm and scorches foes who draw near.

rites.name: Miastarnes
rites.text: A sealed parchment charm of restorative craft that returns lost stamina to whoever unrolls it. Its enchanted script fades once the strength has been drawn out.

rites.name: Valeostia Sirnor
rites.text: A bound parchment roll that, once unfurled and read, releases a burst of flame. It imitates the effect of a known fiery incantation.

rites.name: Valonus Orarnum
rites.text: A restorative incantation that briefly sharpens a wearer's skill in handling mid-weight plate. When the working fades, the skill slips back to its former level.

rites.name: Saules Venontium
rites.text: A restorative working that briefly sharpens a practitioner's grasp of summoning arts. The heightened skill fades once the working ends, leaving the mind as it was before.

rites.name: Vantiarnum Coreonus
rites.text: A ritual parchment that slowly saps the nimbleness of whoever it is turned against, leaving the target clumsy and sluggish for a while.

rites.name: Ceoses Mintolium
rites.text: A bound parchment that releases a mending incantation, driving weaker restless dead away from the bearer. It works like a spell stored within the sheet, usable by anyone who reads it.

rites.name: Valeostanum Oreollastus
rites.text: A ritual parchment woven from several arcane traditions that sapped a foe's strength and drained the will to keep fighting. It is used as a weapon against enemies in battle.

rites.name: Coraunistor
rites.text: A rolled sheet of enchanted parchment that releases a hurled blaze when read. It mimics the effect of a fire-casting incantation for anyone who unrolls it.

rites.name: Coriarintus
rites.text: A restorative rite that briefly sharpens a practitioner's grasp of transmutation. Once the rite fades, the practitioner's skill returns to its former level.

rites.name: Calosia
rites.text: A restorative rite that briefly sharpens a bearer's skill with bludgeoning arms. The enhancement fades once the rite's duration is complete, returning the skill to its former level.

rites.name: Coreollus Naneolium
rites.text: A parchment roll of hidden craft that lets its bearer lift off the ground and stride across open air as if it were solid road.

rites.name: Raulleornus
rites.text: A restorative working that briefly sharpens a runner's stamina and swiftness. When the working fades, the body's natural speed returns to what it was before.

rites.name: Laria Coriasus
rites.text: A restorative working that briefly sharpens a caster's talent for bargaining and trade. Once its duration passes, the talent slips back to its former level.

rites.name: Orenalles Corestialum
rites.text: A restorative incantation that briefly sharpens a warrior's skill with the chopping blade. When the working fades, that skill settles back to its former level, with the gain measured by how much it rose.

rites.name: Lirnia Amilliarium
rites.text: A sacred parchment that, once read, whisks its bearer away to the closest temple of the faithful. It serves as a last resort for escaping peril when wounds cannot be mended.

rites.name: Oreornus Neranum
rites.text: A sealed parchment of arcane craft that, once unrolled, strips away the enchantments lingering within a small surrounding space.

rites.name: Ceolanum Ciarnia
rites.text: A bound parchment that, when unrolled, releases a sorcerous effect mirroring a spear of frozen force. It is used by casters who wish to strike foes with a sudden shard of cold.

rites.name: Tesia
rites.text: A parchment scroll that releases a crackling storm-sheath around its reader, mirroring a spell of lightning cloaking. It serves as a portable copy of that sorcerous working.

rites.name: Coranus Corostausum
rites.text: A temporary healing rite that sharpens the mind's grasp of hidden arcana for a short span. When the rite fades, the practitioner's insight returns to its former strength.

rites.name: Lases Lanium
rites.text: A ritual parchment that drains the vitality of a foe and transfers the same amount of life into the one who unrolls it.

rites.name: Virus Tenteornia
rites.text: A bound sheet of sorcerous script that stirs the hearts of thinking folk toward raising their hands in violence. Beasts, restless dead, and otherworldly spirits remain untouched by its pull.

rites.name: Sialanum Solleornor
rites.text: A bound parchment that, once read, grants its reader a dark, hardened skin that shrugs off harm. It works by reproducing a sorcerer's transformative incantation.

rites.name: Mantollium
rites.text: A parchment roll that, once read, mirrors the effect of a restorative chant, letting its reader mend wounds swiftly.

rites.name: Teliria Sanus
rites.text: A bound parchment that, once read, lets its user harden the skin into a tough, stone-like shell for a time. It mimics a known binding of reshaping craft.

rites.name: Cinum Senolles
rites.text: A sealed parchment of enchanted magic that, once unrolled, makes its target more vulnerable to flame while burning them directly. It is used as a weapon of destruction by those who wield such arts.

rites.name: Telanteonia
rites.text: A ritual of burning craft taught to apprentice casters, it lets a practitioner scorch a foe with a single touch of flame. It is a middling art, mastered after years of study.

rites.name: Serintiaria
rites.text: A protective enchantment that hardens a bearer against venom and toxins. It is cast by healers who channel restorative craft to strengthen the body's defenses.

rites.name: Rellium Corarnontum
rites.text: A restorative ward that briefly sharpens a wearer's skill at handling lightweight protective gear. Once the ward fades, the skill returns to its earlier level, and the strength of the boost sets how much it rises.

rites.name: Taunium Vernaunor
rites.text: A fighting technique forged from serpent teeth taken from the deep water. Practitioners learn it by studying a carved pattern that shows its movements.

rites.name: Mianium Teleostes
rites.text: A restorative incantation that briefly sharpens a caster's unarmed fighting ability. When the magic fades, the strength of the hands returns to its former level.

rites.name: Milanum Lostiranum
rites.text: A healing craft that briefly sharpens a practitioner's gift for mending wounds and cures. The gift fades back to its usual strength once the craft's effect runs out.

rites.name: Larilus
rites.text: A restorative incantation that briefly sharpens a fighter's destructive prowess. When it fades, the craft returns to its former strength, and the strength of the boost sets how far it rises.

rites.name: Liasaunes
rites.text: A sealed roll of blessed vellum that sharpens a bearer's aim and strikes with any weapon while slowly restoring spent vigor and bodily strength.

rites.name: Oresinanum
rites.text: A bound parchment that releases a crackling bolt of storm energy leaping from one foe to the next. Its magic mimics a practiced lightning-working of the arcane arts.

rites.name: Conteornia
rites.text: A sealed parchment of arcane script that drains a rival's inner strength and transfers it to the reader for a short span. Its magic leaves the target weakened and the caster briefly stronger.

rites.name: Taunes Miasium
rites.text: A bound sheet of enchanted writing that softens the urge of a creature or person to strike out at others. It works through illusion, dulling the will to fight.

rites.name: Amoranum Saulosanum
rites.text: A sealed parchment roll that a bearer unfurls to purge sickness, numbness, and venom from the body. It mends the afflicted with a single reading of its inscribed sigils.

rites.name: Niastinor
rites.text: A bound parchment that, when read aloud, lifts the wasting sickness from a body. It draws on the healing discipline of the restoration arts.

rites.name: Telilus Nornisus
rites.text: A masterful incantation of ruinous flame that a practiced caster releases through a single touch, searing a chosen foe with a burst of heat.

rites.name: Tantaunia
rites.text: A bound parchment roll that, once unfurled, releases a burst of searing elemental force against a target. It is a tool of the destructive arts.

rites.name: Riastia Tiallia
rites.text: A sacred parchment that, once read aloud, restores its reader's vitality by a fixed measure. It is a rite-bound object drawn from the mending arts.

rites.name: Listaules
rites.text: A bound parchment that, once read aloud, wraps its bearer in a shimmering hush of force. The guard turns aside blades and arrows alike, hardening the wearer's protection.

rites.name: Meontarum
rites.text: A charmed parchment that hides its bearer from watching eyes and lets them stride across open air as though it were firm ground.

rites.name: Sereseornia
rites.text: A temporary rite of favor that sharpens a bearer's nimbleness and quickness. Its power fades after a short span, leaving the bearer as they were before.

rites.name: Valiarnes Amontises
rites.text: A parchment roll that copies a known sensing charm, letting a reader briefly feel nearby living things. It is a one-use wrap of an existing enchantment.

rites.name: Corallanum Niastor
rites.text: A quiet hidden craft that a bearer may call upon without any daily limit. It works unseen and serves its wielder in secret.

rites.name: Seriallium Coriasia
rites.text: A bound parchment that releases the stored power of a banishing rite. Reading it casts a binding that drives otherworldly beings back to their own realm.

rites.name: Cauranum Valesanum
rites.text: A parchment roll that can be found in scattered places and works like a ritual of sending away otherworldly beings. Reading it unleashes the same banishing force as the conjurer's rite.

rites.name: Teleolium Teliasanum
rites.text: A quiet, ever-present inner discipline that wardens of the fire order cultivate, letting their bodies carry a steady inner blaze that strengthens their resolve in battle.

rites.name: Testonanum
rites.text: A restoring incantation that briefly sharpens a practitioner's grasp of transmutation craft. When its duration ends, the sharpened skill fades back to its former strength, and the amount of enhancement is the measure of the boost.

rites.name: Serarnum Cistiaror
rites.text: A restorative incantation that lets a wielder move unseen for a short while by sharpening their stealth. The added skill fades once the working ends, returning the practitioner to their former ability.

rites.name: Moristanum
rites.text: A gentle mental charm that stills a nearby creature of low standing for a brief moment. Those under its influence grow calm and less likely to act upon their anger.

rites.name: Sostania
rites.text: A restorative working that briefly sharpens a person's ability to guard and protect. When the working fades, that ability settles back to its earlier level.

rites.name: Niallentum
rites.text: A temporary sacred craft that strengthens light protective gear worn by a practitioner. The added resilience fades once the rite's duration runs out.

rites.name: Teosum Coristerium
rites.text: A temporary rite that sharpens the worth of a spear while its magic holds. Once the rite ends, the spear's worth slips back to what it was before.

rites.name: Rinentum
rites.text: A sacred working that temporarily sharpens a person's skill at bare-handed combat. The enhancement fades on its own, restoring the fighter's usual ability.

rites.name: Cauntanum Sastonor
rites.text: A bond of respect where fighters stand fearlessly beside one another, guarding each other's backs. Wise members insist no perilous venture is undertaken without such a companion at one's side.

rites.name: Oreostiarus
rites.text: A temporary sacred rite that sharpens the worth of crushing clubs and maces. Once the rite fades, the weapon's worth returns to what it was before.

rites.name: Sentus Rauleosanum
rites.text: A temple craft that briefly sharpens the edge of a chopping blade, letting its wielder strike with greater force. The enhancement fades on its own and the blade returns to its ordinary strength.

rites.name: Riarnes Miasalor
rites.text: A sacred hush-craft taught in temples that briefly sharpens a traveler's ability to move unseen. Its quiet effect fades after a short while, leaving the practitioner's normal stealth as it was before.

rites.name: Valoneontus Naullerium
rites.text: A sacred working of restoration that briefly strengthens a bearer's skill at fighting without armor. The gain fades when the working ends, and the skill settles back to its former level.

rites.name: Raunanum Corelium
rites.text: A sealed chant that only one ancient winged beast answers, drawing it forth from its tomb-hall when a summoning word is spoken. It can never be learned by ordinary speakers.

rites.name: Ceontastus
rites.text: A mid-level illusion charm that blurs the caster's outline, granting partial concealment for a short while. Its hush lets the wearer slip past watchful eyes.

rites.name: Serarnum Taustanum
rites.text: A temporary blessing that lets a trader's craft fetch higher worth at the market. The gain fades once the enchantment runs its course and the skill returns to its former level.

rites.name: Meontium Amosium
rites.text: A protective ward of the healing arts that shields its caster from damage caused by sudden jolts of lightning. It is taught among the restorative orders.

rites.name: Amonteollus Valeseolum
rites.text: A sacred working that lifts a practitioner's skill in reshaping things for a short while. Once the working fades, that skill settles back to its former level.

rites.name: Rintia Viror
rites.text: A restorative craft that briefly sharpens a practitioner's inner attunement, and the heightened sense fades once the working ends and the attunement returns to its former level.

rites.name: Teleontor Tiastor
rites.text: A sealed technique that traps an enemy inside a binding of radiant light. It is taught as the final art of a warrior discipline of dawn.

rites.name: Telarnum Nianeostia
rites.text: A temple-taught craft that eases the speed of a practitioner's fall, so that landing from a height leaves them unharmed.

rites.name: Lialanum Orestilor
rites.text: A protective craft that wraps a sheath of woven force around a bearer's body. It raises the bearer's guard against blows, and its strength scales with how potent the working is.

rites.name: Sirnia Telenus
rites.text: A trained technique of loosing shafts tipped with precious metal, practiced by warriors of a martial brotherhood. It is one of the active arts they draw upon in battle.

rites.name: Resus Nauntialum
rites.text: A minor spell of the destructive arts, taught to beginners, that is found within a bound book of hidden lore.

rites.name: Serarneles
rites.text: A discharge craft drawn from the destructive arts that costs more inner reserve to weave than flame or chill. Its bolt races across the air far faster than either of those rivals.

rites.name: Teontor Teonastus
rites.text: A shadow-trained assassin's craft in which each blow draws a portion of the victim's vitality into the attacker. It is practiced within the ranks of the night-cloaked blade orders.

rites.name: Oriantia Tenauntus
rites.text: A ranged craft of destructive force that unleashes a crackling sphere of lightning, striking several foes at once with harmful energy.

rites.name: Valiaranum Nasor
rites.text: A beginner's craft of ruin that hurls a flash of searing heat and bitter cold at a foe on contact. It is taught early to apprentices learning to shape destructive forces.

rites.name: Soniantum
rites.text: A ritual craft that channels raw elemental force into a single foe, striking them with searing harm. It is practiced by devout wardens who wield it against those they deem unworthy.

rites.name: Seosiantium
rites.text: A soft-hearted working that lets a caster drop from great heights unharmed. Its hold lasts a short span and stretches a little longer as the caster grows in skill.

rites.name: Amaulor Siallentus
rites.text: A warding quality that softens cuts and blade wounds. It lessens the harm dealt by edged strikes against whatever bears it.

rites.name: Valolinus
rites.text: A restorative sacred working that briefly sharpens a bearer's physical running and leaping prowess. The gift fades once the working ends, leaving the body as it was before.

rites.name: Seraulorum
rites.text: A temporary blessing of restorative magic that strengthens the wearer's mid-weight protective gear for a short span. When the blessing fades, the gear's protection returns to its former level.

rites.name: Tolliasium Raurasia
rites.text: A ward-craft that wraps its caster in a crackling veil of stored lightning. The veil softens incoming jolts and scorches foes who come too near.

rites.name: Taunteres Corostium
