rites.text: A restorative charm that briefly sharpens the bearer's gift for persuasive speech. When it fades, the gift returns to its former strength.

rites.name: Amallor Aminium
rites.text: A quiet, always-active discipline taught within a martial guild, sharpening a warrior's hand in combat. It belongs to a lineage of trained fighting arts.

rites.name: Orilles Visium
rites.text: A discipline of quick, close-held cutting edges that a practitioner refines through swift footwork. Its mastery depends on a sister art of rapid reflexes, and many small, hand-sized blades serve as its tools.

rites.name: Maliasanum
rites.text: A protective craft that lessens damage from sudden jolts of lightning-like force. It is one of the recognized warding powers, and it can be woven into armaments to soften such blows.

rites.name: Mantellus
rites.text: A defensive craft that lets a warband call up a protective barrier during the wars between allied hosts. Only those who have trained in the lesser arts of guarding and supporting their companions may learn it.

rites.name: Lornus Seoraulanum
rites.text: A restorative craft that temporarily heightens the power of healing and mending. Once its effect fades, the practitioner's restorative strength returns to its former level.

rites.name: Oreonia Telostium
rites.text: A ward-craft that lies in wait on locked doors and coffers, unleashing a crackling burst of arcane force the moment someone meddles with it.

rites.name: Masor Sostantum
rites.text: A brief veil of illusion that lets its caster slip past blows from fists, blades, and arrows for a few heartbeats. It offers no defense against sorcery.

rites.name: Roses Tirnanum
rites.text: A destructive incantation that channels crackling, lightning-like force into the hand of its caster. Upon contact, it delivers a jolt of raw shock to whoever is struck.

rites.name: Orollum Orestaullus
rites.text: A quiet hidden art grants a wanderer access to a secretive dealer who sells shadowed gear, draughts and toxins, or a tool for wrongdoing. Only one such offering may be claimed each cycle of twenty hours.

rites.name: Riastanum Maurus
rites.text: A shaping craft that wraps the practitioner's whole form in a protective ward, hardening their defenses against harm.

rites.name: Serosor Ceonauntus
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that lets a wielder of spirit-craft trap a departing essence whenever a foe falls. It deepens in strength once the practitioner reaches a set threshold of mastery.

rites.name: Corelor Orintum
rites.text: A restorative charm that briefly sharpens a traveler's leaping and tumbling ability. Once its effect fades, the traveler's natural agility returns to what it was before.

rites.name: Taulium Orauntia
rites.text: A radiant technique drawn from the sun's fire that a warrior of a sacred order can unleash in battle. It belongs to a line of rites that channel dawn's wrath.

rites.name: Rauntoranum
rites.text: A restorative enchantment that strengthens a bearer's defenses against creeping rot and plague. It is cast upon a person to make them more resistant to blight sickness.

rites.name: Ceoria Serentium
rites.text: A sacred working that briefly hardens a warrior's plated gear and strengthens the wearer's grasp of it. When the rite ends, the armor's craft returns to its former measure.

rites.name: Telles Valaurum
rites.text: A ruinous craft that channels crackling force from the caster's hand into a foe, striking them with a sudden jolt of lightning-like harm.

rites.name: Ameontor Coseolium
rites.text: A temporary healing art that lets a practitioner sharpen the potency of their potion-making. When the working fades, that skill returns to its former strength.

rites.name: Mallenes
rites.text: A temporary sacred craft that sharpens a practitioner's skill with small blades. The enhancement fades once the rite is finished, leaving the wielder's ability as it was before.

rites.name: Corarnanum Selia
rites.text: A mystic working that strips one lingering magical effect away from the one who casts it. Curses, sicknesses, and enduring enchantments cannot be lifted this way.

rites.name: Sastanum Reolum
rites.text: A restorative sacred working that briefly raises the strength of a binding craft. Once its duration passes, the craft settles back to its former level.

rites.name: Vintastanum
rites.text: A crackling craft that unleashes a jolt of lightning damage striking several foes at once. Practitioners of destruction arts wield it to overwhelm groups.

rites.name: Meolus Seriraunia
rites.text: A restoration rite that temporarily sharpens a bearer's skill with long blades. When the rite fades, the skill returns to its former level.

rites.name: Cellia Larnosanum
rites.text: A temporary craft that quickens a practitioner's gift for calling forth summoned things. Its strength fades back to normal once the working ends.

rites.name: Taurollium
rites.text: A sacred restoration art that temporarily sharpens a keeper's aim with a bow or thrown weapon. When the blessing fades, the keeper's skill returns to its former level.

rites.name: Valiria Virnosum
rites.text: A restorative art that temporarily heightens the strength of a sanctuary's protection. Once the working ends, the guardianship settles back to its former level.

rites.name: Rantillia
rites.text: A restorative craft that temporarily heightens the power of illusion. When the working ends, the illusion's strength falls back to its earlier level.

rites.name: Cistanum Valaustus
rites.text: A protective craft that hardens the bearer against wasting sickness and rot. It is cast as a warding rite, bolstering the subject's resistance to plague-like corruption.

rites.name: Ameontum Vantanum
rites.text: A quiet, always-active discipline held by fighters of the guild line, sharpening their ability to read signs and follow trails. It works without being called upon, shaping every hunt they undertake.

rites.name: Reontianes
rites.text: A reflective ward craft that lets its bearer bounce incoming magical assaults back toward the caster who launched them. It is taught among arcane mystics as a defensive art.

rites.name: Vinus Rostum
rites.text: A quiet inner craft that lets a shadow-trained wielder draw vitality from the living. It works quietly in the background, never needing to be called upon.

rites.name: Reosares
rites.text: A dark ultimate technique taught within a shadowy siphoning discipline of assassins. It works in tandem with a companion art that steals life essence from foes.

rites.name: Valiaror Calium
rites.text: A restorative rite that temporarily strengthens a practitioner's capacity to defend against blows. When the rite fades, that strength slips back to its former level.

rites.name: Coraulium Serillorum
rites.text: A temporary craft that sharpens a practitioner's ability to tear down sacred sites. When the working fades, that ability returns to its usual strength.

rites.name: Corenallum Corenum
rites.text: A restorative craft that briefly raises the worth of a smith's trade. Once the working ends, the craft returns to its earlier level.

rites.name: Nalus Sereorianum
rites.text: A scroll-like charm found within a hidden tomb, where a living arachnid is held in the hand and hurled at a foe. Up to eight such creatures can be called forth together, each of a different kind.

rites.name: Reostum Vestisium
rites.text: A ritual sphere that quietly drains the vitality of whoever stands within it, though the loss is only borrowed and returns once the working fades.

rites.name: Lelausanum
rites.text: A sorcerous working that draws the inner reserve of arcane energy out of a rival caster. The target's capacity to channel magic is weakened by the effect.

rites.name: Corostia Lontes
rites.text: A ward of arcane craft that bends hostile magic back toward its caster. It draws on the mystic arts and the shaping of enchantment.

rites.name: Nosum Vintolus
rites.text: A restorative incantation that briefly swells the reserve of inner arcane energy held by whoever it is cast upon. The effect fades after a short while.

rites.name: Sereolles Rollasia
rites.text: A withering craft that siphons a target's inner character away, leaving them hollow. It belongs to the school of ruin and unmaking.

rites.name: Sereostia Sanes
rites.text: A withering craft that siphons away the character of its target. The spell slowly leaches away the victim's personality, leaving them hollowed.

rites.name: Corianor Cerium
rites.text: A passive protective craft drawn from the light-armor disciplines, quietly shielding its wearer against magical attacks. It belongs to a practiced line of lightly armored techniques.

rites.name: Mintium Telarus
rites.text: A ghostly blade-charm that is cast at a foe to drain away their vitality. It belongs to the school of ruin and unmaking.

rites.name: Orastium Rares
rites.text: A quiet art of winning trust through careful words, letting a practitioner sway others to open up and reveal secrets they would keep from a stranger. It is governed by one's inner charm.

rites.name: Niarnorus
rites.text: A disorienting hum is woven into a foe's thoughts, scattering their focus and weakening their hold on spells. The strength of the hum wavers somewhat from one casting to the next.

rites.name: Coreorus Coraulium
rites.text: A masterful veil of illusion that makes its wearer wholly unseen for a span of two minutes. Any deliberate act, such as touching an object or striking another, tears the veil apart.

rites.name: Veoles Ameornia
rites.text: A self-cast protective craft that shields its user from minor enchantments. Its strength and endurance grow as the caster gains experience.

rites.name: Sestanum Sollaurnor
rites.text: A minor craft taught to apprentice casters, letting them send a brief crackle of harmful lightning through a single touch. It is one of the simplest offensive arts in the lower circles of study.

rites.name: Caurantanum
rites.text: A hardened discipline of endurance practiced by a northern folk, letting a warrior grow more enduring and gather a surge of inner power whenever blows land. It began as a technique for guarding with a blade and shield.

rites.name: Telornor Vasus
rites.text: A combat discipline in which a fighter learns to wield long two-handed staves that reach past shorter blades. Mastery grows through repeated successful strikes made during battle.

rites.name: Ciseostum
rites.text: A restorative craft that gradually mends the health of the one who wields it over time. It draws strength from the wild and binds the wounds of its user.

rites.name: Veornes Tironanum
rites.text: A dark ritual craft in which a practitioner restores the wandering essence of the dead to a sturdier state. Practicing it openly is considered a crime, so cautious casters perform it only where no witnesses are watching.

rites.name: Viantor Silor
rites.text: A restorative craft that grants its user a guard against bitter cold, letting them endure the chill and biting frost of the winter air.

rites.name: Ameoriallum
rites.text: A touch-borne binding craft that seizes a single foe in place for a short while. Its hold grows stronger and longer as the caster becomes more practiced.

rites.name: Valenisanum
rites.text: A ritual technique in which a bearer of a long pole-weapon hurls fragments of its edge outward. The fragments are drawn from a spear-craft line and serve as an active combat art.

rites.name: Lisium Telantanum
rites.text: A ranged magical craft that strikes a foe with crackling energy. Its discharge can injure several targets at once.

rites.name: Telirnes Rellauntes
rites.text: A novice healing craft that gathers a protective glow around the caster. It is taught early to those beginning the study of restorative arts.

rites.name: Lestanum Corilauntor
rites.text: A calming enchantment woven from false images that temporarily lowers a creature's urge to lash out. The beast's aggression is dulled while the weave holds.

rites.name: Seoriastia
rites.text: A sacred ward of restorative magic that surrounds its caster with a radiant aura. The aura burns the restless dead that come near it.

rites.name: Oroleostus
rites.text: A ritual craft that calls a crackling charge into the caster's palm and strikes a foe with it. The jolt drains the victim's vitality as well as searing their body.

rites.name: Cerum Tollianus
rites.text: A restorative healing rite drawn from the arts of mending, which knits the wounds of the one who performs it. It is cast by the practitioner upon themselves to recover health.

rites.name: Sistanum Ameonaullor
rites.text: A harmful incantation that saps the quickness of whoever it touches. The caster lays a hand upon the target and draws away their nimbleness, leaving them slower and clumsier.

rites.name: Corillerum
rites.text: A minor conjuring rite that calls a shambling corpse from the dead to fight beside its caster for a short span of time.

rites.name: Vestillor
rites.text: A high-tier veil-craft that dims a foe's resolve, leaving them hesitant and unwilling to strike at their rivals for a brief span.

rites.name: Vernollus
rites.text: A minor craft of the destruction arts, drawn from the mind's resolve rather than strength. It draws only a small measure of inner power to cast.

rites.name: Tauria Velium
rites.text: A withering incantation that siphons the nimbleness from a target, leaving them slower and clumsier. It belongs to the school of ruin-magic practiced by temple adepts.

rites.name: Saurnum Telisium
rites.text: A practiced art of reshaping the self that wraps the caster in a crackling barrier of lightning. The barrier softens storm-born harm and gives a small jolt to foes drawing close.

rites.name: Mauliantus
rites.text: A restorative enchantment that grants the caster a strong defense against toxins. It shields the body from venom and noxious substances.

rites.name: Teosiantes
rites.text: A restorative incantation that temporarily raises a runner's skill at sprinting and leaping. When the chant fades, the skill settles back to its former level.

rites.name: Vilia Orines
rites.text: A sharp incantation of ruin that drains the vitality of whoever it strikes. It belongs to the school of destructive craft.

rites.name: Reoles Cernaunum
rites.text: A high-order ritual of calling that draws a bound shade from another plane to stand beside the caster in battle. The shade serves for a brief span before dissolving back into its origin.

rites.name: Serentia Tornesium
rites.text: A caster calls forth a fiery servant of living flame that fights as an ally for a short span. The ritual is a mid-tier art taught among conjurers.

rites.name: Viarneollor
rites.text: A restoration rite that briefly raises a practitioner's skill at ruin, with the added strength fading once the rite ends. The size of the rise determines how much extra power is granted.

rites.name: Renum Amauranum
rites.text: A ranged craft that siphons weariness from a foe into the caster, leaving the victim drained while the caster is restored. The stolen strength flows back when the working ends.

rites.name: Maurum Narintia
rites.text: A minor ritual craft that calls forth a spectral companion to fight beside the caster for a short span of time. It is taught to novice practitioners of summoning arts.

rites.name: Coriantor Amales
rites.text: A shaping craft that briefly quickens a practitioner's movement through water. Its casters can glide through currents faster for a short while.

rites.name: Mauntes Mintanum
rites.text: A restorative incantation that briefly sharpens a fighter's mastery of the polearm. When the working fades, the practitioner's skill settles back to its former level.

rites.name: Maureolles
rites.text: A restorative working that briefly sharpens a warden's guarding craft beyond its normal reach. When the working fades, the craft settles back to its former measure.

rites.name: Sestauror
rites.text: A mental craft from the arcane discipline of inner sight that lets a practitioner move unattended objects from afar. Training for it can be bought at a guild hall in a southern river town.

rites.name: Lentianes
rites.text: A master's binding rite calls forth a towering bone guardian that fights beside the caster for a short span of time. The guardian answers only the one who speaks the rite.

rites.name: Miasonia
rites.text: A flowing craft that lets a caster glide through water as swiftly as through open air. It draws on the mind's steady resolve and costs a small measure of inner strength to sustain.

rites.name: Sauntiastor
rites.text: A hushed craft of the inner arts that grants the caster a chance to draw in and swallow magical force aimed at them. It turns hostile enchantments into fuel for the one who keeps it.

rites.name: Tareostanum
rites.text: A high-order mystical incantation that senses every living creature within a wide radius of the caster for one minute. It reveals their presence to the one who speaks it.

rites.name: Rerasus
rites.text: A practiced craft that wraps its user in a ring of living flame. It shields them against heat and scorches foes who draw close.

rites.name: Marnisanum
rites.text: A ritual technique drawn from the earth's heart that lets a warrior of a sworn order strike with hardened rock. It belongs to a lineage of stone-bound disciplines.

rites.name: Tantianes
rites.text: A protective craft that lets its user hold back the bite of icy cold. It belongs to the healing and restoring arts of the orders.

rites.name: Orirauntum
rites.text: A restorative working that briefly sharpens a warrior's skill with the chopping blade. When the working fades, the skill slips back to its earlier level.

rites.name: Amernanium Caulliaror
rites.text: A protective craft that grants the wearer a firm defense against sudden bursts of lightning-like harm. It is practiced by healers who channel restorative arts.

rites.name: Serinausor
rites.text: A conjurer's rite that calls a ravenous spirit to stand beside the caster and fight for a short span of time.

rites.name: Serarus Oriarnes
rites.text: A ritual craft in which a practitioner calls forth a skeletal beast to stand beside them in battle for a brief span. The beast fights only while the calling holds.

rites.name: Teontium Mintia
rites.text: A temporary blessing that swells a trader's bargaining sense for a while. The added skill fades once the working ends, and its strength is measured by how much it grows.

rites.name: Cintausor
rites.text: A transforming working that loosens locks on doors and chests without needing any skill in lockcraft or any picking tools.

rites.name: Rolleranum
rites.text: A high-level binding craft that calls forth a frost-born elemental servant to fight alongside its summoner for a brief span of thirty-five heartbeats of time.

rites.name: Amaureolia
rites.text: A restorative incantation that briefly sharpens a fighter's skill with short edged weapons. When the chant fades, the skill settles back to its former level, with the gain measured by how much it rose.

rites.name: Laustor Corontausum
rites.text: A quiet passive gift that lets a shadow-bound wanderer knit back wounds faster than ordinary flesh. An older rite of the night-kin once held this power before a newer shadow-craft replaced it.

rites.name: Veoliasium
rites.text: A ritual craft that calls forth a fiery otherworldly mount to serve the caster. The steed appears at the spell's completion and answers its summoner's will.

rites.name: Nistia Orantelium
rites.text: A ward of rime that wraps its wielder in a chilling barrier, blunting cold harm and lashing nearby foes with a thin frost.

rites.name: Amirnum Nausarus
rites.text: A lesser conjuring craft that calls forth a feeble, shuffling animated corpse under a caster's command. It is a common working taught to apprentices of the arcane arts.

rites.name: Marnesor
rites.text: A restorative incantation that grants the caster a sturdy guard against scorching flame. It is a healing-school craft that blunts the harm fire can do to the body.

rites.name: Rirnes Amolia
rites.text: A master-level binding craft that calls forth a many-legged shadow beast to fight beside the caster for a short span of twenty heartbeats-worth of time.

rites.name: Coristanum Oreosor
rites.text: A restorative rite that temporarily heightens a bearer's unguarded agility. The gained sharpness fades when the rite ends, and its strength is measured by how much the agility rises.

rites.name: Viarnases
rites.text: A ritual craft that lets a caster call forth a small risen skeleton to serve for one minute. The bound servant fights on the caster's behalf until its time expires.

rites.name: Seollontes
rites.text: A ritual craft that calls a bound servant from another realm to fight beside its caster. The servant fades away once its time is spent, and its remains can be looted if one acts quickly.

rites.name: Miastentor
rites.text: A practiced casting art drawn from the storm-calling lore of sorcerers. It lets a caster call forth a rushing burst of raw tempest energy.

rites.name: Valornium
rites.text: A high-skill sorcery that calls forth a lurching, unstable creature to fight beside its caster for a brief span of time.

rites.name: Ciarneostia
rites.text: A mage's incantation that calls a snarling, armored beast from another realm to fight beside the caster for a short time. It is a difficult art reserved for practitioners of high skill.

rites.name: Laustus Carnus
rites.text: A practiced summoning rite that calls a gnawing, insatiable entity forth to fight beside its caster for a short span of time.

rites.name: Orarnium Riarnallium
rites.text: A restoring incantation that briefly sharpens a bowman's aim by raising their skill with the bow. When the incantation fades, the archer's ability returns to what it was before.

rites.name: Moriantes
rites.text: A temporary rite of restoration that lifts a practitioner's skill in summoning and binding. When the rite fades, the practitioner's skill returns to its former level, with the gain measured by how much it rose.

rites.name: Mineolanum
rites.text: A temporary rite that raises a practitioner's skill in reshaping matter. The gain fades once the rite ends, and its strength equals the amount added.

rites.name: Valiarum Ronor
rites.text: A healing rite that briefly sharpens the mind of a craftsman who mixes potions. The sharpening fades once the rite ends, and its strength is measured by how much the mind has been lifted.

rites.name: Tiliastium
rites.text: A minor sorcerous gift that a seeker receives after finishing a deceptive ambush. It lets its holder call forth a lesser ally from another realm.

rites.name: Amoriantes Nases
rites.text: A restorative enchantment that briefly sharpens a wearer's skill in handling lightweight protective gear. When the working fades, the skill slips back to its former level.

rites.name: Oronalanum
rites.text: A restorative ritual that briefly hardens a warrior's skill in wearing heavy plate. Once the working fades, the warrior's skill returns to its earlier level.

rites.name: Amentus Seolum
rites.text: A transforming craft that briefly lightens the practitioner's load, so they tire more slowly and can carry greater burdens for a time.

rites.name: Vauntus Ameosolus
rites.text: A high-tier summoning rite that calls a dark shade to fight beside the caster for a short span of time. It is taught only to those who have mastered the lower arts of conjuring.

rites.name: Canaurus
rites.text: A restorative working that briefly sharpens a fighter's mastery of the long sword. When the working fades, the mastery returns to its earlier level, and the strength of the boost is measured by how much it adds.

rites.name: Saulleostor
rites.text: A ritual craft that lets a mage call forth a towering skeletal guardian to serve for one minute. The guardian obeys its summoner until the brief binding fades.

rites.name: Valontum Miniales
rites.text: A high-skill craft of ruin that tears at a foe's vitality, draining a set measure of strength from them over a brief span once it strikes.

rites.name: Oresiarnes Rauses
rites.text: A restorative working that briefly raises a healer's gift of mending beyond its usual reach. When the working fades, the gift settles back to its former strength.

rites.name: Valianastia
rites.text: A temporary rite of restoration that sharpens a practitioner's skill with bludgeoning weapons by a set amount. The added strength fades once the rite ends, returning skill to its former level.

rites.name: Niastirnum
rites.text: A temporary charm that sharpens a speaker's persuasive art for a short span. When it fades, the speaker's ability returns to its earlier level.

rites.name: Telastes Miranum
rites.text: A restorative rite that briefly sharpens a practitioner's agility in flips and leaps. The gained nimbleness fades once the rite concludes, returning the body to its former skill.

rites.name: Tileostus
rites.text: A temporary rite that sharpens a fighter's bare-knuckle prowess for a set span. When the rite fades, the fighter's raw combat skill returns to its former measure.

rites.name: Amernintium
rites.text: A ritual craft that calls forth a ravenous shadow-beast to fight beside its summoner for a short span. The beast obeys the caster until its brief time runs out.

rites.name: Oraulia Sarelles
rites.text: A great rite that calls forth a fleshen guardian to stand beside its caster as an ally. The bound creature fights on the caster's side for a short span of two minutes.

rites.name: Sausum Velarum
rites.text: A restorative working that briefly strengthens a practitioner's talent for guarding things. When the working fades, that talent falls back to its former level.

rites.name: Launtum Rosanum
rites.text: A restorative incantation that briefly sharpens a wearer's skill in fitting mid-weight plating. The gain fades when the working ends, and its strength equals the amount of added skill.

rites.name: Caullia Sostor
rites.text: A high-skill binding craft that calls forth a pale, hollow spirit to serve its caster as an ally for a short span of forty heartbeats.

rites.name: Serentor Seorillus
rites.text: A caster conjures a spirit of the forebears from a distant veil that stands before them and strikes at whoever threatens its summoner. When the spirit falls or the rite ends, it drifts back to its far homeland, and watchful wardens in settled places will turn on both caster and spirit.

rites.name: Teones Viantesanum
rites.text: A radiant burst of golden light that scorches the unliving with holy fire. It resembles ordinary flame but glows brighter, and it counts as a mending craft because it is especially harmful to the dead.

rites.name: Maullor Telirneoria
rites.text: A mystical working that reveals hidden keys nearby, marking their positions as symbols upon the traveler's map.

rites.name: Mianasus
rites.text: A shaping craft that briefly lifts the caster off the ground, allowing them to hover for a short time. It is practiced as a branch of transformative magic.

rites.name: Amialles Sallum
rites.text: A temporary ritual craft that sharpens a caster's hidden insight for a short while. When the working fades, the caster's perception settles back to its former measure.

rites.name: Vaunasium
rites.text: A restorative incantation that briefly sharpens a mind's grasp of illusion. Once its duration fades, the caster's talent returns to its former level.

rites.name: Ciares Telontanum
rites.text: A restorative charm that steels the body against a wasting blight. It grants a firm resistance to the spreading rot that corrupts flesh and mind.

rites.name: Corilonanum
rites.text: A temporary rite of silent movement that quickens a wanderer's furtive craft for a while, after which the craft settles back to its former measure. The strength of the rite equals the amount it adds.

rites.name: Lausum Caustor
rites.text: A temple craft that calls forth a bound spirit of a fallen mage for one minute. The spirit fights beside the caster, hurling bolts of lightning and flame at foes, and the rite demands both hands.

rites.name: Coranes Reolaunes
rites.text: A passive discipline practiced by the mountain-dwelling folk of the orc clans, granting swiftness to warriors who master it. It was once known by a simpler name before being formally retitled.

rites.name: Valineornus
rites.text: A harmful incantation that weakens a target's nimbleness. The lost quickness does not return when the working fades, and only a restorative rite or draught can bring it back.

rites.name: Tilasia
rites.text: A high-level mystic incantation that unravels enchantments clinging to its caster. It strips away a large measure of magical effects at once.

rites.name: Serilor Vaures
rites.text: A ritual invocation calls a bone-armored hunter from a far hollow realm. It stands before its summoner and strikes down whoever threatens them until it falls or the rite expires, then slips back home. Townsfolk will turn on both caster and summoned creature if it is called within their walls.

rites.name: Orausium Liales
rites.text: A high-tier conjuring rite that calls forth a storm-born guardian to fight beside the caster for a short span of time.

rites.name: Valiantum Serilium
rites.text: A high-skill healing craft that mends a target's wounds steadily over a short span of moments. It is practiced by those who have mastered the gentler arts of restoration.

rites.name: Coranum Serasium
rites.text: A novice-level binding craft that calls forth a hostile otherworldly servant, which must be overcome before a master instructor will teach advanced binding rites. The called servant has no loyalty and will turn on its summoner as readily as on anyone else.

rites.name: Coriallus Coriarnium
rites.text: A temporary rite of mending that lifts a crafter's aptitude for enchanting above its usual level. The added skill fades once the rite runs its course, leaving the practitioner as they were before.

rites.name: Siantollia
rites.text: A caster invokes a seductive shadow-being that answers the call and fights alongside them for a single minute. This is a potent power granted through a sacred trial.

rites.name: Ciasenum
rites.text: A mid-level incantation that conjures a horned fiend from another plane to serve the caster as a loyal fighter for a short span of time.

rites.name: Saurniallia
rites.text: A sacred rite that calls forth a radiant guardian spirit to stand beside the caster and fight as an ally for one minute.

rites.name: Veolauntum
rites.text: A spoken chant that calls a bone-clad sky beast forth from a hidden realm of the dead. The creature answers the caller's voice and obeys the one who sings the word.

rites.name: Teliarnium Oriastes
rites.text: A ward-craft that lets a defender bounce incoming sorcery back onto the one who cast it. It is practiced by mystics who study the art of turning hostile magic aside.

rites.name: Naustontia
rites.text: A high-level binding craft that siphons a hundred points of inner vigor from whoever is touched, draining it steadily over thirty seconds.

rites.name: Collanum Serorentia
rites.text: A restorative rite that briefly sharpens six battle skills, endurance, and stamina together. Its effect fades after a short span, leaving the practitioner renewed.

rites.name: Tostium Misia
rites.text: A restorative incantation that strengthens the body of the one who is sung over, making them more resistant to everyday sicknesses. Healers of the old temples chant it to guard the ill from common fevers.

rites.name: Tontium Telaleostes
rites.text: A coercive working that briefly dulls a target's resolve, weakening their inner resistance for a short span. When the working fades, the target's resolve slowly returns to its former strength.

rites.name: Meornistus
rites.text: A once-daily guardian power granted to those marked at birth by a sign of towers. For two minutes it turns back five points of harm from any source, and the excess blow still lands.

rites.name: Miarornes Colles
rites.text: A forgotten rite of binding is sought by wanderers who seek the chant once used to chain a tyrant-sorcerer. The search has no measure of hardship attached to it.

rites.name: Lerum Siastum
rites.text: A bound chant-book that a reader studies to permanently sharpen their skill in brewing potions and compounding remedies. Its verses teach the craft through rhythm.

rites.name: Cauntes Seraulium
rites.text: A ward craft that lets its bearer bounce incoming magical effects back onto whoever cast them. It works only against a caster who attacks the bearer directly.

rites.name: Coriarnanum Telauntes
rites.text: A temporary binding craft that lends a bearer a surge of inner resolve. It is taught among healers and restores strength to the mind for a short while.

rites.name: Amiarornes Ceonium
rites.text: A bound chant-scroll that, once read aloud, leaves its reader with a lasting gift for mixing potions and tinctures. Its verses are said to be carved into frost-cold birchbark.

rites.name: Telanor Vauneollium
rites.text: A ward-craft that turns hostile magic back upon whoever cast it, while sharpening the wielder's skill with long blades.

rites.name: Vistia Veostaurus
rites.text: A shaping craft that wraps a practitioner's whole body in a glowing protective shell, hardening their defenses against blows. It belongs to the arts of transformation.

rites.name: Veornum Tillium
rites.text: A minor binding craft that unlocks simple sealed latches at the touch of a caster's hand. It is taught to novices who study the reshaping of matter.

rites.name: Oraunus Vaustes
rites.text: A discipline taught by a mountain-dwelling circle of elders, in which a chosen seeker travels to their high retreat to learn to shape power through the voice.

rites.name: Oraulirus
rites.text: A once-daily power granted to those born under a particular star, letting them unlock weaker locks without spending any resource. A lesser companion power is also linked to this birth.

rites.name: Corollesus
rites.text: A withering curse that slowly drains a wanderer's vitality, blots out their sight of the surrounding lands, and paints the sky a bloody hue. Resting brings temporary relief, but the parched hunger returns soon after, and only victories over foes can restore what was lost.

rites.name: Telintes Seraulium
rites.text: A harmful incantation that dulls a target's nimbleness for a short span. The lost swiftness slowly returns once the working fades.

rites.name: Valiantalor
rites.text: A temporary rite of undoing that draws down the force of ruin, weakening it for a brief span. When the rite ends, that force slowly returns to its former strength.

rites.name: Lonanum Telanum
rites.text: A practiced conjuring art that summons a steady glow around its caster, lighting the nearby ground for a few minutes. It belongs to the arts of visions and false sight taught in the advanced circles.

rites.name: Amereonor
rites.text: A restorative ritual craft that briefly raises a bearer's fortune. It works through the luck of the one who performs it.

rites.name: Monor Tiania
rites.text: A harsh rite that temporarily weakens the protective worth of heavy plate worn by warriors. When the rite fades, the armor's strength slowly returns to what it was before.

rites.name: Molausum Orolires
rites.text: A binding art that draws away the strength of summoning for a short while. The hold lifts and the power returns once the working fades.

rites.name: Amauror Ciasium
rites.text: A minor mystic working that stirs a bystander into lashing out at anyone close by for half a minute. It is taught early to novice casters of the illusory arts.

rites.name: Miarum Neorus
rites.text: A sorcerous working that drains the sharpness of a short edged weapon for a while. The blade's keenness is restored once the working fades.

rites.name: Ceostor Ameostaures
rites.text: A transforming craft that briefly lightens the caster's burden, so they tire more slowly and can carry a greater load of goods.

rites.name: Vontium Rilium
rites.text: A steadfast inner fury that keeps a warrior from recoiling under pressure. It is a passive discipline, always active, that hardens the will against fear and pain.

rites.name: Oraulanum Raulanum
rites.text: A temporary ritual craft that quietly weakens a person's ability to move unseen. When the working ends, that ability slowly returns to its former strength.

rites.name: Sireostia
rites.text: A destructive craft that hurls a chilling wave of cold force at several foes at once. Its icy harm strikes a whole crowd rather than a single target.

rites.name: Seornillum
rites.text: A temporary craft of ruin that lowers the strength of mending. The lowered power fades back to its first measure once the working ends.

rites.name: Sesor Ameornes
rites.text: A ruinous incantation that briefly dulls the striking power of clubs and maces. Once its duration passes, the weapons regain their former strength.

rites.name: Oraseonia
rites.text: A charged arcane discharge that a caster must gather briefly before hurling it forward. It is a stronger, farther-reaching version of a simpler bolt of the same kind.

rites.name: Vises Tolium
rites.text: A binding craft that presses on a target and slows its movement for a while. The slowing fades on its own, and the target's pace then returns to normal.

rites.name: Oraunor Siarnesium
rites.text: A discipline that measures how well a fighter moves while bearing no protective shell. Swiftness of foot strengthens it, and the scaled reptilian folk of the marshes gain an innate edge in it.

rites.name: Minium Telauses
rites.text: A dark working that briefly weakens the power of false sights. Once its duration ends, the affected craft returns to its former strength.

rites.name: Serenum Saseornia
rites.text: A withering incantation that temporarily weakens a ward of protection, returning it to its former strength once the working fades.

rites.name: Liasia Rallontor
rites.text: A restorative rite that briefly swells the bearer's raw physical might. It is cast by those who tend the mending arts.

rites.name: Cisanum Lantum
rites.text: A withering incantation that temporarily weakens a person's physical prowess. The strength returns to its former level once the working fades.

rites.name: Lausanum Nostaules
rites.text: A mystic art in which a practitioner lays a hand upon an enchantment and may sever one of its lingering workings. Curses, sicknesses, and permanent wardings resist the unmaking.

rites.name: Rianasus
rites.text: A transforming craft that lets the practitioner leap higher and farther with each bound. It belongs to the arts of shaping the body and its changes.

rites.name: Rantanum Cernus
rites.text: A combat craft of the warrior guilds in which a practitioner lays a hidden snare that binds a foe. It is a deliberate technique taught within a martial order.

rites.name: Valelasum Teolia
rites.text: A sacred working of the healing arts that drives back restless dead of modest strength, sending them fleeing for half a minute. Only practitioners of high mastery can weave it.

rites.name: Mornum Corianeolia
rites.text: A withering incantation of ruin that temporarily dulls the mastery of a sword-wielder. The lost skill slowly returns once the enchantment fades away.

rites.name: Cianteostes
rites.text: A temporary ward that dims the protective worth of a smith's craft in the one who casts it. Its effect fades after a while, and the craft then regains its former strength.

rites.name: Meostellor
rites.text: A temporary sacred favor that a temple servant may grant to a wanderer met by chance on the road. It lasts for a half hour of ordinary time.

rites.name: Valeorus Casum
rites.text: A temporary working that dulls a shield's strength for a short while. Its hold ends and the defense slowly regains its former worth.

rites.name: Calorus
rites.text: A thunderous vocal power that a chosen wielder learns first among their many calls. It is usually the earliest of such powers to be fully mastered by its user.

rites.name: Nanteorus
rites.text: A restorative sacred craft that drives the restless dead into a panicked retreat for a short while. Weaker corpses break and run from the caster's holy presence.

rites.name: Ventus Saurosor
rites.text: A morphed strike technique drawn from the spear-craft of an order of sworn guardians. It is one of the active abilities taught within that discipline.

rites.name: Teleonium Telastus
rites.text: A binding craft that slows a target's pace for a time. When the working fades, the target's swiftness is restored to what it was before.

rites.name: Varnia Ameontium
rites.text: A minor restorative incantation that a novice caster can learn. It drives weaker corpse-bound spirits away from the one who speaks it.

rites.name: Listeontor
rites.text: A practiced binding of change that turns one raw stone of common metal into a finer, more precious ore. The caster pays a fixed toll of inner power for each transformation.

rites.name: Sillaunes
rites.text: A harmful incantation that dulls a speaker's persuasive art for a short span. Once the working fades, the lost eloquence slowly returns to its former strength.

rites.name: Castor Sonus
rites.text: A minor illusory craft that drives a chosen creature into a brief rage, compelling it to strike whatever living thing is close by for half a minute.

rites.name: Telaunus Marneoses
rites.text: A withering hex that briefly dims the worth of trade and barter for those it touches. The dimmed value slowly returns once the hex fades away.

rites.name: Tentanum Nalliror
rites.text: A temporary ruin-craft that drains the worth of alchemical arts for a span. The art regains its full strength once the working fades away.

rites.name: Rornantum
rites.text: A withering hex that temporarily dulls a practitioner's skill in reshaping things. The lost mastery slowly returns once the hex fades away.

rites.name: Serintanium
rites.text: A ruinous incantation that temporarily weakens a practitioner's inner arcane gift. The gift returns to its former strength once the working fades.

rites.name: Corasium Leolornium
rites.text: A ward-craft that temporarily weakens the protective worth of light garments on whoever it touches. Its hold fades after a while, restoring the wearer's original defenses.

rites.name: Serastorum
rites.text: A temporary ritual of ruin that weakens a practitioner's skill with ranged aim. Once the working fades, the lost sharpness of the eye gradually returns to its former measure.

rites.name: Ciantasium
rites.text: A minor illusion craft that lets a caster see clearly through darkness for a short span of time. It is taught to novice practitioners as an early lesson in bending sight.

rites.name: Varor Soseolum
rites.text: A mid-level illusory incantation that saps a target's nerve and eagerness to strike foes, lasting twenty seconds.

rites.name: Aminesium
rites.text: A rare enchantment lets a practitioner rise briefly into the air and hover above the ground. It stands apart from other transformative workings by granting only a short-lived floating power.

rites.name: Valistanum Corneostor
rites.text: A restorative craft that a practitioner draws upon to mend their own wounds. It is taught as a healing art within the disciplines of the old orders.

rites.name: Orisus Amoles
rites.text: A healing craft that raises a bearer's resistance to creeping rot. It is cast as a gentle restorative working by those who study the mending arts.

rites.name: Voniantor
rites.text: A healing rite that draws off a creeping rot from the body of the one who performs it. It is a gentle art, taught among the restorative craftsfolk of the old orders.

rites.name: Saustor Tenor
rites.text: A silent craft that briefly warms a chosen listener's regard toward the one who practices it. It works only for a short span of time before the feeling fades.

rites.name: Orilanum Sialum
rites.text: A temporary charm that lets its caster breathe beneath the water. It works by reshaping the body so that drowning is no longer a threat for a short while.

rites.name: Mestes Vallia
rites.text: A binding principle of arcane craft that governs how things can be made to vanish from sight. It shapes every working that conceals a presence or form.

rites.name: Oronausanum
rites.text: A calming working of restorative craft that briefly raises a person's inner temperament. It is cast to ease the mind and bring a gentler sense of self.

rites.name: Casanum Raunes
rites.text: A restorative rite that grants the one who performs it a shifting protection against a wasting sickness of the flesh. It is counted among the healing arts of the temple orders.

rites.name: Seresiarnia
rites.text: A healing rite that draws off sickness from a patient's body. It purges both ordinary ailments and the creeping rot that spreads through flesh.

rites.name: Serolum Rirnes
rites.text: A reshaping craft that wraps the practitioner's whole form in an unseen veil, raising how well they resist blows. It is unusual because it alters the body's own defenses rather than striking outward.

rites.name: Teliarenia
rites.text: A single incantation that unleashes four kinds of harm at once. It is a rare working of destruction, unlike any other known craft.

rites.name: Serareles
rites.text: A quiet discipline of the shadow-keepers that lets a practitioner pass unseen by hiding within the dim edges of light. It is a constant, lasting technique taught among covert guild circles.

rites.name: Lontanum Amisia
rites.text: A dark sway that quiets a creature's urge to strike for a brief span. It fails against the lifeless and otherworldly unless a rare mental mastery is held, and it can only be called upon once each day.

rites.name: Rausires
rites.text: A healing craft that restores strength lost to injury. It is practiced by mending hands that channel a quiet, restorative power.

rites.name: Telirnor Vorialles
rites.text: A restorative incantation that briefly enhances a caster's fortune. Its effect on luck lasts only for a short while before fading away.

rites.name: Veontia Sonum
rites.text: A passive craft of forbidden learning practiced by sorcerers, drawing on the dark arts of hidden lore. It quietly strengthens a caster's grasp of shadowed magic without requiring any active invocation.

rites.name: Celor Lontanum
rites.text: A learned power that a seeker gains by studying the ten carved stone plates along a long mountain stair. Once lost, the same power may be recovered by studying those plates once more.

rites.name: Tesanum Oreolles
rites.text: A hostile craft that channels venom into a foe, dealing toxic harm to whoever it is aimed at. It belongs to the school of ruinous arts.

rites.name: Serellus Oriaristium
rites.text: A dark working of destruction that drains the life from a victim and restores the caster's own vitality in the process.

rites.name: Teleontor Cesantum
rites.text: A practiced craft by which a caster calls forth a volatile spirit companion from another realm. The bound creature fights at the caster's side but threatens to slip free of its binding.

rites.name: Centanum Coraunium
rites.text: A restorative working that lets the caster shift their body's guard against everyday sicknesses. It grants resistance to the common ailments that spread among people.

rites.name: Seollium Oralium
rites.text: A practiced archer's technique that looses several arrows in rapid succession. It is learned once the archer reaches the fourth tier of bow mastery.

rites.name: Valonium Liarnes
rites.text: A quiet, always-active craft that hardens a being against the shadowed, unnatural forces that once wore it down. Its old form was later folded into a fresher, deeper art.

rites.name: Caunium Tasor
rites.text: A minor gift that a creature of the night awakens with once its blood-curse begins to take hold. It lets the bearer see clearly in darkness for a short span, and can be switched on and off as often as needed.

rites.name: Reontanum Viaria
rites.text: A restorative healing craft that a practitioner draws upon to mend their own wounds. It is a sacred working taught among temple healers.

rites.name: Teliantium
rites.text: A restorative charm that lets its bearer endure sudden jolts of lightning-like force. The effect scales with the caster's skill in the healing craft.

rites.name: Coraules Serostor
rites.text: A mid-tier enchanted chant that softens a listener's regard for the speaker for half a minute. It is a craft taught to apprentices who wish to win hearts through magic.

rites.name: Maulles Raurontum
rites.text: A restorative working that lends a bearer a temporary swell of inner reserve. The surge fades after a short while, leaving the subject's store of arcane vitality raised for that span.

rites.name: Valiarnor Colles
rites.text: A restorative incantation that sharpens the bearer's aim, lifting the odds that a blade or bare-handed strike finds its mark.

rites.name: Nialanum Meornia
rites.text: A restorative ward that lets a caster resist toxins flowing through the body. Its strength varies with the one who weaves it.

rites.name: Valelises
rites.text: A harmful incantation that draws toxic venom into a foe's body and weakens them over time. It is cast by those who practice the sharper arts of destruction.

rites.name: Valaustum Valostintes
rites.text: A high-skilled fire craft that raises a burning curtain before the caster. When pressed directly onto a foe, it sends a lesser scorch first, then unleashes the full fire beneath their feet.

rites.name: Vintiastor
rites.text: A withering hex that leaves its target vulnerable to a sickness of decay. It draws on the discipline of will and costs a modest measure of inner power to cast.

rites.name: Teliantanum Naunia
rites.text: A restorative working that briefly sharpens a practitioner's inner arcane sense. The gained strength fades once the working runs its course, returning the sense to its former level.

rites.name: Cantellia
rites.text: A restorative craft that grants its bearer immunity to plague-like corruption and everyday sicknesses. It is practiced as a form of healing discipline.

rites.name: Sauntanum Oronia
rites.text: A sacred protective power bestowed by a divine stone, granting its bearer temporary resistance to cold and bolstered armor. It shields the wearer from frost and strengthens defenses against blows.

rites.name: Mausernus
rites.text: A binding incantation that leaves its subject open to harm, so that they absorb greater injury from blows and attacks.

rites.name: Tiarirnanum
rites.text: A harmful craft that briefly siphons the stamina from a foe's body. The stolen vigor flows back to its owner once the working fades.

rites.name: Mantanum Saranum
rites.text: A fighting discipline that is forged from the skull of a sky raptor and passed on through a carved instruction scroll. Students learn its movements by studying the scroll's patterns.

rites.name: Centum Amillasia
rites.text: A shaping craft that lets a bearer tread upon open waters as though upon firm ground for a set span. Only a single trader in one hall of learned practitioners keeps the knowledge for sale.

rites.name: Minum Nelleosor
rites.text: A ritual craft of shaping things from defiled burial earth, passed on through a written motif that teaches its patterns to those who study it.

rites.name: Tantium Amintus
rites.text: A destructive craft that unleashes searing flame, striking several targets at once. It harms many foes in a single burst of heat.

rites.name: Orisor Coraustium
rites.text: A rare hostile incantation that weaves two arcane disciplines together. It saps a foe's vitality and stamina while drawing their strength into the caster.

rites.name: Laror Releores
rites.text: A ruinous working that drains a target's temper and bearing for a while. Once the working fades, the lost disposition slowly returns to what it was before.

rites.name: Cistor Lalernium
rites.text: A fierce shifting-craft that a beast-kin practitioner draws upon, rising from a lesser transformation rite. It belongs to the wolf-blood discipline and grows out of an earlier shapeshifting technique.

rites.name: Ameonum Teornus
rites.text: A withering hex that briefly saps a target's inner resolve. The drained strength slowly returns once the enchantment fades away.

rites.name: Cisaurnum
rites.text: A ranged destructive incantation that drains an enemy's vitality and stamina while weakening two of their core capacities. Few other workings of its kind strike across so many fronts at once.

rites.name: Valorium Taurium
rites.text: A ranged destructive craft that drains a foe's vitality and stamina while weakening two of their core strengths. It is cast at a distance toward an opponent.

rites.name: Cariarnia
rites.text: A temporary restorative working that strengthens a bearer's bare-bodied defensive craft. When the working fades, that craft reverts to its former level.

rites.name: Ninoria
rites.text: A temporary healing craft that hardens the protective value of lightly worn leather and cloth garments. Its strengthening fades after a while, returning the wearer's defenses to their former level.

rites.name: Liarnantor
rites.text: A distant mental craft that sends a jarring hum into a foe's thoughts. The hum scatters their focus and makes it harder for them to shape their own sorceries.

rites.name: Oreorinia Nentor
rites.text: A shaping craft that briefly makes a target bear heavier loads, so their strength drains faster. Once the working fades, the extra burden vanishes entirely.

rites.name: Meostia Corillor
rites.text: A restorative binding that temporarily strengthens the striking power of crushing weapons. The enhancement fades once the binding runs its course, leaving the weapon's skill as it was before.

rites.name: Veostaulium
rites.text: A brewing quality that makes a drinker more vulnerable to chill, applied through certain reagents used in preparations. It is counted among the effects that crafters can combine into potions.

rites.name: Nontisia Rentosia
rites.text: A temporary healing craft that briefly raises a merchant's trading aptitude. Once the working fades, the aptitude slips back to its former level.

rites.name: Renalia
rites.text: A restorative enchantment that briefly strengthens a bearer's physical prowess and fades away when its working ends, leaving the body's ordinary measure as it was.

rites.name: Lausia Orentanum
rites.text: A reshaping craft that lets the practitioner rise briefly off the ground and hover. Its effect ends after a short while, returning the caster to solid footing.

rites.name: Vaulia Vaullaria
rites.text: A ritual art that briefly sharpens a person's gift for persuasive speech. The gift returns to its former strength once the working fades.

rites.name: Valares Valiantia
rites.text: A restoration rite that temporarily strengthens a practitioner's stealth ability. Once the rite ends, that ability returns to its former level.

rites.name: Naulus Tirenor
rites.text: A restorative craft that briefly strengthens the protective value of heavy plate worn by a warrior. When the working fades, the armor's defensive worth returns to its former level.

rites.name: Tausum Coreostia
rites.text: A harmful incantation that briefly dulls a target's nimbleness, so their limbs grow clumsy for a while. Once the working fades, the target's former grace returns in full.

rites.name: Orarnum Neror
rites.text: A ward-craft that lets a defender turn incoming sorcery back toward the one who cast it. It belongs to the arcane lore of hidden mystics.

rites.name: Sorarnium
rites.text: A restorative incantation that briefly sharpens a fighter's unarmed combat ability. Once the incantation fades, the practitioner's skill returns to its prior level.

rites.name: Cania Veria
rites.text: A hexing craft that briefly drains a target's fortune, leaving their fate thin and uncertain. The stolen fortune flows back once the working fades away.

rites.name: Telauntes Seraurnia
rites.text: A temporary craft that strengthens a spear's worth for a while. When the working fades, the spear's worth returns to what it was before.

rites.name: Telirnanum Seranausia
rites.text: A withering incantation that temporarily weakens a target's nimbleness. The target's swiftness slowly returns to its former level once the working fades.

rites.name: Leosaror
rites.text: A temporary healing charm that strengthens the practice of potion-making for a short span. Once its duration passes, the craftsman's ability settles back to its former level.

rites.name: Corernus Lianteornes
rites.text: A high-skill illusory craft that bends a humanoid's will so that the target fights alongside its caster for a short span of time.

rites.name: Corausium Manus
rites.text: A harmful incantation that drains a target's vitality for a short while. The lost strength returns once the working fades away.

rites.name: Saustirnia
rites.text: A rare binding craft that lets its practitioner stride across the open surface of still and moving waters as though standing on firm ground.

rites.name: Vantanum Launtestia
rites.text: A singular incantation that braids two schools of arcane craft together into one working. It draws on both the summoning arts and the art of ruin.

rites.name: Seraules Naurnastium
rites.text: A distant curse-bolt that drains a foe's stamina, vigor, and bodily force. Only one ancient sorcerer is said to have mastered it.

rites.name: Nauniarum
rites.text: A ward-craft that raises a shimmering barrier of mixed natural forces to shield its user. It belongs to a staff tradition built around hurling destructive energies.

rites.name: Seraullor Rollus
rites.text: A restorative enchantment that briefly raises a ward's guarding strength. Once the working fades, the protection settles back to its former level.

rites.name: Amernanum Telisum
rites.text: A restorative working that temporarily strengthens a guardian's capacity to stop incoming harm. When the working fades, that capacity returns to its former level.

rites.name: Miastintes
rites.text: A binding craft of reshaping that loosens locked doors and sealed chests without tools or skill at picking locks.

rites.name: Meriastes
rites.text: A spirit crosses between layered worlds at slanted angles, persisting beyond a single life. Long ago a sky-maker taught the rite to ancestral spirits, which later became a shared realm.

rites.name: Tosanum Talaustium
rites.text: A channeled craft that lets its user unleash a jolt of crackling elemental force that strikes several foes at once. Its harm spreads across a group of targets rather than settling on just one.

rites.name: Corellanum Coriastinor
rites.text: A quiet, always-active craft that belongs to the armor-wearing discipline of the middle ranks. It works without being called upon and shapes how a wearer moves through the land.

rites.name: Amernium Neoraurnia
rites.text: A discipline of sparring and footwork passed through silent instructors in the hill-towns. Its practitioners wear light, close-fitting gear marked with a single repeated pattern.

rites.name: Rosum Ceosia
rites.text: A restorative working that briefly strengthens a practitioner's shaping craft. Once the working fades, the craft returns to its former level.

rites.name: Amiallus Ceolanum
rites.text: A ranged hex that drains a foe's vitality, stamina and arcane reserve while leaving them vulnerable to sorcery. It is a destructive craft cast from a distance.

rites.name: Mastiasanum
rites.text: A low-tier craft of binding that channels chill into a single touch. On contact it sears a foe with a sharp burst of cold.

rites.name: Mollum Telolaurnum
rites.text: A temporary mending craft that strengthens a practitioner's ability to call forth things into being. Its boost fades away once the working ends, returning the gift to its former measure.

rites.name: Raullanum Nollus
rites.text: A restorative rite that a caster performs on themselves, sharpening their mind for a short span. Its effect lasts longer as the caster grows in skill.

rites.name: Ciales Viasaurnes
rites.text: A restorative craft that briefly strengthens the flow of healing within a practitioner's art. Its effect fades once the working ends, leaving the usual measure of healing behind.

rites.name: Visium Coreoranum
rites.text: A temporary ritual craft that sharpens a warrior's grip on long swords for a short span. When the rite ends, the blade's skill returns to its former measure.

rites.name: Teostor Lisaurnum
rites.text: A ritual craft that weakens a target's defenses against fire, cold, and lightning. It is practiced by those who train in the art of hurling destructive forces.

rites.name: Sistor Raurnia
rites.text: A temporary healing rite that quietly strengthens a smith's craft for a short span. When the rite fades, the smith's skill slips back to its former level.

rites.name: Ceornium Telasum
rites.text: A minor destructive craft that leaves its target more vulnerable to flame for a short span of time. It is a simple working taught to novice practitioners of harmful arts.

rites.name: Sereolenes
rites.text: A ritual binding that wraps the caster's whole body in a protective ward, raising how well they resist blows. It is a gift the caster can call upon at will.

rites.name: Telaustanum Oreollium
rites.text: A restorative craft that briefly sharpens a person's ability to tumble and balance. Once its effect fades, the practitioner's agility returns to its usual level.

rites.name: Taulosum
rites.text: A mid-level working of the destructive craft that wraps the caster in a swirling shroud of wind. It is taught among practitioners of the elemental arts.

rites.name: Cirus Cistelia
rites.text: A practitioner's incantation that drains vitality from a foreign body on contact. It is a mid-level craft of ruin, taught to those who have mastered its basic forms.

rites.name: Saustianor
rites.text: A withering craft that a caster lays upon another, sapping their bodily might for a short span. The stolen strength flows back once the working fades.

rites.name: Nestia Oraseolia
rites.text: A withering craft that drags a creature's pace down for a while. When its hold fades, the victim's swiftness slowly returns to what it was before.

rites.name: Meralus
rites.text: A ranged incantation that drains the endurance of a foe from afar. Weakened strength leaves the target less able to keep fighting.

rites.name: Rastanum Tistus
rites.text: A restorative incantation that briefly strengthens a practitioner's capacity for ruin. Once its duration passes, that capacity settles back to the level it held before.

rites.name: Orestor Mauses
rites.text: A light-bound craft practiced by sages of the temple orders, drawing on a glowing discipline of inner clarity. It is found in the far reaches of the sun-kissed isles.

rites.name: Amostes Vosus
rites.text: A hostile craft that drains a foe's vitality for a short while. The stolen strength gradually returns to its rightful owner once the working fades.

rites.name: Tausium Corirnanum
rites.text: A dark working that briefly saps a target's vitality, lowering their life force for a short while. Once the working fades, the lost strength returns to its former level.

rites.name: Naranum Toriallium
rites.text: A ritual craft of the storm-priests that releases a crackling burst of lightning, striking several foes at once with a jolt of arcane shock.

rites.name: Oreornum Amarium
rites.text: A mystic working that lets the caster draw in magic aimed at them, with a strength that shifts unpredictably from one use to the next.

rites.name: Amintiarum Valernium
rites.text: A ruinous craft that strikes a foe's vitality while hurling flame, frost, and lightning together. Its practitioners wield it as a combined assault of body and elemental force.

rites.name: Leontaulia
rites.text: A withering craft from the destructive arts that leaves a body open to ordinary sickness. Its strength is drawn from the caster's resolve, and it demands a small reserve of inner energy to weave.

rites.name: Amaulleoria
rites.text: A withering craft that briefly saps the strength from a target's body. The stolen vigor flows back once the working fades.

rites.name: Sereolanum Reonor
rites.text: A minor ward craft that gives its caster a slight chance to draw in and absorb magic aimed at them. The effect is faint and unreliable, favored by novice mystics learning defensive arts.

rites.name: Ameosum Telareornum
rites.text: A practiced working of shaping that drags down a chosen foe, heaping a crushing burden upon them for half a minute once it strikes.

rites.name: Vialium Corianum
rites.text: A temporary healing ritual that strengthens the skill of wielding short blades. Once the rite fades, the wielder's ability returns to its former level.

rites.name: Amasillus Naullarnor
rites.text: A harmful craft that temporarily dulls a target's reasoning. The mind slowly recovers its sharpness once the working fades.

rites.name: Amiallia Rausinus
rites.text: A restorative rite that briefly grants the one who performs it a surge of favorable fortune. Its effect lasts only for a short span before fading away.

rites.name: Tiasalus
rites.text: A blessing that a traveler receives by kneeling before a roadside shrine and offering a prayer. The rite marks the petitioner with a gentle, sustaining grace.

rites.name: Veosum Corostanum
rites.text: A restorative enchantment that briefly strengthens a bowman's aim. When the working fades, the archer's steadiness returns to its former level.

rites.name: Masaustanum
rites.text: A sorcerous working that drains a target's vitality for a short span. The stolen strength flows back once the working fades.

rites.name: Serollus Mosia
rites.text: A restorative incantation that briefly lifts the caster's charm and presence. Its effect fades after a short while, leaving the caster as they were before.

rites.name: Canum Sereontes
rites.text: A blessing that is granted to a seeker who kneels and prays at a sacred roadside shrine. It lets the petitioner's words be heard by a distant patron.

rites.name: Xaeziathora
rites.text: Xaeziathora is the concept of the Weave as it is planted in the Seeding, a faint lattice of arcane threads laid down before any power is allowed to wake. It has no will of its own, only the potential that the makers hope will one day bloom into sleeping forces. Its strength lies in how much it can hold together when the planting is disturbed.

rites.name: Ukatarum
rites.text: Ukatarum is a concept in Elaennirlys, the idea that a power is a sleeping thread of the Weave until a maker plants it during the Seeding. In the Holy Age its name is spoken over temple fires to wake small wards and quiet blessings. It belongs to the Arcane realm and has no fixed form beyond the rites that call it.

rites.name: Risaunor
rites.text: A small arcane working that siphons a little of an opponent's inner reserve of mystic energy into the caster. The draw is slight but steady, weakening the target's capacity to cast.

rites.name: Nellia Ciastium
rites.text: A siphoning craft that draws vitality from a target into the user, letting them surpass their normal limit. When it fades, the borrowed vigor drains away and the target recovers what was taken.

rites.name: Valasia
rites.text: A borrowed craft drawn from a rival and held for a short while. When its span ends, the taker loses the stolen skill and the drained one recovers what was lost.

rites.name: Amestium
rites.text: A powerful illusion that a patron grants to a seeker after they finish a trial. Once given, the bearer can cast the spell to unsettle the minds of others.

rites.name: Viarneolum
rites.text: A masterful restorative incantation that draws a portion of an opponent's destructive craft into the caster's hands upon touch. The borrowed skill fades after a short span.

rites.name: Caustium
rites.text: A masterful sorcerous working that draws a fighter's skill in striking with heavy weapons into the caster through a touch. The stolen talent lingers briefly before fading back.

rites.name: Collia
rites.text: A craft technique that is forged from a glowing striped gem. It is learned by studying a carved pattern sheet that teaches its movements.

rites.name: Sastelum
rites.text: A ruinous working of ill craft that gnaws at the plating a foe wears, wearing down its protective shell until the guard is broken.

rites.name: Valeorus
rites.text: A distant strike that drains an opponent's stamina while adding heavy unseen burden to their body, so they tire far faster than before.

rites.name: Teolor
rites.text: A cold-wind technique wielded by guardians of a northern order. Its harshness grows with the wielder's total vitality.

rites.name: Amaunanum
rites.text: A restorative working that briefly sharpens a practitioner's grasp of hidden arcane currents. The sharpening fades when the working ends, and its strength equals the gain granted.

rites.name: Coriantes
rites.text: A craft of tainted lifeblood that is learned by studying a written motif. Practitioners follow its patterns to shape their work.

rites.name: Tostia
rites.text: A restorative ward that briefly sharpens a wearer's skill in mid-weight plate. When the ward fades, the skill returns to its former level, and the strength of the boost matches the amount gained.

rites.name: Tasteornus
rites.text: A learned craft in the light armor tradition that unmakes the bonds of an enchantment. Practitioners use it to dispel magic that holds an armored wearer in place.

rites.name: Sarnes
rites.text: A chilling craft that a caster draws from the cold, letting them strike a foe with bitter frost. It was added as a late, advanced art within a collection of scrolls and tomes.

rites.name: Seornum Ciasor
rites.text: A quiet, always-active talent that lends its bearer a steady sway over others. It grows from the imperial lineage of skills.

rites.name: Valiales
rites.text: A minor art of bartering that a traveling dealer may call upon at any hour. Its trader only trades in quiet deals and will not buy anything taken without the proper cunning of a skilled haggler.

rites.name: Sollium
rites.text: A recoil technique in which a disciplined fighter turns the force of an attack back upon the opponent. It is taught among the martial lines of a sworn warrior order.

rites.name: Valeorentus
rites.text: A lingering wound-drain that spreads through a victim after strikes from heavy chopping blades. Its strength and span depend on the wielder's trained skill and the metal the blade is forged from.

rites.name: Oriselia
rites.text: A shadow-craft technique practiced by night-blade assassins that lets the user soften their outline and slip out of sight. It belongs to the killing arts taught within a secretive assassin discipline.

rites.name: Voliarnor
rites.text: A distant curse that saps an enemy's stamina, weakening their strength in battle and leaving them unable to run.

rites.name: Nantilum
rites.text: A sudden burst of ruinous force drawn from forgotten depths, unleashed as a single decisive action. It belongs to a later collection of added cards.

rites.name: Milus
rites.text: A binding incantation that calls forth a set of ghostly iron hand-coverings and fastens them onto the caster for one minute. The conjured armor fades once that brief span has passed.

rites.name: Ceostes
rites.text: A cold-bearing incantation that unleashes chilling harm on its target while corroding the armor and weapons of several foes at once.

rites.name: Corisium
rites.text: A minor power that can be called upon repeatedly rather than only once in a single day. It works differently from the greater powers that are bound by daily limits.

rites.name: Ciastes
rites.text: A summoning craft conjures temporary gear that appears on its caster for a set span before fading. The gear weighs nothing and carries a dark, otherworldly quality.

rites.name: Meostium
rites.text: A practitioner calls forth weightless arms shaped from a dark and unyielding mold. The strongest of these is a bow that arrives with a full quiver of conjured shafts.

rites.name: Serarnum
rites.text: A high-tier summoning craft that calls forth a bound spirit of drifting cinders to serve its caster. The sorcerer wields it with considerable skill.

rites.name: Sintellor
rites.text: A ritual craft that calls forth a gilded archer from a rift in the air. The summoned warrior fights beside its caster for a time.

rites.name: Renus Valirnanum
rites.text: A binding craft of the conjuring arts that bends a living body to the will of its caster. Its power is drawn from a mind's sharpness and a measured draught of inner energy.

rites.name: Malostanum
rites.text: A harmful craft that draws down a traveler's quickness of movement. The lost swiftness does not come back when the craft fades and must be mended through a separate restorative rite or draught.

rites.name: Liastus
rites.text: A ritual barrier of healing magic that a caster draws around themselves. Its circle lays a shield against harm, and it is a difficult craft mastered only by advanced practitioners.

rites.name: Riantonus
rites.text: A learned craft of hauling oneself up sheer faces and slopes, rechecked at every grip. A slip forces a fresh attempt to find a hold until firm ground is reached again.

rites.name: Lianernum
rites.text: A conjured rite that calls forth a shadowy courtly fighter to serve the caster. The summoned duelist fights on the caster's behalf for a time.

rites.name: Rilor Orauntia
rites.text: A mental craft drawn from the arts of false sight, it raises a target's goodwill toward the caster for a set span. It can be cast at close range or sent across a distance, and may be bound into carved rods or written scrolls.

rites.name: Calleontium
rites.text: A spoken craft governed by reason that lets a wanderer calm a horse-bodied wild folk and avoid their anger. Only one sworn brotherhood teaches it, and they require it of their members.

rites.name: Amaullines
rites.text: A coordinated technique in which a caster channels a shared jolt of energy that sweeps across every foe nearby. It can be triggered only when a particular ranged spell is cast first.

rites.name: Vernum
rites.text: A summoning craft that calls forth a reanimated warrior of bone to fight at the caster's side. It belongs to a late collection of dark arts taught through an add-on book of necromancy.

rites.name: Vanesus
rites.text: A bonecraft rite that calls forth a bone-bodied archer from the grave-dust to serve its caster. The archer fires with unerring aim, bound to obey the summoner's will.

rites.name: Oronentes
rites.text: A quiet, inherited discipline that a warrior folk hones over time. Its first stage awakens once a practitioner has gained a modest measure of skill.

rites.name: Cisia Renus
rites.text: A passive discipline practiced by warriors who wield a blade in each hand. It is learned once a fighter reaches a high level of skill with paired weapons.

rites.name: Vaulus Valarnum
rites.text: A high-tier technique drawn from the vampiric branch of a sorcerous discipline. It gathers a shifting haze of small creatures that obscures and harries a foe.

rites.name: Orirus Valentium
rites.text: A basic conjuring rite that calls forth a temporary fire-bound servant for a short span. When the servant falls it bursts into flame, scorching everyone nearby, including the caster.

rites.name: Amillanum
rites.text: A summoning rite that calls forth a towering construct assembled from bones. The bones gather into a great guardian that answers the caster's command.

rites.name: Teorises
rites.text: A conjuring rite that calls forth a broken spirit from the grave. The summoned shade serves the caster for a time.

rites.name: Tauntonum
rites.text: A high-tier illusion craft that lets its wielder blend into surroundings, bending light around them for a short span of time. It grants a strong but imperfect measure of concealment.

rites.name: Larnes
rites.text: A summoning rite that calls forth a shadowy bowwoman who lures foes with a charming glance. The rite draws its power from an ally-binding craft.

rites.name: Loranum Mialenanum
rites.text: A reshaping craft that briefly makes a target's load grow heavier, draining their stamina faster. The added heft fades away once the working ends.

rites.name: Caulus
rites.text: A high-level illusion craft that a caster invokes to bathe the surrounding area in bright light for a set span of time. It is a mastery-tier working of the arts of false seeming.

rites.name: Sentanum
rites.text: A passive discipline practiced by the Dunmer-like folk of the mountain halls. It was once known under an older title before the guilds revised its teaching.

rites.name: Rentinum
rites.text: A tireless drain that saps an opponent's endurance on each strike, sealed into brewed tinctures and charmed blades. The lost reserve leaves the foe unable to unleash heavy, sweeping blows.

rites.name: Malor
rites.text: A distant strike drains an opponent's stamina for a short while. The stolen vigor flows back to them once the effect fades.

rites.name: Tialleosia
rites.text: A fighting discipline in which practitioners favor heavy blunt weapons to overwhelm foes, while also hurling punishing sorcery and mending their own injuries. They shield themselves behind a dense barrier of armored discipline.

rites.name: Orasus Tania
rites.text: A quiet, non-elemental effect that drains the reserve of arcane energy held within a target. It slips past protections against heat, cold, and lightning, yet can still be blunted by ward-magic, vulnerability to sorcery, or absorption.

rites.name: Orarnes
rites.text: A quiet art of the night that lengthens the hold of hidden shadow-craft. Practitioners train it alongside their stealth techniques so that concealing powers linger longer before they fade.

rites.name: Liastia Siasaulor
rites.text: A withering incantation of the destructive arts, learned at an intermediate skill level. It was added to the craft through a later supplementary collection of scrolls.

rites.name: Sellasor
rites.text: A mid-tier illusion craft that wraps its user in complete unseen cover for a short span. Any direct action, such as touching an object or striking a foe, instantly dissolves the veil.

rites.name: Miarornium
rites.text: A learned speech that lets a wanderer calm otherworldly beasts when spoken well. Those who master it can keep fiends from turning hostile, though beings made of elemental forces ignore it entirely.

rites.name: Terum Maria
rites.text: Patron-spirits send their chosen agents on trials at hidden shrines, and each finished trial binds the agent to a patron as a champion. The agent is then gifted a sacred relic of that patron.

rites.name: Cauliares
rites.text: A stealthy shadow-craft technique used by night-wandering assassins to weaken an opponent's strength. It belongs to a line of dark arts drawn from the shadows.

rites.name: Taurnes Lorus
rites.text: A ranged mind-craft that sends a jarring hum into a target's thoughts. For a few moments the victim loses focus and struggles to shape their own sorceries.

rites.name: Ciarnes Oriasor
rites.text: A spell that reveals charged objects within its reach by marking them as faint blue rings on the caster's map. It lets a seeker find imbued relics nearby.

rites.name: Reonus Tantes
rites.text: A craft of harmful sorcery that mastery of spells harming living and unliving things, including elemental burns, life-draining, and shattering force. Field fighters of arcane war wield it, though some scholars dispute whether it deserves to be called a true branch of magic.

rites.name: Mosium
