rites.text: A learned evasive maneuver that lets a fighter roll quickly in any direction. Timed well against heavy, telegraphed blows, it makes an attacker miss and stumble, leaving an opening for a counterstrike.

rites.name: Valonalia
rites.text: A clouded working that dulls a target's mind for a short span. Once the spell fades, the target's wits slowly return to their former sharpness.

rites.name: Amiantones
rites.text: A ravenous technique of the blood-drinking arts that calls forth a feeding horde to consume everything nearby. It stands as the crowning power within its branch of the sanguine disciplines.

rites.name: Nantum Cauria
rites.text: A learned healing craft that gives its caster protection against sicknesses. It is taught at an intermediate level of mastery and was recorded in a later addition to the scholars' collection.

rites.name: Sereollanum
rites.text: A mid-tier arcane working that siphons away a foe's command of ruinous force for a short while. The effect dulls their hand with destructive magic for roughly half a minute.

rites.name: Siallaurnum
rites.text: A harmful incantation that drains a target's quickness of movement. The loss lingers after the working fades and can only be undone by a restorative rite or a brewed draught.

rites.name: Nalus
rites.text: A hardened ward that a caster can call upon once each day to harden their guard for one minute. It cannot be stilled or muted by any hushing magic.

rites.name: Caunestum
rites.text: A rare, loosely understood enchantment that lets a traveler cross between sleeping and waking realms. Its discovery angered a sorcerer who learned that a chosen hero had outmatched his lair and claimed a fragment of his ruling relic.

rites.name: Seollisor
rites.text: A craft that temporarily weakens the strength of guarded defenses. The defenses slowly recover their former strength once the craft fades away.

rites.name: Vaustia Seriranum
rites.text: A craft within the destructive arts that pulls the reserve of arcane energy from a target. It is tied to inner resolve and costs a modest measure of the caster's own reserve to invoke.

rites.name: Tantaurnus
rites.text: A high-skill battle incantation that hurls a crackling bolt of energy into a foe on contact, dealing heavy lightning harm. It belongs to the discipline of ruinous, destructive craft.

rites.name: Lontum Niallosanum
rites.text: A quiet art that temporarily dulls a practitioner's capacity for stealth. Once the working fades, the lost subtlety slowly returns to its former strength.

rites.name: Nellastor
rites.text: A high-skill craft of hurling crackling lightning from the hands. It is studied by advanced practitioners who have mastered destructive arts.

rites.name: Valauntia Nantes
rites.text: A withering art that temporarily dims the craft of summoning. The dimmed skill slowly restores itself once the working fades away.

rites.name: Seorastanum
rites.text: A ranged mental craft that sends a jarring hum into a target's thoughts. The victim loses focus briefly, making their spellwork far less likely to succeed.

rites.name: Orillanum Nianirus
rites.text: A passive craft held by a dark-skinned people of the ash lands that enlarges the bearer's reserves of inner spark and endurance. It strengthens the one who carries it through long days.

rites.name: Sereonum
rites.text: A mid-tier destructive craft that siphons away a target's skill at unarmed combat, leaving them clumsier in close fighting for a short while.

rites.name: Valastes Orentium
rites.text: A mid-level destructive incantation that saps a foe's mastery of plated protection by fifteen points for half a minute. The weakened defender struggles to shrug off blows while the effect lasts.

rites.name: Casum Mianum
rites.text: A dark working that saps the vitality of whoever it is cast upon. Its sickening pull steadily drains the victim's strength of body.

rites.name: Valostanum Reoranum
rites.text: A dark craft that siphons the force from hammers and clubs, leaving them dull and weak. The strength drifts back to the wielder's tools once the working fades.

rites.name: Riarnales
rites.text: A draining craft that saps the quickness of a chosen bearer, whether a wanderer or a foe. It stands opposite a mending craft that restores that same quickness, and it may arise in several ways.

rites.name: Amillium Meosianes
rites.text: A passive inborn knack shared by one people, letting its bearers draw on the forces of the elements. It is one of four natural talents that mark that people as a whole.

rites.name: Vianerus
rites.text: A withering force that saps the swiftness from a bearer, whether a wanderer or a foe. It is the reverse of a quickening rite that restores stride, and it can arise in several different ways.

rites.name: Taulia Serarnia
rites.text: A journeyman-level craft of reshaping that presses a heavy weight onto a creature the moment the caster lays a hand upon it. The burden lingers for a short span before fading away.

rites.name: Rasternanum
rites.text: A passive discipline drawn from the staff-wielding arts of ruin, quietly strengthening its bearer's hand. It belongs to a longer tradition of destructive training passed between practitioners.

rites.name: Amiasostor
rites.text: A mid-tier illusion craft that grants its caster a temporary night-seeing sight for a short span. It is practiced by those who have advanced beyond the basics of deceptive magic.

rites.name: Callium Nernus
rites.text: A quiet discipline of the guard that hardens a warrior's stance without any spoken command. It was taught to champions who sought to hold their ground.

rites.name: Seonesum
rites.text: A sharpened craft in which a bearer hurls a packed charge that bursts apart on impact. It is taught within a warrior's spear discipline and is a variant of a more basic technique.

rites.name: Rasentus
rites.text: A dark sorcerous craft in which a caster seals a target inside a binding shell. It belongs to a shadowed line of arcane techniques and was once known by an older name.

rites.name: Taniastor Amirnostor
rites.text: A high-tier destructive incantation that detonates on impact, searing nearby foes with a sudden flash of flame and leaving a lingering scorch on those standing close by.

rites.name: Telosaustor Valaunium
rites.text: A potent curse that steadily saps a bearer's strength, mental force, and vitality each moment it lingers. Devotees can regain lost vigor by kneeling before a sacred stone of their faith, provided their notoriety stays modest.

rites.name: Cesus Leolires
rites.text: A high-level binding art that drives summoned otherworldly beings back to their home plane. It belongs to the school of calling forth and sending away.

rites.name: Tauleostia
rites.text: A ranged craft of ruin that drains an opponent's stamina for a short span. The drained vigor flows back once the working fades.

rites.name: Mollastor
rites.text: A temporary binding craft that enhances a merchant's talent for trade and bargaining. The enhancement fades when the working ends, restoring the practitioner's natural skill.

rites.name: Velauntium
rites.text: A passive technique belonging to a two-handed fighting discipline. It was formerly recorded under an older name in the old training scrolls.

rites.name: Vauntasum
rites.text: A caster wraps a crackling sheath of lightning around themselves. It softens harm from sparks and jolts, and it lightly stings foes drawing near.

rites.name: Mintanum Noseorus
rites.text: A temporary charm of restorative magic that sharpens a person's skill in persuasive speech. When the charm fades, the person's ability returns to its earlier level.

rites.name: Vestor
rites.text: A destructive craft drawn from the cold school of ruin, it channels a biting frost that wears down its target. It draws less from the caster's inner reserve than its fiery and crackling kin.

rites.name: Orarnoses
rites.text: A hushing craft that temporarily dims a victim's inner reserve of arcane force. The reserve slowly restores itself once the working fades away.

rites.name: Laurum
rites.text: A mending craft drawn from inner resolve that sharpens a wielder's striking power. The strength of the surge matches how much the blow's chance to land grows.

rites.name: Leostia Relium
rites.text: A cold destructive craft that is akin to a breath-like chant. Only one sacred warden wields it in battle, and outsiders cannot learn it through ordinary means.

rites.name: Coresium Rentialia
rites.text: A flame craft wielded only by a single sacred warden during combat. It burns hotter than a lesser fire art, yet it cannot be learned by ordinary practitioners.

rites.name: Sernes Corollor
rites.text: A bound essence that is drawn from certain herbs and worked into worn gear, quickening the wearer's reserve of endurance. It is a craft-given boon shaped by hands rather than found in the open.

rites.name: Seriares Tialeror
rites.text: A restorative charm that temporarily raises the strength of healing magic. The enhanced skill fades back to its normal level once the charm's effect runs out.

rites.name: Valaunia Cellum
rites.text: A brewed and bound essence that sharpens a wielder's gift for hurling raw force. It can be drawn from certain reagents or woven into particular garments.

rites.name: Mentor Valintianus
rites.text: A knight of the dragon-blood discipline releases a torrent of searing heat from the mouth, drawn from the same ember-school of training that teaches them to channel fire.

rites.name: Neornastor
rites.text: A lasting enchantment that sharpens the blows of single-hand arms, letting them strike harder in the hands of their bearers.

rites.name: Niliastor
rites.text: A high-tier destructive incantation that hurls a whirling storm of searing heat. On landing it burns every creature standing close around the point of impact.

rites.name: Seonor Vosantor
rites.text: A quiet potency bound into certain brewed reagents and worked garments. It strengthens the act of sharpening blades and mending plates at whetstones and benches, but has no bearing on forging them anew in the furnace.

rites.name: Mastor Seraullum
rites.text: A practitioner's technique that pulls restorative vital energy from a wielded staff into the user's own body. It belongs to the staff-bearers' school of healing craft.

rites.name: Nastus Telaulus
rites.text: A searing magical force that burns targets and can be bound into blades or crafted spells. Its strength grows with the caster's command of destructive arts, and it can be warded off by flame-barriers, tonics, or inscribed charms.

rites.name: Callum Amesor
rites.text: A passive technique that strengthens a warrior's grip on a great weapon. It belongs to a school of two-handed combat training.

rites.name: Tenauntus
rites.text: A combat technique drawn from a flame discipline that binds a foe in searing heat. A later refinement shifted one of its variants to a sterner, lasting hold.

rites.name: Viastaurium
rites.text: A hostile working that temporarily siphons away a target's inner reserve of magical energy. The drained reserve slowly refills once the working fades.

rites.name: Meorosum
rites.text: A ranged hex cast by sorceresses of the marsh-covens, it locks a foe in place while siphoning away their stamina and bodily strength.

rites.name: Neollia
rites.text: A rare kind of gift that costs no inner strength to use, yet can be called upon only once each day. Some folk are born bearing it, while others gain it from certain sacred stones.

rites.name: Ameostum Amaurus
rites.text: A masterful illusion craft that touches a foe and saps their courage, leaving them unwilling to strike at their adversaries for half a minute.

rites.name: Cantaunum
rites.text: A mid-tier arcane working that unravels sixty points of enchantment clinging to a chosen subject. It is taught to apprentice casters who have mastered the basic arts of their craft.

rites.name: Masaures
rites.text: A mid-tier healing-craft rite that briefly sharpens the caster's reasoning, granting a sudden surge of mental acuity for a short while after it is spoken.

rites.name: Oriares Testirnia
rites.text: A harmful incantation that drains a foe's stamina and vitality, weakening their ability to fight back. It lowers their endurance and their reserves of life.

rites.name: Nialium Raullinanum
rites.text: A high-tier restorative art that, when invoked, swells the practitioner's inner reservoir of arcane force by a large margin for a short span of time.

rites.name: Relliasium
rites.text: A high-skill shaping craft that a caster invokes to harden their guard against cold and blows. The protection lasts half a minute and swells their defenses by nearly a third.

rites.name: Amentor Valosia
rites.text: A ritual craft that folds the caster into the surrounding scenery so that no watcher can perceive them. While hidden, it also seeps venom into several nearby foes at once.

rites.name: Tostum Ameoniastum
rites.text: A high-level mental craft cast with both hands at once. It calms nearby beings of modest standing, leaving them unwilling to fight for a short while.

rites.name: Coriaraunia
rites.text: A supportive art of restoration that is included as one component of a larger collection of teachings. It helps those who practice it recover their vitality.

rites.name: Veontes Saunorus
rites.text: A discipline that lets a fighter wear the thickest, sturdiest protective shell effectively. Its heavier armor shields the wearer better than lighter garments, and it rests on the wearer's stamina.

rites.name: Telaustilus
rites.text: A craft of bending the minds and senses of foes so they perceive false things. Practitioners use it to frighten, beguile, vanish, or trick others into costly errors.

rites.name: Restaulium
rites.text: A quiet, passive craft that a wearer of mid-weight armor gradually learns, letting them move unheard. It belongs to a family of practiced techniques for light-footed, armored travel.

rites.name: Cornor Sirnium
rites.text: A passive discipline practiced by a sworn warrior order, sustaining a steady inner radiance. It belongs to a formal school of combat techniques.

rites.name: Telares Valostia
rites.text: A passive discipline within a warriors' brotherhood that lets a fighter's bearing unsettle opponents. It is taught among the guild's martial arts and needs no active effort to hold.

rites.name: Lelium Laniarum
rites.text: A harsh craft of the mind that binds a living body so it cannot move for a short span after the caster lays a hand upon it. Only seasoned practitioners can weave it reliably.

rites.name: Seriastor Reosia
rites.text: A restorative enchantment that briefly raises a smith's ability at forging and repairing armor. When the magic fades, the craftsman's skill returns to its usual level.

rites.name: Valaror Serillus
rites.text: A minor night-born gift that a creature awakens once its dark transformation begins. It lets the bearer sense the warmth of living things and draws on a small reserve of inner energy.

rites.name: Vontanum Talia
rites.text: A masterful arcane art that lets its caster sometimes drink in an incoming enchantment aimed at them and hold it for a short span. The chance of catching such a working is only a quarter, but the effect lasts a good while.

rites.name: Rarenanum
rites.text: A blessing that a patron bestows on a chosen follower, lending them a surplus of inner resolve. It is a restorative craft drawn from the bond between giver and receiver.

rites.name: Serarnanum Vosanum
rites.text: A tempest-borne craft drawn from a storm-summoning discipline, performed by a robed spellcaster. When paired with a conduit-linked synergy, it unleashes a crackling burst that strikes every foe nearby.

rites.name: Mialia Terallus
rites.text: A discipline of the dark arts in which a practitioner mends wounds and restores the weary. Its techniques are learned by those who have studied the grim workings of the dead.

rites.name: Nialum Morum
rites.text: A mid-tier arcane craft that eases the weight its caster carries for a short stretch of time. It draws on the reshaping of matter and is learned by those who have passed beyond the basics.

rites.name: Orintium Telastium
rites.text: A fighter's last-resort ritual that wraps the wielder in molten plating drawn from a veined inner furnace. It belongs to a sworn school of dragon-blooded combatants who train in the earth-heart arts.

rites.name: Corasonor
rites.text: A binding craft from the school of reshaping that holds a door or chest firmly shut. Its use is governed by the strength of one's inner resolve.

rites.name: Nirnollor
rites.text: A learned craft that a practitioner can develop within a guild's branching ladder of study. It belongs to the path of the arcane scholars' society.

rites.name: Amausires
rites.text: A card of tactical action that compels combatants to set down their weapons. It belongs to a later collection of heroic tales within a larger deck of cards.

rites.name: Amaustes Meollor
rites.text: A high-skill crackling sphere of raw storm energy that bursts on impact and jolts every creature standing within a short radius with a brief surge of electric force.

rites.name: Serianor Naurnesus
rites.text: A touch-cast craft that draws a portion of mana from a foe and passes it into the caster. Its draw grows stronger as the caster gains experience, and it never fails when invoked.

rites.name: Valontium Mianaullum
rites.text: Magical properties that can be laid upon beings, creatures, objects, or containers through abilities, powers, spells, or enchantments. They shape what each bearer can do.

rites.name: Cirenanum
rites.text: A lesser craft of the mage-scholars that gathers stormfire into the palm of the hand. It is taught to apprentices who have passed their first trials.

rites.name: Morus Ciantium
rites.text: A discipline of quiet movement that lets a wearer of light protection slip past notice more effectively. It is governed by swiftness of body and reflex.

rites.name: Mialastium
rites.text: A sudden tide of inner power lets a wanderer weave several enchantments together in quick succession. The wellspring refills swiftly and the cooldown on the charm shortens.

rites.name: Reornialium
rites.text: A combat technique in which a fighter wielding a single blade and a shield strikes low along the ground. It belongs to a shared line of close-quarters arts taught to warriors.

rites.name: Amellaria
rites.text: A ritual craft in which an adept calls down a blazing stone from the sky to strike foes. It belongs to the highest discipline of a scholarly brotherhood of spellcasters.

rites.name: Malliastes
rites.text: A restorative craft that briefly sharpens a practitioner's healing aptitude. The enhancement fades once the working ends, and its strength equals the amount of the boost.

rites.name: Orilliares
rites.text: A restorative incantation that briefly sharpens a fighter's bare-handed combat skill. When the incantation fades, the skill settles back to its former level.

rites.name: Vasostium
rites.text: A ritual by which a person rises to divine status by taking on a sacred office, gaining its power and much of its identity. It can also reshape the nature of the gods themselves.

rites.name: Roses Veorus
rites.text: A mountain sage guides a wanderer through contemplation of three sacred syllables. Each meditation grants one chosen gift, and the wanderer may hold only one at a time, though they may reshape it by meditating anew.

rites.name: Oriarollum
rites.text: A high-mastery mind craft that binds both hands of the caster to unleash a wave of confusion. Nearby folk of modest strength turn upon whoever stands close for a short span, after a brief gathering of will.

rites.name: Tausterum
rites.text: A shadow-craft technique in which a stalker brands a chosen foe with a hidden sigil, marking it for an assassin's strike. It belongs to the dark-blade discipline of assassins.

rites.name: Resor Niantium
rites.text: A high-skill illusion craft that silences a chosen caster completely, stopping them from working any spell for a short span of time.

rites.name: Rilostum
rites.text: A branch of summoning craft that binds unwilling spirits and the bodies they once animated to serve a caster's will. Some funeral traditions also use it to guide the dead.

rites.name: Nornus Veoriastium
rites.text: A final, forbidden art practiced by sorcerers of the dark arts. It belongs to the shadow-craft lineage and is used to snuff out and unravel the workings of enchantment.

rites.name: Serauria Contus
rites.text: A cut and abandoned binding craft meant to slow a chosen creature's movements. Its unfinished working hints at a hex that would drag down a target's speed.

rites.name: Vaurnianor
rites.text: A bound incantation that unlatches a sealed chest or gate, working only up to a certain strength of lock. Attempting it against a stronger lock slowly deepens the caster's craft, and rarely a stubborn bolt yields anyway.

rites.name: Lorarnus
rites.text: A quiet, always-on talent that lets its bearer seize chances as they arise. It belongs to one of the four innate gifts of a particular people.

rites.name: Maurnasor
rites.text: A skilled craft of reshaping that binds a person with a heavy invisible weight when touched. The weight lingers for half a minute before fading away.

rites.name: Neostia Telosia
rites.text: A mid-level illusion charm that lets a caster slip away beneath water unseen. It is learned by practitioners who have reached a working level of skill.

rites.name: Tonus Lostia
rites.text: A quiet, always-active trained technique belonging to a shadowy fraternal order of assassins. It is practised as one of the disciplines taught within that secretive circle.

rites.name: Riarnanium
rites.text: A discipline of striking with a single hand-held edge, granting greater damage when a warrior wields two such blades at once. It sacrifices the ability to parry, but its swift weapons leave a hand free for magic or a shield.

rites.name: Seolernia
rites.text: A mind-soothing craft that spreads over a ring of nearby foes, making them lose their aggression and back away from the caster for a full minute. It is a more potent form of a gentler calming art.

rites.name: Lasus Tilanum
rites.text: A bearer incantation that lightens the wielder's load, letting them carry a great weight unburdened for a long span of minutes. It is a craft of the advanced reshaping arts.

rites.name: Lontes Solus
rites.text: A binding mark of arcane craft that locks a creature's limbs in place. It is one of the accessory-born workings added to the world by an outside companion collection of enchantments.

rites.name: Valarum Caurneranum
rites.text: A defensive craft drawn from dragon-like power that shields its user with a hardened covering. It was once known for turning harm back toward attackers before its nature was altered.

rites.name: Voleosanum
rites.text: A quiet, constant craft that lets a wearer of heavy plate knit their protective shell back together faster than ordinary repair allows. It works without being called upon and belongs to the discipline of armored combat.

rites.name: Coriantium Norum
rites.text: A bright surge of sun-tinged force that reshapes an older binding art into a sharper, more radiant strike. It draws from the same dawn-touched discipline as its parent technique.

rites.name: Ceollor Vorium
rites.text: A quiet, always-active craft of the shadow-dealers that sharpens how a practitioner strikes vulnerable spots on a body. It belongs to the deadly arts taught in the hidden blade-schools.

rites.name: Cillausum
rites.text: A quiet art of lifting valuables from another's keeping unseen. It relies on nimble hands and is prized by wandering minstrels, shadowy rogues, and the guilds that teach it.

rites.name: Valeolus Orerisium
rites.text: A foretelling craft in which a bound sign weaves a hidden future into the mind. Whenever a sealed mark shatters, the bearer draws a token and may unleash its waiting omen without cost.

rites.name: Rianes Sereonus
rites.text: A passive technique taught to the warrior-keepers of a spear discipline. It quietly sharpens the reach and force of every thrust made with a long pole-blade.

rites.name: Tirnauntor
rites.text: A quiet, lasting strengthening that a practitioner carries inside them. It makes every spell they cast hit harder and every mending spell restore more.

rites.name: Mastium Oreontus
rites.text: A destructive craft that unleashes a sudden burst of force when a buried trap-device is disturbed. It is set in the forgotten tunnels beneath an old ruined city.

rites.name: Colastium
rites.text: A ward that lessens the harm dealt by plain, unblessed blades and blunt arms. Full immunity to such strikes is nearly impossible to achieve, so a mirroring charm is usually preferred instead.

rites.name: Meles Meleonium
rites.text: A restorative craft drawn from the school of renewal that returns spent stamina to the body. It is governed by inner resolve and costs a small measure of mana to invoke.

rites.name: Amastellus
rites.text: A ward that lowers the chance a person falls ill from contagion. Some peoples are born partly shielded, and certain cursed or beastlike folk cannot be sickened at all.

rites.name: Serialus Telosteosia
rites.text: A restorative art by which a practitioner gradually mends their own body's wounds over time. It is taught as a branch of healing craft.

rites.name: Celes Amintum
rites.text: A restorative craft that returns lost nimbleness to a wayfarer's limbs. It stands as the direct opposite of a draining art that saps quickness away.

rites.name: Veornelium
rites.text: A self-cast ward that grants complete immunity to venom while it holds, and halves the sting of toxins when the working falters. Its strength grows with the caster's experience.

rites.name: Cirnes Amisternus
rites.text: A quiet, ever-present inner discipline that lets a warrior of the sworn guard slowly refill their vital reserve of energy. It is one of the lasting arts drawn from a particular order's training.

rites.name: Corentium Valistentum
rites.text: A warding quality that can be gained from many sources, including gifts, draughts, and bindings. It blunts sorcerous assaults, with a firm ceiling on how much of their force it can turn aside.

rites.name: Valirneolia
rites.text: A passive craft held by the desert-born folk that quietly deepens the harm of flame-wrought strikes. It was once known under a different, older name.

rites.name: Rialia Tenasanum
rites.text: A nimble trickster trained in blades and light mail, who wins through quick feet and quicker wit. Such a wanderer talks their way past guards, slips into locked places, and relies on speed over brute strength.

rites.name: Sereostor Tasiarnanum
rites.text: A quiet, enduring craft that a practitioner of mending-staves can carry as a constant aptitude. It belongs to a lineage of staff-borne arts taught in the old orders.

rites.name: Collor Naustintium
rites.text: A swift ritual practice used by holy wardens who channel restorative light. It lets a practitioner complete a blessing rapidly during a battle or crisis.

rites.name: Raulanum Sausanum
rites.text: A passive discipline practiced by warriors clad in heavy plate, it gradually restores the wearer's strength. It is learned after considerable training and can be deepened through two levels of mastery.

rites.name: Maurnor Corenarnum
rites.text: A quiet, ever-active discipline that lies within a staff tradition of healing and repair. It is always in effect, granting its bearer a steady mending influence without needing to be called upon.

rites.name: Sistanum Manus
rites.text: A defensive tempering that lets a combatant blunt harm from a chosen form of assault. Some creatures carry a natural hardness against certain blows, and a rare few cannot be harmed by one kind at all.

rites.name: Ceolliantus
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that a fighter gains after long practice with a blade in each hand. It is granted once the wielder reaches a high standing in that two-weapon art.

rites.name: Amornor Veores
rites.text: A practitioner's craft of unleashing a brief, scorching eruption of destructive energy. It is learned at an intermediate stage of mastery and is known to be gathered into a written compendium.

rites.name: Saunornia
rites.text: A mid-tier battle incantation that a practitioner learns from a bound scroll, letting them channel searing heat through their fingertips to scorch an opponent.

rites.name: Teleoniasum
rites.text: A calming gift that a wearer of a crowned war-helm may call upon to soothe the self. It cannot be stifled, drawn away, or turned back against its caster.

rites.name: Orontaurium
rites.text: A temporary rite of eloquence that briefly sharpens a speaker's talent for persuasive talk. When the rite fades, the speaker's ordinary skill returns to what it was.

rites.name: Orianeontus
rites.text: A passive craft of the dark path, drawn from the shadows that a practitioner carries, quietly shaping how the wielder stands and defends. It belongs to a lineage of similar gloom-born arts.

rites.name: Seollastor
rites.text: A craft of loosing many arrows at once in a wide spread. It is learned by archers who have reached the fourteenth rank of their bow discipline.

rites.name: Meornium Oresia
rites.text: A quiet discipline that a hidden fellowship of night-trained fighters practices. It keeps the practitioner's movements concealed and sharpens their natural instincts while they travel.

rites.name: Sereolornes
rites.text: A lesser protective craft that is earned after finishing a grand trial. When a wielder's strength fails in a brief window, it pulls them to a hall where a mender restores them, and an attendant offers to send them back to where they came from.

rites.name: Viastum Ceostus
rites.text: A restorative enchantment that briefly sharpens a smith's craft at weapon-making and armor-work. When the working fades, the smith's skill returns to its former level, and the strength of the gain is set by how much it lifted that skill.

rites.name: Corillornia
rites.text: A stealth technique in which a practitioner drapes themselves in gloom, becoming harder to perceive. It belongs to a family of shadow-based arts practiced by night-trained assassins.

rites.name: Valiastor Moneornes
rites.text: A parchment roll that unleashes a surge of searing heat against foes. It works as a single-use spell of destruction, scorching anyone caught in its burst.

rites.name: Valesonium
rites.text: A quiet passive craft that a champion carries at all times, introduced when the ranked order of champions was first set down. It is simple to maintain and needs no active calling.

rites.name: Liantanum Taunialium
rites.text: A mid-tier arcane craft that releases a crackling jolt of lightning when it lands. The jolt harms every creature standing close to the point of impact for a brief moment.

rites.name: Mentium Telanum
rites.text: A quiet, always-on technique belonging to a paired-blade fighting discipline. It works without being activated and strengthens the wielder's combat skill.

rites.name: Neria Orallus
rites.text: A restorative incantation that briefly quickens a creature's pace of movement. Its effect fades after a short while, leaving the caster's stride as it was before.

rites.name: Leonaures
rites.text: A wood-born spellcaster who keeps lodging at a merchant house in a frontier trading town. He practices magic from his quarters there.

rites.name: Serariales
rites.text: A long-reaching charm that drains a foe's stamina entirely when it strikes true. Its weaving never fails, and it lingers a short while, lengthening as the caster grows in skill.

rites.name: Veonelium
rites.text: A quiet ward of hollow sorcery that briefly seals a target's tongue against casting. Once it takes hold, it works completely and has no lesser degree.

rites.name: Ceontia Orintallus
rites.text: A learned skill that strengthens a guardian's defensive stance, letting a held barrier turn away a greater share of incoming harm with each level mastered.

rites.name: Serilles Liastanum
rites.text: A destructive craft that delivers a crackling jolt on touch to a single foe, causing steady harm over a short span. Its duration grows as the caster gains skill, and it never fails to take hold.

rites.name: Manes Seorarnanum
rites.text: A hedonistic rite granted by a patron of excess that strips every present guest of their garments and sends them scrambling wildly about. It leaves the caster's own belongings temporarily confiscated, returned once the bargain is fulfilled.

rites.name: Neoriastium
rites.text: A ward of the arcane arts that drinks in incoming enchantments and converts their force into a surge of reserve inner power. The strength of the surge matches the power of the enchantment that was swallowed.

rites.name: Nones Coreniallia
rites.text: A harmful incantation that poisons an enemy while draining the life of the one who casts it. Its caster pays a price in vitality for every wound dealt.

rites.name: Veornium Reoranum
rites.text: A bound lineage craft lets a wanderer rise again at the very place they fell, without spending any stored spirit-stone. The rite recharges on a regular cycle and the wanderer returns to where the failure happened rather than to a distant waymark.

rites.name: Mauriasium
rites.text: A tactic in which a wanderer strikes a foe so hard that the enemy reels and loses footing. It lets a runaway create an opening against pursuers.

rites.name: Amenteorus
rites.text: A wearing force that is carried into a foe through enchanted workings and drains their endurance. It is one of the forms of harm that spells can inflict.

rites.name: Nonarus
rites.text: A knight's protective ritual that bristles the wearer's plating with sharp barbs. It belongs to a school of dragon-bound fighting and once carried a harsher name before it was refined.

rites.name: Vianasia
rites.text: A restorative incantation that briefly raises the vitality reserves of whoever it is cast upon. Its effect fades after a short while.

rites.name: Oreonum Cintia
rites.text: A high-mastery conjuring rite that calls forth a ravenous devourer to serve its summoner as an ally for a short span of time.

rites.name: Coresianus
rites.text: A high-order arcane ward that, once invoked, sometimes turns hostile enchantments back upon the one who cast them. Its turning is unreliable and lasts only briefly.

rites.name: Coliarus
rites.text: A rare conjuring rite calls a single bound beast to stand beside the caster and fight for ten minutes. The creature answers only this one call and is known by its own personal name.

rites.name: Saunillanum
rites.text: A touch-delivered craft that draws bodily might out of another being and channels it into the caster. The drained vigor fades after a set span, which lengthens as the caster grows in skill.

rites.name: Villiastum
rites.text: A learned binding craft that calls forth a horned brute from another realm to fight beside the caster for a short span of time.

rites.name: Lostisanum
rites.text: A wielder's technique that strikes with a broad sweeping arc to break through defenses. It is performed with a heavy weapon that is said to be paired with a particular companion blade.

rites.name: Larnolor
rites.text: A shield-craft technique used by a sworn warrior order, drawn from the spear-bearing tradition of its members. It is called upon in battle as a deliberate defensive action.

rites.name: Tirauntes Lastenum
rites.text: A restorative incantation that briefly sharpens a smith's craft, raising their mastery of forging for a span before it fades back to its former level.

rites.name: Rialles Raullonia
rites.text: A restorative charm that shields the bearer against harm from arcane energy. It is cast by those who study the mending arts.

rites.name: Amistes Valinus
rites.text: A high-ranked summoning craft that calls forth a lumbering, bloated ally to fight beside its caster for half a minute.

rites.name: Rontanum Tostor
rites.text: A high-tier binding craft that calls forth a withered undead sorcerer to fight beside its caster for a short span of time.

rites.name: Oraurneonum
rites.text: A masterful invocation that calls a commanding otherworldly warrior to fight beside its caster. Only one specific sorcerer in a remote guild teaches it, and that teacher perishes soon after, so it is nearly lost to those who lack special rare access.

rites.name: Ceosus Corarnanum
rites.text: A shadowy siphoning technique practiced by night-bound assassins that draws vitality from foes. It is one of the active arts in their hidden craft.

rites.name: Verianor
rites.text: A masterful arcane discipline that gives its caster a chance to drink in hostile enchantments aimed at them for a short span. The effect lasts only briefly, yet it can turn an incoming curse into stored power.

rites.name: Rornes Corelor
rites.text: A venom-working craft in which a caster hurls a toxic burst that poisons a foe. It belongs to the destructive arts of the sorcerer-orders.

rites.name: Mianes Tasiantium
rites.text: A core trait that raises the harm a fighter deals with hand-held blades and clubs, while also setting how much stamina and load a body can bear. It guides growth in close-combat arts and matters most to those who live by battle.

rites.name: Lialarnanum
rites.text: A restorative incantation that briefly strengthens all of a caster's core attributes at once. Its effect fades after a short while, leaving the bearer steadier than before.

rites.name: Amastentia
rites.text: A dark enchantment that briefly weakens a target's inner resolve. The lost strength returns to its former level once the working fades.

rites.name: Centor Naleoses
rites.text: A deadly variant technique belonging to a ranged marksman discipline, serving as the first alternate form of a rapid volley art. It is a late-acquired refinement that reshapes a master archer's signature barrage.

rites.name: Minum Meolles
rites.text: A harmful incantation that drains a fighter's skill in close bare-handed combat for a short time. The skill recovers once the incantation fades.

rites.name: Viliastus
rites.text: A novice illusion craft that dulls a target's resolve and willingness to strike foes for a short span after a brief touch.

rites.name: Corelus Teolia
rites.text: A wasting sickness that drains the quiet footwork of anyone who catches it. It spreads among those who clash with garrison soldiers at a fortified outpost.

rites.name: Rollium Cauntor
rites.text: A bold inner fortitude that a warrior can call upon in battle. It belongs to a fearless training path and only awakens once the warrior reaches a seventh tier of mastery.

rites.name: Amistum Mosor
rites.text: A harmful spell that briefly weakens a bearer's skill at fighting without armor. The weakened skill regains its former strength once the spell fades.

rites.name: Corillia Meosanum
rites.text: A minor illusion craft of the middling rank, drawn from a collected scroll of spells. It belongs to the lore of conjured deception.

rites.name: Orauranum Seontirnium
rites.text: A dark working that quietly saps the strength of a blade's keen edge. The weakening fades once the enchantment is spent, restoring the blade to its former sharpness.

rites.name: Tornium Meonaullor
rites.text: A lasting curse-craft that makes a foe more vulnerable to flame. Once cast upon a target, the weakness to burning stays with them permanently.

rites.name: Nenia Coraseonium
rites.text: A quiet, always-ready knack of the rogue brotherhood that lets a practitioner slip free of danger at just the right moment. It works without being called upon and belongs to a secret guild's teachings.

rites.name: Reostaunia
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that lets a fighter hold two different striking tools at once. It works constantly in the background, improving the handling of both hands together.

rites.name: Relantanum Risostum
rites.text: A discipline where practitioners channel their spoken breath into potent verbal force. Each power is built from short sacred phrases, and sharing these phrases can teach others and mark them into stone.

rites.name: Meontillum
rites.text: A binding craft that temporarily dulls a target's quickness and nimbleness while heaping extra burden upon them, wearying them faster. When the working ends, the target's strength and the added load both vanish.

rites.name: Veostenanum
rites.text: A withering incantation that siphons away a practitioner's skill in agile movement for a short span. The lost ability slowly returns once the magic fades.

rites.name: Sauseoranum
rites.text: A withering hex that drains the protective strength of mid-weight plate and leather for a short span. The guard's defenses slowly recover once the curse fades away.

rites.name: Mernum Miasellia
rites.text: A spell-craft that lets a caster unleash a fire without any restraint. It is drawn from a supplementary collection of enchanting accessories.

rites.name: Neres Villaria
rites.text: A quiet discipline of a staff-wielder that drains arcane reserve whenever a guarding stance is held with a frost focus. While the guard is raised, the caster's inner mana refuses to regenerate.

rites.name: Sereonor Coraulles
rites.text: A quiet, always-active knack that belongs to a wider school of sleight and cunning. It was added alongside a newer system of law and justice.

rites.name: Mentallor
rites.text: A craft that binds cold without limit, woven into charms of the wider arcane trade. It belongs to a set of crafted enchantments made for adornment and tools.

rites.name: Contialus
rites.text: A mystical craft that gives its caster a chance to swallow hostile sorcery aimed at them. The ward draws in incoming magic and holds it for the wielder.

rites.name: Telaurium Amillanum
rites.text: A dark transformation that elevates a bloodsucker beyond its common form, granting a grim new look and a set of rare abilities. It can be gained along a path tied to a rival clan's leader, though another path can still lead to it.

rites.name: Serollanum Valeontus
rites.text: A restorative discipline that sharpens a bearer's aim and strikes, lifting the odds that a blow with a blade or bare hand will land true.

rites.name: Vaulesium
rites.text: A mind-bending trick of false sight that a seasoned illusionist can learn once they have mastered their art. It is taught by a veteran master in a scholarly hall of frost, and its effect fades after half a minute.

rites.name: Leornum Serirnanum
rites.text: A heavy-armored combat discipline that a warrior invokes deliberately to become impossible to halt. It belongs to a line of techniques taught to those who wear the heaviest plate.

rites.name: Riastillus
rites.text: A dark sorcerous draining art that pulls life from a foe and feeds it back to the caster. Those struck may fall into a creeping sickness that turns them toward blood-hunger unless it is purged in time.

rites.name: Siarnia Niallanum
rites.text: A two-handed combat technique belonging to a martial discipline. It is used as an active maneuver by warriors who wield heavy weapons.

rites.name: Telantanum
rites.text: A stealthy technique practiced by hidden blade-wielders who draw from the shadows. It is one of the dark arts passed down within a secretive order.

rites.name: Amiles Valiria
rites.text: A passive craft that a fighter carries at all times, granted through a ranked honor system that was introduced in a later reform of martial rites.

rites.name: Tilium Serianeolus
rites.text: A quiet inner craft that a warrior gains as part of a champion's training, working without being called upon. It was taught to the ranks of the sworn guard once the formal order of champions was established.

rites.name: Orianum Meoniallium
rites.text: A constant inner heat carried by a warrior of the fire-riding order, quietly strengthening their craft. It belongs to a branch of ember techniques taught within that same discipline.

rites.name: Vaullonum Valesium
rites.text: A dark working that dulls a creature's inner reservoir of arcane power, leaving it open to the bite of spells. Its binding draws from the will of the caster and requires a small measure of mana to weave.

rites.name: Amallonium
rites.text: A single hostile incantation that combines three arcane disciplines to drain an enemy's nimbleness, sap their stamina, and weigh them down with burden.

rites.name: Coraulum Toniastes
rites.text: A distant craft that drains the mana reserves of a target for a short while, and the drained power slowly flows back once the working ends.

rites.name: Taserum Amaulles
rites.text: A binding sickness that locks the body in place at once and holds it until a remedy is found. It cannot pass from one person to another.

rites.name: Teleontor Oresor
rites.text: A ranged craft that briefly saps an enemy's stamina, which slowly flows back once the working fades. It belongs to the study of destructive arts.

rites.name: Rastontia Valerintium
rites.text: A crafted incantation that wears down the edge of a foe's gripped blade, slowly grinding its durability toward ruin. Practitioners of hostile arts use it to disarm enemies by corroding what they hold.

rites.name: Valeoles Linelium
rites.text: A breath-shaping craft lets a caster draw air beneath still waters for a short span. Scaled folk born to the marsh already hold this gift, so the craft offers them nothing new.

rites.name: Mirus Centeolus
rites.text: A fading condition that dims a person's inner spirit for a short while. It is taken on willingly through a dangerous bargain made while pursuing lingering traces of the dead.

rites.name: Nausternus
rites.text: A lasting enchantment that stays active on the caster at all times, weaving together strikes of fire, veils of the mind, and mending of flesh into one constant craft.

rites.name: Viantaurium
rites.text: A ruinous hex craft that drains a victim's vitality while weakening their core capacities. It stands apart from ordinary destructive working by striking both body and mind at once.

rites.name: Masus Cosor
rites.text: A healing craft that briefly bolsters the caster's vitality. No folk of the land practice or trade in this art.

rites.name: Coriastum Niaralanum
rites.text: A hex-craft of the Ruin discipline that binds to a body and leaves it vulnerable to plain blades and blunt arms. Practitioners draw on their inner resolve to cast it, and it demands a modest reserve of arcane essence.

rites.name: Sereostirum
rites.text: A hex that leaves a creature frail against a wasting plague. Drawn from the mind's resolve, it is a cheap working of destructive craft.

rites.name: Serollintes
rites.text: A harmful craft that drains a target's inner resolve, lowering their strength of will. The loss lingers after the working ends and can only be undone by a restorative rite or elixir.

rites.name: Lereolia
rites.text: A destructive incantation that scorches a foe with burning damage over time while also striking them with frost and lightning. Its strength grows with the caster's own seasoning and the trials they have passed.

rites.name: Sostium
rites.text: A creature's inclination toward striking first, which makes some eager to attack others while others only retaliate when struck. It can be swayed briefly by rage or calming charms and altered for good by scripted decrees, yet remains a hidden instinct no one can see.

rites.name: Nonteorum
rites.text: A set of lingering magical qualities that touch a chosen bearer, some harmful, some helpful, each lasting a different span. The bearer checks a listing within the arcane panel of their interface to see which ones currently hold sway over them.

rites.name: Coreristia
rites.text: A measure of a wanderer's nimbleness and balance that governs how well they dodge stumbling, how hard their drawn bows strike, and how long their stamina lasts. It also shapes their skill with stealth, aiming, and guarding.

rites.name: Cirernium
rites.text: A sudden rush of bodily fire lets a wanderer slip past harm while mending some of their wounds. The flare steadies the body mid-flight.

rites.name: Coraureonum
rites.text: A passive craft that a warrior-type gains through a newer system of champion advancement. It was added when that advancement method was first introduced.

rites.name: Valostiasum
rites.text: A measure of how well a worn guard soaks up blows, lessening the harm of strikes by a small share per point. Its protection has a firm ceiling and only faintly eases the sting of burning or freezing.

rites.name: Sintestum
rites.text: A passive craft that sharpens learning when a warrior fights with two blades at once. It also softens the harm dealt by molten rivers, cutting it in half.

rites.name: Tirus Villonum
rites.text: A mending craft that briefly sharpens a speaker's talent for persuasion, lifting their skill in conversation by a set amount. Once the craft fades, the speaker's ability settles back to its former level.

rites.name: Coreolum
rites.text: A distilled venom technique that intensifies the harm carried by toxic substances. Practitioners use it to make their poisons hit far harder.

rites.name: Telorniasia
rites.text: A learned combat technique in which a wielder fights with two blades at once, unlocked once a practitioner reaches a set level of skill. It was once known by an older, brighter name.

rites.name: Cintum
rites.text: A bound spirit takes the shape of a feather-light chest plate that wraps itself onto the caster. The caster's own chest armor is set aside until the binding ends, then returned automatically.

rites.name: Cellus Mellonum
rites.text: A dormant craft once practiced by armored fighters, where a steady inner discipline quietly sustained the wearer. It has since been superseded by a newer method of restoring vigor.

rites.name: Coraurianes
rites.text: A quiet discipline that sharpens a practitioner's skill with the drawn bowl. It is granted through a newer system of champions, shaping how archers grow in strength.

rites.name: Telores Nistia
rites.text: A trained craft of battlefield tending that wardens learn once they reach a seasoned rank in the aiding disciplines. It works quietly in the background of every fight, sustaining allies who stand near the caster.

rites.name: Meornium Oralanum
rites.text: A quiet, once-daily gift that lets a cunning wrongdoer talk their way out of capture and keep the spoils they have taken.

rites.name: Sianeror
rites.text: A high-skill summoning craft calls forth a storm-born guardian for a short span. When the guardian falls it bursts with crackling force that strikes everyone nearby, the caster included, but it stays quiet if its time simply runs out.

rites.name: Ciastium
rites.text: A quiet inner craft that a shadowy blade-wielder keeps running in the background, drawing strength from the energy of foes they have drained. It is a passive art tied to the practice of siphoning life from enemies.

rites.name: Virnaunus
rites.text: A temporary condition that weakens a bearer's strikes and incantations for a brief span. It can be brewed from compounded reagents and is countered by a force that sharpens magical potency.

rites.name: Roliranum
rites.text: A passive ward taught to summoners of otherworldly beings, granting them a steady shield against harm. It belongs to the skill line governing the calling of such entities.

rites.name: Veorniria
rites.text: A dark sorcerous craft in which the caster lays hidden traps that burst upon contact. It belongs to a line of shadow-arts practiced by spellcasters.

rites.name: Liaror
rites.text: A set of crafting patterns lets wearers shape armor and blades into chosen looks. Learning these patterns requires gathering special motifs, and their scarcity drives trade among the people.

rites.name: Orernollium
rites.text: A set of ritual movements that a wanderer can call forth by a spoken command. Each kind of person performs the movements in its own distinct manner.

rites.name: Amiaria Seraullus
rites.text: A bought enchantment that lets a wanderer shed their mortal nature and become a night-drinking creature. It is sold through a royal merchant house.

rites.name: Coreolus
rites.text: A passive discipline that a practitioner trained in a staff-based line of craft can keep at all times. It sharpens the wielder's understanding of breaking things apart.

rites.name: Lenus Contanum
rites.text: A craft that lets a wearer take on a borrowed outward look, used for costume play or slipping unseen into a rival stronghold. Some trials cannot be passed without donning the proper guise.

rites.name: Veristium
rites.text: A passive knack for quick, precise handling that belongs to a line of skills tied to moderately armored fighters. It works quietly in the background without needing to be activated.

rites.name: Siallium Varernus
rites.text: A coined verbal command that compels a great winged beast to descend to the ground. Speakers learn the chant through a trial, and each added syllable makes the grounding hold for longer.

rites.name: Vaules
rites.text: A high-skill craft that channels crackling energy through a practitioner's palm to strike whatever they touch. It is taught through a rare collection of bound scrolls.

rites.name: Amintor Oraullornia
rites.text: A practice that lets a wielder hold a short blade, charm, or rod in each hand at once. The two held things need not be alike.

rites.name: Tistellanum
rites.text: A novice-level craft of hurling crackling charge at a foe. It comes from a later collection of written scrolls added to the lore of the realm.

rites.name: Teolor Amostus
rites.text: A hostile working that temporarily weakens the worth of trade and commerce. The effect fades after a while, and the trade's value then returns to what it was before.

rites.name: Maularnia
rites.text: A passive craft that is introduced alongside a champion ranking structure. It is a standing skill that quietly improves a practitioner's handling of elemental forces.

rites.name: Riallium Riliasum
rites.text: A quiet, always-active discipline that a wearer of featherlight plating gradually learns. It belongs to the lightly armored craft line and works silently in the background.

rites.name: Sesia Larnia
rites.text: A traveler vanishes from one known spot and reappears at another mapped place almost at once, though the wider world keeps moving as if the journey were walked. Hired wagons ferry folk between great towns for a price set by distance and size.

rites.name: Collor
rites.text: A passive craft that lets a caster of arcane arts call forth otherworldly beings more readily. It belongs to a branch of summoning learning practiced by sorcerers.

rites.name: Amiales Roneollium
rites.text: A practiced technique belonging to the medium armor discipline, used to avoid incoming harm. Wearers of moderately plated gear rely on it to slip past blows.

rites.name: Tanus
rites.text: A quiet, always-on craft that gradually pulls spent vigor out of a bearer's reserves. It is taught alongside the healing-rod tradition and works without any deliberate command.

rites.name: Caurnor Lastes
rites.text: A learned craft that governs how well a practitioner can weave lasting magical properties into objects. Greater mastery lets the crafter build stronger charged artifacts and makes their use gentler on the magic within them.

rites.name: Tiastenium
rites.text: A binding craft that is inscribed onto worn trinkets such as rings and circlets, making the mixtures a brewer prepares noticeably stronger. It is never found in the reagents themselves, only worked into the wearable charm.

rites.name: Valauriles
rites.text: A charm woven into worn garments or drunk from a vial that sharpens a thief's quick hands. It adds a bonus to the skill check made during a light touch, rather than changing the odds directly.

rites.name: Viarum Teleria
rites.text: A dangerous technique drawn from the staff discipline, which a wielder performs to unleash a sudden blast of pressure outward. It belongs to a family of disciplined battle arts.

rites.name: Amantum
rites.text: A quiet craft held by wandering tenders who mend the wounded out in the open. It works without deliberate effort and was first recorded when the champion orders were reformed.

rites.name: Valeosium
rites.text: A quiet knack that comes to anyone who breaks open a hidden cache of stolen goods. It is granted automatically to those who take part in a shared criminal venture if they have not gained it before.

rites.name: Telintes
rites.text: A guardian's trained discipline that quickens the restoration of mana and vigor when a bonded beast's technique is readied. It works well alongside a particular kind of swamp-dwelling companion.

rites.name: Carium
rites.text: A master-grade flame craft that bursts outward from the wielder's body, scorching nearby foes intensely while sparing the one who cast it. Enemies standing closest to the blast suffer the most.

rites.name: Visium
rites.text: A lingering enchantment that eases the opening of locks, granting a temporary boost as though one's craft had grown sharper. It lasts while worn or until a brewed draught fades away.

rites.name: Coraustium Teliaror
rites.text: A minor enchantment bound into a few charmed relics that sharpens the bearer's ability to bargain and persuade. It works much like a related ward that only aids trading, but reaches into both costs and argument.

rites.name: Virornanum
rites.text: A masterful illusion craft that conjures a soothing false radiance around its caster. It is learned from a rare tome, and the knowledge spreads among practiced mages.

rites.name: Callum Vastor
rites.text: A binding craft that seals a box or doorway so it stays shut indefinitely. The seal yields only to a matching key, a picking tool, or a counter-working that undoes sealing.

rites.name: Amauniarnum
rites.text: A restoring craft that raises the multiplier used to work out how much inner charge a person holds. The usual multiplier sits at one half.

rites.name: Orialus
rites.text: A reward that builds up for skillful fighting, filling a charge bar that unlocks a powerful signature strike. Using these strikes costs the charge rather than mana or breath, and they grow stronger with repeated use.

rites.name: Vallontes
rites.text: A high-skill craft of bending light so the practitioner vanishes from sight for a minute. Any deliberate act, like touching an object or striking another, ends the effect early.

rites.name: Serornia
rites.text: A reshaping craft that loosens locked doors and chests so they open without any picks or trained hands. It works by bending the bolts themselves rather than forcing them.

rites.name: Taurus Reonor
rites.text: A practiced technique of the night-blades that quickens the user's movements for a brief span. It belongs to the assassin's discipline of swift, silent strikes.

rites.name: Coriseolum
rites.text: A quiet, lingering wound-craft practiced by shadow-trained killers, causing a victim's blood to keep flowing after the strike. It belongs to the stealthy killing arts taught among night-blade guilds.

rites.name: Valeorarnes
rites.text: A grim binding craft taught to apprentices of the second rank, it drives a looping cord of force around a foe's neck. It is recorded among the appended tomes of a later compendium.

rites.name: Coriastor Sastiarium
rites.text: A passive discipline that a warrior gains through a ranked training path, granting steady benefits while wearing thick plate protection. It was added alongside a later reworking of the way fighters advance their skills.

rites.name: Valerastes
rites.text: A touch-cast craft that drains an opponent's stamina entirely, leaving them lethargic for a short span that grows with the caster's skill. It never fails, making it useful against foes who still have great reserves of endurance.

rites.name: Velaurum
rites.text: A quiet, constant inner resilience that a champion draws upon without thinking. It was introduced alongside the newer system of champions, giving them a steady reserve of vitality.

rites.name: Corolinor
rites.text: A temporary enchantment that raises the worth of trading and bartering for a while. Once its duration ends, the trader's talent returns to its former measure.

rites.name: Carnia Neontesia
rites.text: A passive craft of remaining unseen that belongs to a sleight-of-hand discipline introduced alongside a newer system of civic justice.

rites.name: Calesanum Cialium
rites.text: A quiet, always-active discipline that hardens a fighter's guard without any deliberate effort. It arrived alongside a newer system for raising chosen champions.

rites.name: Valarilor
rites.text: A ranged craft that hurls a shard of biting cold at a foe, dealing sharp frost harm. It always takes hold when cast, and it is learned early, making it a reliable way to deliver chilling damage.

rites.name: Teonus Corineoles
rites.text: A passive discipline drawn from the heavy plate tradition of the armored orders. It hardens the wearer's stance so that they carry on through blows that would otherwise stagger them.

rites.name: Menes Nellises
rites.text: A bound craft that lets its user leap far higher than normal for a stretch of time. Practitioners use it to clear obstacles that would otherwise stop them.

rites.name: Renus Nerisor
rites.text: A high-skill illusion craft that a practitioner gains through a specialized arcane tome. It works through deception of the senses and is the work of a skilled caster.

rites.name: Seriantasor
rites.text: A quiet, always-on inner technique that a shadow-trained practitioner uses to draw in and channel a surge of arcane energy. It belongs to a school of siphoning crafts.

rites.name: Cernanum Amaulor
rites.text: A passive craft of opening sealed locks and mechanisms that belongs to a wider line of sleight-of-hand arts. It was added alongside a formal system of law and order.

rites.name: Naror Cestisum
rites.text: A quiet, always-active knack for lifting small belongings unnoticed. It belongs to a wider discipline of sleight-of-hand that was taught alongside a newer system of civic judgment.

rites.name: Mellor
rites.text: A learned skill belonging to a guild of spellcasters that lets a practitioner rein in the flow of arcane energy. It forms one branch of the guild's broader training path.

rites.name: Amernastium
rites.text: A passive craft that a wearer learns to favor in lightweight protective garments. It arrived alongside a newer system of champions, shaping how fighters are trained.

rites.name: Sialum Ronor
rites.text: A deadly trait carried by certain bearers, whose strikes ruin any creature they wound. Anything struck by such a force is torn apart and cast aside.

rites.name: Corestiasor
rites.text: A minor restorative craft that mends wounds, drawing on little of the caster's reserve. It is the simplest form of healing practiced by those who study such arts.

rites.name: Lianeontor
rites.text: A learned art of bargaining that lets a trader sell goods for more than they are worth and buy them for less. The skill grows sharper with every deal completed and rests on a person's charm.

rites.name: Tistium Riaraules
rites.text: A passive craft that a practitioner carries without needing to activate it. It arrived alongside a newer system of champions that shaped how such abilities were granted.

rites.name: Teleriantor
rites.text: A quiet blessing that works on trade in the background, always active without being called upon. It was introduced alongside a newer system for chosen champions.

rites.name: Oriastes Valornor
rites.text: A passive discipline that a warrior learns to rely on while wearing moderately heavy protective gear. It arrived alongside a newer system for ranking fighters into formal champions.

rites.name: Mornaulum
rites.text: A rare inner craft lets its bearer bend the sky above them, so that the air around them strengthens or mends their vigor while they remain within its reach. It may be wielded only once each day, and only in the far fringe realm after its great trials are finished.

rites.name: Telolaustus
rites.text: A high-tier arcane craft that reshapes the flow of living motion, freezing every creature nearby in place. Only the most accomplished practitioners can learn it from a sage who guards the knowledge.

rites.name: Vistiasia
rites.text: A temporary working that briefly sharpens a trader's talent for bargaining and commerce. When it fades, the talent returns to its former level, with the gain measured by how much it was raised.

rites.name: Viarnestium
rites.text: A learned craft that sharpens a wielder's stealth, letting them move unseen. It works as a restored skill adding extra quiet and cunning to one's talents.

rites.name: Viasterium
rites.text: A self-cast ward that wraps the caster in a field able to unravel hostile sorcery aimed at them. Its success is uncertain, growing steadily as the caster gains experience.

rites.name: Serornus Caurus
rites.text: A binding craft that locks a creature's limbs in place for a set span, so it cannot step, parry, or drink a remedy. Its strength depends only on how long the stillness is made to last.

rites.name: Vinorum
rites.text: A rare binding of force that bypasses every ward and armor a foe might raise. Its mark on a blade shows a different sigil, yet its power stays unchanged.

rites.name: Niriases
rites.text: A tally that measures how long a wanderer may remain beneath the waters before the body begins to fail. When its count runs dry, the wanderer's vitality drains quickly away.

rites.name: Coraurnum
rites.text: A harmful incantation that briefly saps an opponent's stamina, draining it away for a short span. The stolen vigor flows back to its owner once the working fades.

rites.name: Monor
rites.text: A reshaping craft that unbinds the most stubborn locks upon a chosen target. It is a spell of advanced skill, cast by those trained in transforming matter.

rites.name: Nelus Ternalles
rites.text: A spinning dial lets a speaker choose among pressing, nudging, or buying a listener's agreement. A trained tongue lowers the price of the buying option and sharpens the outcome.

rites.name: Orontia
rites.text: A kindred craft of focused radiance that was once called by an older name before being renamed. Its two branching forms were renamed alongside it.

rites.name: Montiares
rites.text: A set of harsh spoken utterances used to wound or menace another being, to add jest or force to speech, or to fit habitual phrasing. Its use is recorded in a catalogue of such sayings.

rites.name: Siantum Teliantor
rites.text: A passive practice that lets a champion bounce back swiftly from injury. It was introduced alongside the ranking system for champions.

rites.name: Neontiasum
rites.text: A discipline by which a seeker crosses the limits imposed by ancient sovereigns to reach a higher state of being. Its practice is said to follow an older path and a newer path, though its full method remains hidden.

rites.name: Lernanum Sintium
rites.text: A craft of quietly sliding goods from another's keeping, letting the practitioner look through a target's belongings without breaking any law. A botched attempt stirs suspicion, often turning the mark hostile.

rites.name: Veollor Naules
rites.text: A ledger of mixing formulas lets traders buy common reagents cheaply, brew them into draughts, and resell the brews at a steep markup. Any two reagents sharing a property yield a draught of that property, regardless of the brewer's training.

rites.name: Amiselanum
rites.text: A craft that alters the ground so that unwary travelers are caught within it. It belongs to a family of crafts that reshape the surrounding land.

rites.name: Coreones Amaunor
rites.text: Each people receives one great gift at its founding, and more gifts can be gained along the way. These active surges cost no inner reserve, are not studied from scrolls, and are called forth with a single press of a chosen key.

rites.name: Ciastauntor
rites.text: A learned craft that lets a bearer drive out lingering corruption from an ally's body. It is awakened once the bearer has reached the fourth standing of the healing arts.

rites.name: Sereonum Morantia
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that a warrior trained in heavy plate can draw upon without thinking. It works silently in the background, steadying the wearer while they fight.

rites.name: Toniastia
rites.text: A restful practice that every wanderer must undertake to grow stronger and restore body and spirit. Once done, all their vital reserves are refilled completely, no matter how long the slumber lasted.

rites.name: Oralles Sereliares
rites.text: A constant inner hardening that a fighter gains without choosing to use it. It was added alongside a newer system for gathering and training champions.

rites.name: Siallosanum
rites.text: A restorative force that refills the stamina of a chosen champion. It stands in direct opposition to a draining counterpart that wears that same stamina away.

rites.name: Serines Ceosiarnes
rites.text: A passive mark granted to a lone warrior upon reaching a high rank within an imperial order. It quietly enhances the bearer's abilities without requiring any action.

rites.name: Vilum Solleornum
rites.text: A passive practice of a caster trained in calling bound otherworldly servants. It works quietly in the background and shapes how summoning is carried out.

rites.name: Seroralum
rites.text: A soothing force that mends a wanderer's inner spirit and returns their lost sense of self. It stands in direct opposition to the draining force that strips a person's character away.

rites.name: Telisanum Valonaurnia
rites.text: A passive craft in which a combatant automatically returns harm when struck. It was added alongside a newer system of chosen warriors.

rites.name: Tiallus Risanum
rites.text: A practiced technique in which a wielder directs a heavy forged weapon in a sharp, punishing blow. It is used alongside a particular great hammer carried by the same bearer.

rites.name: Viaranum Vellia
rites.text: A minor enchanted effect that stirs back a little of a traveler's appetite. It belongs to a set of optional craft-trials for those who endure long journeys.

rites.name: Tisor Oriallostes
rites.text: A touch-cast rite of a great power that rouses a fallen person into a brief, mindless servitude for a single minute. It can be wielded only once each day.

rites.name: Amonium Orintasia
rites.text: A passive technique that lets a fighter answer an incoming strike with a counter-blow. It was introduced alongside a new ranking system for champions.

rites.name: Amalernum
rites.text: A coined craft that lets a caster unveil hidden things with a sudden burst of light. It is learned through a supporting discipline and only becomes available after reaching a high level of training.

rites.name: Castiarium
rites.text: A practiced seeing-craft that lets a seeker sense hidden relics through faint reflections. It is used whenever one searches for an ancient artifact within the region a trail leads toward.

rites.name: Valaurenia
rites.text: A craft by which a practitioner binds a chosen tome to assorted glyph-strands, reshaping the form and reach of a learned technique. It serves as an early forerunner of a later, more refined art of arcane construction.

rites.name: Valarnum Valaustium
rites.text: A temporary enchantment that heightens a wanderer's talent for moving unseen and hides the caster's presence from watchful eyes. It proves especially useful for covert errands and shadowed tasks.

rites.name: Mernium Nesteolum
rites.text: A stealth craft that lets a wanderer pick the bolts of doors and chests. Greater mastery opens harder locks with less effort, and it is governed by nimbleness of hand.

rites.name: Resanum Reollor
rites.text: A sticky, cloying spell that sprays a thick ooze over a target's surroundings. It cannot be learned through ordinary study and causes no harm to those it splatters.

rites.name: Tastum Telaniastus
rites.text: A late-acquired mastery of guarding with a broad shield, allowing a fighter to unleash a decisive technique once it is learned. It arrived as a newer addition to the wider craft of arms.

rites.name: Telolenanum
rites.text: This craft lets a practitioner slip quietly through shadows and lift belongings from unsuspecting folk. It also allows small goods to be slipped secretly onto others, as easily as tucking them into a bag, and it rests on nimbleness of body.

rites.name: Valeostia Sostor
rites.text: A ward that grants its bearer a layer of protection against lightning-style strikes, hardening the body against both blows and crackling energy. It can be woven into enchanted gear, crafted into charms, or drawn from brewed draughts.

rites.name: Amostianium
rites.text: A bright, searing technique drawn from a skill line of dawn-fire wrath, used by a holy fighter to unleash a burst of radiant flame. It belongs to an order's repertoire of sunlit combat arts.

rites.name: Serirnanum Ceorum
rites.text: A ranged strike technique drawn from the bow arts, practiced by archers who learn it once they reach the second tier of their craft.

rites.name: Reonia Leoniasum
rites.text: A reserved technique of brief power that a fighter can call upon to fully guard the battlefield, marked as one of the great attacks of the trained warrior's repertoire. It arrived in a later revision of the craft.

rites.name: Tinum Sasinanum
rites.text: A learned craft of the tongue that belongs to the Thief path and merges two older arts of bargaining and persuasion. It opens special words in conversation, letting a speaker sway, threaten, buy, or jeer a listener.

rites.name: Amaulentia
rites.text: A swift burst of running that drains a traveler's endurance reserve while it lasts. Once the pace slows, the reserve slowly refills, and anyone bumped by the rush grumbles at the runner.

rites.name: Leontaunes
rites.text: A wielder's bodily reserve of drive spends itself on heavy strikes and hard running. When the reserve runs dry, the wielder cannot act until it returns, and cold magic can drain it from foes.

rites.name: Seristum Misanum
rites.text: This measure sets how swiftly a wanderer dashes across the land and how far they leap forward. It also shapes skill in nimble climbing, bodily exertion, and wearing light protective garb. Beyond a certain height, it still grants an added quickening of the stride.

rites.name: Amellantia
rites.text: A constant inner trait belonging to one lineage of mages, quietly restoring their arcane reserves over time. It counts as one of the four innate gifts bestowed upon that people.

rites.name: Leolontanum
rites.text: An art of forging new enchantments by fusing several known incantations into one. The strength of the result rises with the mana it consumes, and each added effect demands more mana than the last.

rites.name: Serauntanum Causirnus
rites.text: A practitioner channels a shared arcane craft by striking a set keybind, releasing a crackling burst of force that jolts every foe nearby. The technique draws its power from a bond between allied casters.

rites.name: Serintes Ameostolus
rites.text: A learned craft that siphons weariness from a rival into the practitioner, leaving the foe drained while the caster is restored.

rites.name: Amantestor
rites.text: A practiced technique where a shadow-trained fighter briefly slips across a short distance to strike an unguarded foe. It is learned once a fighter reaches the fourth tier of the assassin's discipline.

rites.name: Seranium Cauntus
rites.text: A defensive role within a band of adventurers, where one member steps forward to absorb enemy attacks. Such a member acts as a living barrier, shielding the companions who strike and heal.

rites.name: Sentanum Tornium
rites.text: A quiet, constant talent practiced within a covert brotherhood of shadow-dealers. It lets a practitioner see the wanted marks laid upon them fade about twice as fast as usual.

rites.name: Sintaullus
rites.text: A nocturnal craft by which a practitioner calls forth a dim, shadowy companion from the dark. It is used by those who work in the shadows and act unseen.

rites.name: Corenes Corarnum
rites.text: A withering craft that drains the strength of a binding ritual for a short while. The binding's power slowly restores itself once the working fades.

rites.name: Teliarnium Telaulus
rites.text: A quiet alchemical effect that dulls a bearer's courage and bold instincts. It stands directly opposed to an effect that kindles fearless resolve.

rites.name: Neres Seonus
rites.text: A separate reserve of power that is gathered during battle and through the use of abilities. It is spent only on the mightiest techniques, each demanding a set portion, and it can be enlarged by skillful fighting and certain learned gifts.

rites.name: Caurus Neostia
rites.text: A stealing craft that drains the strength of a lance-like weapon for a short while. The weapon's power slowly returns once the craft fades.

rites.name: Amisteria
rites.text: A quiet inborn craft that lets a bearer endure blows and harm without flinching. It was recognized as a formal discipline when a new system of champions began to be sanctioned.

rites.name: Restus Ciastesum
rites.text: A quiet, always-on craft by which a shadowy practitioner draws strength from others and passes it along. It belongs to a sneaky order that lives by siphoning power.

rites.name: Oreornia Amiallor
rites.text: A passive discipline taught within a guild of hardened warriors, unlocked once a fighter reaches the sixth tier of their standing. It was added to the craft in a later revision of the training rolls.

rites.name: Nasauria
rites.text: A craft of shaping the world by sounding resonant tones that thread through everything that exists. Its practitioners can build lasting structures, mend bodies, and alter or bind the minds of others.

rites.name: Miantium
rites.text: A ultimate technique of the twin-blade discipline that alters a fierce strike into a more disruptive form. It serves as the second variation of a bleeding attack.

rites.name: Oreornistum
rites.text: A craft that lets a warrior of the hunter orders spin binding threads that hold foes fast. It is learned once a fighter reaches the second tier of the order's training.

rites.name: Corelanium
rites.text: A high-skill spell that raises a crackling curtain of lightning on the ground, where it hurts anyone walking through it. A lesser spark-like version can be cast straight at a foe, which then conjures this barrier at their feet.

rites.name: Terum Coreolauses
rites.text: A touch-cast craft that draws a little life force out of one chosen foe and passes it into the caster. It never fails and lasts longer as the caster grows in skill.

rites.name: Reoriantum
rites.text: A combat technique drawn from a band of fighters who train together in the offensive arts. It becomes learnable once a warrior reaches the fifth tier of their assault training.

rites.name: Lanisia
rites.text: A practiced fighting technique in which a warrior wielding two blades spins through a swirling assault. It is learned only after mastering the art of striking with a blade in each hand.

rites.name: Rastaurnia
rites.text: A dragonborn warrior's passive craft that empowers fire-based abilities and eases the cost of venom and web techniques. It draws on the fire-skill lines used by many fighters, mages, and archers.

rites.name: Nisium Lenteosia
rites.text: A restorative incantation that briefly sharpens the caster's skill at bargaining and trade. Its effect fades after a short while.

rites.name: Lalia
